About ERA Environmental Management Solutions
--------------------------------------------

Since 1995, we have been helping hundreds of companies use our software to solve their environmental management problems.  
  
Our mission is simple. We offer reliable, user-friendly & affordable software tools to help industry comply with environmental regulations.  
  
We pair this with dedication to customer service and environmental expertise.  
  
ERA's Software includes regulatory tracking and reporting capabilities for North American air emissions, waste management and water management. All calculations are completed within the software and the result is exported to the required report for submission to the appropriate regulatory authority.  
  
ERA's Health & Safety Module compliments the environmental management software. The module provides a broad range of tools for tasks such as Training Tracking, Incident Tracking with OSHA 300/301 Log generation and Hygiene Sampling.  
  
ERA-CERTIS™ provides fast, easy and accurate environmental solutions for paint/coating distributors.  
  
At the core of our program is our Master Chemical List - an up-to-date compilation of over 100,000 federal and state regulated chemicals. This is used to create any product your facility consumes, allowing you to track your impacts at a chemical level.

In recent years, Michelle has shifted her focus back to modeling and has continued to pursue opportunities in the entertainment industry. She has also become a mother and has embraced the role of being a parent, sharing her experiences on social media and in interviews. While she may no longer be an active wrestler, Michelle's impact on the wrestling world is still felt to this day.

As with any wild-grown food, you want to be sure that you are getting 100% safe and edible AFA, harvested by the most reputable of harvesters. Our harvesting and purity testing is of utmost importance to us. We not only meet, but exceed quality and safety standards for harvesting processes. About Nuspire
-------------

Over twenty years ago, Nuspire was born out of the devotion to provide a new,  
fresh and inspiring approach in solving the security gaps that many clients faced.  
At that time, the idea of a managed security services provider (MSSP) was just an  
idea, but we believed in a higher purpose – to inspire our employees, clients and  
company to become better every day. Because of that, we found that the best way  
to help our clients is through a partnership that allows us to protect them and  
help them become more secure.  
  
The recipe, while simple, remains elusive to much of the industry. Our senior  
leadership has been in our clients’ shoes – starting with the CEO, the team is rooted  
in a chief information security officer (CISO) background. We hired the best security experts in the industry that relentlessly pursue operational excellence and work in the industry to customize the cybersecurity experience.  
  
We know that cybersecurity needs are as unique as a business itself. We exist  
to make clients fanatically happy and go beyond achieving what is expected. Our team is  
intentional and deliberate – which makes us stand out from others in the  
industry. We are authentic and relentless in our pursuit of excellence and stand out from the  
crowd to always be an extension of your client’s team—accountable for their success.  
  
Many global clients trust Nuspire to manage their cybersecurity program from  
two US-based offices and 12 global processing centers and security operations  
centers (SOCs). Many of the brands that you know – Nuspire is with them every day  
partnering, supporting and managing their cybersecurity programs. We have  
many of the same clients from Nuspire’s early days, evident with one of the  
highest client retention rates in the industry – 99%\*.  
  
For more information, visit www.nuspire.com and follow @Nuspire.  
  
\*Client retention rate based on calendar year.

What makes Solera Networks different from other cybersecurity providers?

About Park City Municipal Corporation
-------------------------------------

Long before Park City became home to world class mountain resorts and venue for the 2002 Olympic Winter Games, it was an infamous mining town. Founded by prospectors in 1884, Park City mined silver until the early 1960's when the consolidation of area mines precipitated the start of the ski industry.  
  
Today, Park City Municipal Corporation has set the goal for Park City, Utah to become "The Best Resort Town in America.” To achieve this, the City implemented a strategic plan which aims to: preserve and enhance the natural environment, make Park City a "Thriving Mountain Town," cultivate an engaged and effective government and citizenry, and foster a diverse and healthy community.

Established in 1979, Autosmart is the UK and Ireland’s largest manufacturer and distributor of professional vehicle and food processing cleaning products for trade customers. No other company has such extensive knowledge of the specialised cleaning requirements for these markets.  
  
Customers come from a wide range of industries, including car dealerships, valeters, hauliers, vehicle rental companies, body shops, agricultural dealers, coach and bus operators, plant hire and construction and food processors.  
  
Our network of over 160 mobile showrooms will visit you regularly, wherever you are. We bring our full range of products to you and offer expert local support and service. Take immediate delivery of the products you need, with no minimum orders or expensive delivery costs.  
  
Each franchisee operates from a ‘mobile showroom’ – a purpose built vehicle, laid out inside like a supermarket. The customer comes on board, sees the full range of products, and tries out the ones they're interested in. Then they take immediate delivery and can start using the product straight away. Combine this system with our excellent product range and you can see why, wherever we are, we are the market leader.  
  
With over 300 franchisees worldwide, we aim to have a long term, profitable business relationship with our franchisees. In fact, 70% of our franchisees have been with us for more than 5 years, and half of these for more than 10 years.  
  
We currently have several business 'resale' opportunities available throughout the UK and France. If you want to be your own boss, but want the back-up and support of a major, recognised brand, Autosmart has a proven track record in helping people like you achieve your professional dreams.

What types of products does Unilock offer?

Unilock offers a wide range of products including natural stone, concrete pavers, interlocking pavers, permeable concrete pavers, slabs, and segmental retaining walls. These products are designed for various applications such as driveways, patios, walkways, and landscaping, providing both aesthetic appeal and durability.

How does Unilock ensure the quality of its products?

Unilock is committed to quality and employs rigorous testing and manufacturing processes to ensure that all products meet high standards. The company utilizes advanced technology and adheres to strict quality control measures throughout the production process, ensuring that customers receive reliable and long-lasting products.

Can Unilock products be used for both residential and commercial projects?

Whether you are looking to enhance your home’s outdoor space or need durable solutions for commercial properties, Unilock offers products that meet the demands of various environments and usage scenarios.

What is the benefit of using permeable concrete pavers?

Permeable concrete pavers are designed to allow water to pass through their surface, reducing runoff and promoting groundwater recharge. This environmentally friendly option helps manage stormwater effectively, minimizes flooding, and can contribute to meeting local regulations for stormwater management.

Does Unilock provide installation services for their products?

Unilock primarily focuses on manufacturing high-quality paving products and does not directly offer installation services. About BlueJeans by Verizon
--------------------------

BlueJeans Network is the most advanced way to enable video conferencing in the workplace or on the road. Our goal is to make video as easy and pervasive as audio communications and create visual experiences that people love. While the audience that uses BlueJeans has expanded to businesses of all sizes, our core customers are enterprises who need reliability, security, and scale they can trust. Our customer list includes some of the world’s leading brands including Facebook, Red Hat, Viacom, LinkedIn and thousands of other companies.  
  
In everything we do, we strive to build the best possible products and always put our customers first. BlueJeans service extends high-quality video meetings beyond the traditional boundaries of specialized conference rooms and into the mainstream of everyday business life. In doing this, we allow employees throughout a business to interact more productively with each other, and with their customers and partners.  
  
We believe that video is an enhanced way for people to communicate today. We also believe that organizations who heavily utilize video will have a more productive workforce. People have always been a company’s most important asset. We believe this for all companies— and for ourselves. We care deeply about creating a work environment where people are happy, productive, and interact well with each other. We look for people who are grounded and humble, and share our desire to create video meetings that people love to use. If this is you, then we welcome you to BlueJeans!  
  
BlueJeans investors include New Enterprise Associates, Accel, Battery Ventures, Derek Jeter Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, Glenn Capital Management, Quadrille Capital, and Derek Jeter.

Rocketrip cuts a company’s travel costs by incentivizing employees to spend less on their trips. When employees get to keep a portion of the savings they generate, they start to treat the company’s money like it’s their own.  
  
Rocketrip’s software combines real-time travel prices, company policy, and a suite of patented algorithms to set a customized Price to Beat, predicting what a trip should cost. Business travelers beat these thresholds by making cost-conscious choices like booking in advance, selecting a cheaper hotel, or staying with friends. The company saves money, and the employee earns actual rewards.  
  
Rocketrip provides comprehensive reporting and seamlessly integrates into any existing corporate and expense technology stack. If you want to rein in business travel costs while improving corporate culture, visit rocketrip.com

What is Rocketrip and how does it help companies manage travel costs?

Rocketrip is a platform designed to help companies reduce their travel expenses by incentivizing employees to save money on business trips. By allowing employees to keep a portion of the savings they generate, Rocketrip encourages cost-effective travel choices. This not only lowers overall travel costs for the company but also promotes a culture of financial responsibility among employees.

What types of businesses can benefit from using Rocketrip?

Rocketrip is suitable for a wide range of industries, including technology, finance, consulting, and any organization that requires frequent business travel. Companies of all sizes can leverage Rocketrip's solutions to optimize their travel budgets and enhance employee engagement through incentives.

How does the incentivization process work for employees?

When employees book travel through Rocketrip, they are presented with a budget for their trip. If they manage to spend less than this budget, they can keep a percentage of the savings as a reward. This creates a win-win situation where employees are motivated to find cost-effective travel options while the company benefits from reduced travel expenses.

Can Rocketrip integrate with existing travel management systems?

Yes, Rocketrip is designed to integrate seamlessly with various travel management systems and tools that companies may already be using. This ensures a smooth transition and allows companies to leverage Rocketrip's incentivization model without disrupting their existing travel processes.

What kind of reporting and analytics does Rocketrip provide?

Rocketrip offers comprehensive reporting and analytics tools that allow companies to track travel spending, employee savings, and overall program effectiveness. These insights help organizations make informed decisions about their travel policies and identify areas for further cost savings.

Is Rocketrip suitable for remote or hybrid workforces?

Absolutely! Rocketrip is well-suited for remote and hybrid workforces, as it allows employees to book travel from anywhere while still benefiting from the incentivization model. This flexibility encourages all employees, regardless of their work location, to engage in cost-saving behaviors when traveling for business.

Screenco Manufacturing Ltd., headquartered in Vaughan, Ontario, is recognized as Canada’s premier manufacturer of high-quality rollform and screen products. At Screenco, customer satisfaction is paramount. The company prides itself on delivering exceptional service, competitive pricing, and unparalleled reliability, making it a trusted partner for contractors, builders, and homeowners alike. Utilizing advanced manufacturing technologies, Screenco produces durable and aesthetically pleasing rollformed products that enhance the functionality and appearance of any space.  
  
The company’s offerings include custom screen solutions, roll-formed components, and a wide array of accessories designed to meet the rigorous demands of the construction industry. Screenco’s commitment to quality and innovation ensures that their products not only meet but exceed industry standards, providing customers with peace of mind and long-lasting performance.  
  
Whether you are embarking on a residential renovation or a large-scale commercial project, Screenco Manufacturing Ltd. stands out as a one-stop shop for all your rollforming and screening needs. With a focus on sustainability and efficiency, Screenco is dedicated to supporting the evolving needs of the construction industry while maintaining a strong commitment to environmental responsibility.

About Otafest
-------------

Otafest is an annual conference for anime enthusiasts. We act as a creative outlet for fans, an occasion where they can show their passion and appreciation of the hobby. We are an event where fans can show off the costumes they have made, the music videos they have created, and the art they have painted and drawn. Otafest is a forum for discussion and education. We host community-made and educational panels introducing others to the basics of the Japanese language and tips on how to use computer programs to enhance music videos and CG art. In the past, we have hosted guests who explained the process of donning a kimono, demonstrated the intricacies of tea ceremonies, and Iaido (the art of drawing a sword from a scabbard). We have also invited individuals involved in the voice acting and animation industries to speak of their experiences.  
  
Otafest is a marketplace. We gather dozens of vendors and artists together from all over Western Canada to facilitate the best bargain hunting in town.  
  
Each year, we host charity events and fundraisers during the festival to be donated to that year’s selected charity. Dedicated rooms such as the Maid Cafe donate their proceeds to the charity as well.

About Hispanic Scholarship Fund
-------------------------------

Founded in 1975, the Hispanic Scholarship Fund empowers Latino families with the knowledge and resources to successfully complete a higher education, while providing scholarships and support services to as many exceptional Hispanic American students as possible. HSF strives to make college education a top priority for every Latino family across the nation, mobilizing our community to proactively advance that goal – each individual, over a lifetime, in every way he/she can. HSF seeks to give its Scholars all the tools they need to do well in their course work, graduate, enter a profession, excel, help lead our nation going forward, and mentor the generations to come. As the nation’s largest not-for-profit organization supporting Hispanic American higher education, the Fund has awarded over $470 million in scholarships and provides a range of ancillary programs for students, HSF Scholars, Alumni, and parents. About Alberta Agriculture and Forestry
--------------------------------------

The Ministry contributes to three of the government’s four key opportunities. Unleashing Innovation, Competing in a Global Marketplace and Making Alberta the Best Place to Live, Work and Visit. The primary focus of Alberta Agriculture and Forestry is on Government of Alberta Goal 1, Alberta will have a diversified and prosperous economy under the key opportunity of Unleashing Innovation. The Ministry achieves this by working with others to promote prosperity for Alberta through a strong, competitive, sustainable agriculture and food industry.  
  
Ministry Core Businesses  
  
A market-driven, environmentally responsible industry  
  
Food safety, plant health, and animal health and welfare  
  
Rural development  
  
The Ministry is divided into the Department of Agriculture and Forestry and a number of agencies, boards and commissions. The Department is responsible for the management of programs designed to facilitate the development of all components of the agriculture and food industry, to sustain the natural resource base of the industry and to encourage the development of rural communities.

About New Hope Center, Inc.
---------------------------

New Hope Center, Inc. is a community service agency that provides services to individuals with intellectual and/or age-disabilities who reside in Southeast Cook County and Northeast Will County. Communities served include Dolton, Calumet City, Chicago Heights, Crete, Evergreen Park, Harvey, Lansing, Lynwood, Markham, Matteson, Park Forest, Riverdale, Sauk Village, South Chicago, South Holland, Steger, Thornton, and Tinley Park.  
  
New Hope Center, Inc. is a not-for-profit community-based organization, defined in Section 501 (c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code.  
  
The purpose of New Hope Center is to be a leading solutions provider to clients with intellectual and/or age-related disabilities, their families and their communities by leveraging a culture of innovation, professionalism and caring to exceed stakeholders expectations.  
  
New Hope School was incorporated in 1960 by a small group of parents whose children were developmentally disabled and were unable to receive education in the public school system. Through their collaborative efforts, educational and vocational classes were conducted in local churches and storefronts. New Hope School soon evolved into New Hope Center, Inc. and a vast array of services were provided to individuals with developmental disabilities far beyond educational and vocational programming.  
  
In July 2016, New Hope Center merged with SouthSTAR Services. Both organizations were championed by courageous parents of children with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Their hard work and dedication will remain the fabric as we operate under our new name, New Star, Inc.

About Black Swamp Steel, Inc.
-----------------------------

Black Swamp Steel, Inc. is a certified steel contractor, providing exceptional service to customers throughout the Midwest for more than 22 years. Our services include reinforcing steel installation, structural steel erection, and reinforcing steel fabrication and supply.  
  
The name Black Swamp is a historical reference to Ohio's Great Black Swamp, a vast wetland that dominated the Lake Erie lowlands from northwest Ohio to northeastern Indiana. Through hard work, determination, and old-fashioned ingenuity, the swamp land was drained to leave some of the richest and most productive agricultural soils in the Midwest.  
  
At Black Swamp Steel, Inc., we believe that the past helps shape future, and our commitment to safety, communication, hard work, and ingenuity reflects that. We have drained away the barriers and inefficiencies and have emerged stronger and more productive, providing the highest quality service and products the steel industry has to offer.  
  
Our talented employees come from diverse backgrounds, both in the public and private sector, and have more than 200 years combined experience. Customers rely on Black Swamp Steel, Inc.’s skilled team to provide solutions, and we deliver. We strongly believe in developing relationships and shouldering the responsibility to facilitate a successful project, completed safely, on time and on budget.  
  
We welcome the opportunity to assist with your next project. Contact us to learn more.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Black Swamp Steel, Inc.

What types of services does Black Swamp Steel, Inc. offer?

Black Swamp Steel, Inc. specializes in a variety of steel services including structural steel erection, reinforcing steel fabrication, reinforcing steel installation, and shear stud welding. With over 22 years of experience in the industry, we are committed to delivering high-quality workmanship and exceptional service to our clients throughout the Midwest.

What industries does Black Swamp Steel, Inc. serve?

We serve a diverse range of industries, including commercial construction, industrial facilities, infrastructure projects, and residential developments. Our expertise in steel contracting allows us to meet the unique needs of each sector, ensuring that we provide tailored solutions for every project.

How does Black Swamp Steel, Inc. ensure quality in its steel installations?

Quality is a top priority at Black Swamp Steel, Inc. We adhere to strict industry standards and utilize certified materials in all our projects. Our team of experienced professionals follows rigorous quality control processes and conducts thorough inspections throughout the installation process to ensure that every project meets or exceeds client expectations.

Can Black Swamp Steel, Inc. handle large-scale projects?

Yes, we have the capacity and expertise to manage large-scale projects efficiently. Our team is equipped to handle complex structural steel erection and reinforcing steel installation tasks, ensuring timely completion without compromising on quality. We have successfully completed numerous large projects across the Midwest, demonstrating our ability to scale our services to meet client needs.

What is shear stud welding, and why is it important?

Shear stud welding is a process used to attach shear studs to steel beams, which helps to improve the composite action between the steel and concrete in a structure. This technique enhances the overall strength and stability of the building. At Black Swamp Steel, Inc., we utilize advanced welding techniques and equipment to ensure precise and reliable shear stud installations, contributing to the safety and durability of our projects.

How can I request a quote for a project with Black Swamp Steel, Inc.?

To request a quote, you can visit our website and fill out the contact form with details about your project, or you can call our office directly. About Ministério Público Federal
--------------------------------

O Ministério Público Federal no contexto do Ministério Público O Ministério Público Federal (MPF) integra o Ministério Público da União (MPU), que compreende também o Ministério Público do Trabalho, o Ministério Público Militar e o Ministério Público do Distrito Federal e Territórios (MPDFT). O MPU e os ministérios públicos estaduais formam o Ministério Público brasileiro (MP). A cada dia cresce o grau de confiança e respeito em relação ao Ministério Público, em decorrência do correto e independente desempenho das suas atribuições constitucionais. Cabe ao MP a defesa dos direitos sociais e individuais indisponíveis, da ordem jurídica e do regime democrático. As funções do MP incluem também a fiscalização da aplicação das leis, a defesa do patrimônio público e o zelo pelo efetivo respeito dos poderes públicos aos direitos assegurados na Constituição. O Ministério Público tem autonomia na estrutura do Estado: não pode ser extinto ou ter atribuições repassadas a outra instituição. Seus membros (procuradores e promotores) têm liberdade para atuar segundo suas convicções, com base na lei. São as chamadas autonomia institucional e independência funcional do Ministério Público, asseguradas pela Constituição. As atribuições e os instrumentos de atuação do Ministério Público estão previstos no artigo 129 da Constituição Federal, dentro do capítulo "Das funções essenciais à Justiça". As funções e atribuições do MPU estão dispostas na Lei Complementar nº 75/93.

About B-Tech AV Mounts
----------------------

B-Tech AV Mounts, which was founded in 1972, is a leading global designer and manufacturer of professional audio video mounting solutions. The core range focuses on providing solutions for Flat Screen Displays, Projectors and Loudspeakers and are used for Digital Signage, Video Walls, Video Conferencing, as well as for more traditional scenarios such as domestic use and public access areas such as shopping centres, airports, transportation hubs, hotels, schools, sports stadia etc.  
  
B-Tech AV Mounts is the brand used by The B-Tech International Group which includes the following companies:  
  
B-Tech International Ltd (Head Office - Daventry, UK)  
B-Tech Pro-AV bvba (Brussels, Belgium)  
B-Tech Deutschland GmbH (Berlin, Germany)  
B-Tech International Iberia s.l. (Barcelona, Spain)  
B-Tech International Design & Manufacturing Ltd (Hong Kong)  
B-Tech AV Mounts Pte Ltd (Singapore)  
Ningbo B-Tech International Trading Co., Ltd (China)  
B-Tech International Vietnam Co., Ltd (Hanoi, Vietnam)  
B-Tech Korea Co., Ltd (Seoul, Korea)  
B-Tech AV Mounts LLC (USA)  
B Tech Audio Visual Accessories LLC (Dubai, U.A.E.)  
  
B-Tech has two distinct market segments with its product range: B-TECH PROFESSIONAL for installers, systems integrators etc which includes the successful and industry acclaimed SYSTEM X, and B-TECH CONSUMER which caters for the retail and domestic markets.  
  
B-Tech owns several brands through which our products are promoted depending on the target market:  
  
B-Tech AV Mounts, Mode-AL, and B-Tech Pro for the Professional markets.  
Ventry, BIB and Cantabria for the Consumer markets.  
  
These ranges are available worldwide through our global distribution network - for more information please visit our website at www.btechavmounts.com.  
  
Thanks for following,  
B-Tech

### Frequently Asked Questions about St. Tammany Parish Sheriff Office

What services does the St. Tammany Parish Sheriff’s Office provide to the community?

The St. Tammany Parish Sheriff’s Office provides a wide range of services to ensure the safety and well-being of the community. These services include law enforcement, crime prevention programs, community outreach initiatives, emergency response, and support for victims of crime. The agency is committed to preserving public safety, protecting citizens' rights, and promoting community engagement.

How can I report a crime or suspicious activity in St. Tammany Parish?

To report a crime or suspicious activity in St. Tammany Parish, you can contact the St. Tammany Parish Sheriff’s Office directly by calling their non-emergency number or by visiting their website to find additional reporting options. In case of an emergency, please dial 911 immediately. The agency encourages citizens to report any suspicious behavior to help maintain community safety.

What programs does the St. Tammany Parish Sheriff’s Office offer for youth engagement?

The St. Tammany Parish Sheriff’s Office offers several programs aimed at engaging youth in the community. These include educational initiatives such as D.A.R.E. (Drug Abuse Resistance Education), youth leadership programs, and community service opportunities. The agency believes in fostering positive relationships with young people to encourage responsible citizenship and prevent delinquency.

How does the St. Tammany Parish Sheriff’s Office handle community outreach?

Community outreach is a vital component of the St. Tammany Parish Sheriff’s Office's mission. The agency actively participates in community events, hosts informational seminars, and collaborates with local organizations to address community concerns. They also utilize social media and their website to keep citizens informed about safety tips, crime trends, and available resources.

What should I do if I have a complaint against a deputy or staff member?

If you have a complaint against a deputy or staff member of the St. Tammany Parish Sheriff’s Office, you can file a formal complaint by contacting the agency's Internal Affairs Division. This can typically be done via phone or through their website. The agency takes all complaints seriously and investigates them thoroughly to ensure accountability and maintain public trust.

What resources are available for victims of crime in St. Tammany Parish?

The St. Tammany Parish Sheriff’s Office provides various resources for victims of crime, including victim assistance programs that offer support, counseling, and information about legal rights. Victims can access resources through the agency’s website or by contacting their Victim Services Unit directly. The agency is dedicated to helping victims navigate the aftermath of crime and ensuring they receive the support they need.

About Boston Area Rape Crisis Center
------------------------------------

Founded in 1973, the Boston Area Rape Crisis Center (BARCC) is the only comprehensive rape crisis center in the Greater Boston area and the oldest and largest in New England. Our mission is to end sexual violence through healing and social change.  
  
BARCC provides free, confidential support and services to survivors of sexual violence ages 12 and up and their families and friends. We work with survivors of all genders, from the immediate crisis after to years and decades later. Our goal is to empower survivors to heal and seek justice in ways that are meaningful to them. We meet the needs of survivors in crisis and long after, and we assist survivors as they navigate the health-care, criminal justice, social service, and school systems.  
  
We take the knowledge we learn from survivors and current research out into the community. We work with a wide range of schools, campuses, community groups, and organizations. These include middle and high schools, colleges, police, health-care providers, businesses, and more. We advocate for change and work with them to help them make their environments safe and prevent sexual violence. We do this by offering training, on topics such as how to respond to survivor's disclosures. We provide concrete tools and technical assistance to help create policies and practices that prevent sexual violence. Our response and prevention programs are based on research and more than 45 years of direct service experience. We are frequently asked to provide expert testimony about potential policy and legislative solutions to preventing and responding to sexual violence. We also provide expert commentary in the media on these issues.  
  
BARCC assists thousands of survivors, their loved ones, and communities each year, regardless of sex, gender identity, race, physical/developmental disabilities, income, ethnicity, class, religion, or sexual orientation. We provide services in English and Spanish, as well as other languages upon request.

About Prime Design - The Roof Rack Specialists
----------------------------------------------

Prime Design has been the industry’s ergonomic leader since 1992, when we first introduced the concept of an ergonomic ladder rack. Based in West Saint Paul, MN, Prime Design is the leading innovator of ladder storage solutions for fleet vehicles. When loading a ladder, these solutions help reduce back and muscle strain while keeping feet safely on the ground.  
  
Our design philosophy starts with the worker – how can we make the job safer, easier and more comfortable for the human body? We firmly believe that a product’s design and how it impacts the user is every bit as important as the quality of materials and construction.  
  
All Prime Design products feature patented designs that greatly reduce operator stress and fatigue, reduce the risk of work-related injuries, and increase worker productivity.  
  
Telecommunication workers, insurance estimators, general contractors, and other vehicle-based occupations rely on Prime Design to improve productivity and reduce Workers’ Compensation claims. For more information, please visit our products page. Or, to learn about the additional brands owned by Prime Design’s parent company, Safe Fleet, visit www.safefleet.net.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Prime Design - The Roof Rack Specialists

What types of roof racks does Prime Design offer?

Prime Design specializes in a variety of roof racks designed for commercial vehicles. Our product line includes ergonomic ladder racks, cargo racks, and custom solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of different industries such as transportation, distribution, and manufacturing. Each rack is engineered for durability, safety, and ease of use, ensuring that your equipment is securely transported.

How does Prime Design ensure the safety of its roof rack systems?

Safety is a top priority at Prime Design. Our roof rack systems are designed with ergonomic principles to minimize the risk of injury during loading and unloading. We conduct rigorous testing to ensure compliance with industry safety standards. Additionally, our products feature secure locking mechanisms and are built to withstand various environmental conditions, providing peace of mind for users.

Can Prime Design customize roof rack solutions for specific vehicles?

Yes, Prime Design offers customization options for our roof rack solutions. We understand that different vehicles and industries have unique requirements. Our team works closely with clients to develop tailored solutions that fit specific vehicle models and operational needs, ensuring optimal functionality and efficiency.

What industries does Prime Design serve?

Prime Design serves a wide range of industries, including transportation, distribution, safety, manufacturing, and commercial vehicle sectors. Our products are designed to enhance productivity and safety for businesses that rely on transporting equipment and materials. We have extensive experience working with various sectors, allowing us to provide specialized solutions that meet industry-specific challenges.

How can I determine which roof rack is right for my vehicle?

To determine the best roof rack for your vehicle, consider factors such as the type of equipment you need to transport, the weight capacity required, and any specific features you may need (like adjustable height or additional storage options). We recommend consulting with our knowledgeable team, who can guide you through the selection process based on your vehicle model and usage requirements.

What is the warranty policy for Prime Design products?

Prime Design stands behind the quality of our products with a comprehensive warranty policy. We offer a limited warranty that covers defects in materials and workmanship for a specified period. The exact terms may vary depending on the product, so we encourage customers to review the warranty details provided with their purchase or contact our customer service for more information.

About University Of Nottingham Malaysia
---------------------------------------

The University of Nottingham Malaysia, established in September 2000, stands as a pioneering institution, being the first campus of a British university in Malaysia and one of the earliest globally. Recognized with prestigious accolades such as the Queen's Award for Enterprise in 2001 and the Queen's Award for Industry (International Trade) in 2006, the university has built a strong reputation for excellence in education and research. In 2005, the campus relocated to a modern, purpose-built facility in Semenyih, Selangor, situated just 30 kilometers from Kuala Lumpur's city center.  
  
Spanning 101 acres, the campus is designed to reflect the serene beauty of University Park in the UK, providing a vibrant and diverse community for over 5,000 students from various backgrounds. The university prides itself on offering world-class teaching and research opportunities, with all courses delivered in English and conferring the same degrees as those awarded in the UK. The state-of-the-art learning facilities are complemented by a high-quality living environment, creating an ideal setting for academic and personal growth.  
  
In addition to its academic offerings, the University of Nottingham Malaysia boasts a dedicated faculty, with a comprehensive teachers list available for prospective students. This diverse group of educators is committed to fostering an engaging learning atmosphere that encourages collaboration and innovation. With convenient transport links to Kuala Lumpur and surrounding areas, students enjoy easy access to the vibrant culture and opportunities that the region has to offer. Overall, the University of Nottingham Malaysia is a remarkable institution that combines academic rigor with a supportive community, making it an excellent choice for students seeking a global education experience.

At Gravity, we aim to bring clarity to supply chains.  
  
We do this because we understand the unpredictability of the earth, wind, and sea. Powered by best-in-class technology, our solutions help to navigate the pressures and complexities in an ever-changing landscape of disruption.  
  
Crafted with decades of industry insight, our solutions blend the latest in IoT, predictive technologies and accurate data sets from transport networks around the world.  
  
Focused on optimizing operating costs, on-time performance and improving your end-customer relationships, our core applications include:  
  
Shipment Tracker (Multi-modal tracking)  
PO Management (Order and vendor management)  
Sourcing (Master data management)  
  
All our applications are seamlessly integrable with your existing systems, making it simple and easy to partner with you.  
  
From shippers to third party-logistics firms, we understand the importance of delivering end-to-end visibility and execution across the supply chain.  
  
Gravity is a truly global business with headquarters in Singapore and offices in the US, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK.  
  
Designed to deliver real, actionable insights, when you need them most. Gravity keeps you reassured and equipped to deal with the unexpected.  
  
Book a live demo with us to learn more: https://gravitysupplychain.com/book-a-demo/.

Water Technology, Inc. (WTI) was established in 1983 to meet the individual needs of waterpark clients and translate their visions into successful designs. Today, WTI maintains the widest range of planning, design and engineering qualifications in the waterpark industry. WTI believes that creating exciting and sustainable waterpark environments help clients become leaders in their markets, across sectors that include resort destination waterparks, themed waterparks, and community aquatic centers in North America, Europe, Middle East, Asia and Australia. WTI’s world renowned firm staffs over forty professionals in the disciplines of planning, architecture, design, and engineering.  
  
Water Technology’s global experience, accompanied by its partner firms, has taken indoor and outdoor waterpark development to new heights by integrating the latest technology in design, engineering and construction. This provides owners with unequalled experience in delivering a project which is situational and geographically correct. As a leader in waterpark design and engineering, WTI continues to integrate the latest environmentally friendly disinfection and filtration technologies into waterparks, such as UV disinfection and regenerative media filtration for maximizing water conservation. WTI’s strength is in realizing the client’s vision, incorporating new attraction developments and innovations, and then delivering a technologically superior waterpark product for any location.

About Detroit Free Press
------------------------

The Detroit Free Press is the oldest company in the State of Michigan, yet publishes new content as it is happening.  
  
We do that with the largest newsgathering staff in the state and some of the best technology for gathering and posting text, photos and video.  
  
One of the Free Press' first editorial campaigns was for Michigan to become a state, which it did in 1837.  
  
The Free Press pioneered regular Sunday publication, a women's section and a European edition.  
  
The Detroit Free Press is the largest daily newspaper in Detroit, Michigan. It is sometimes informally referred to as the "Freep." Some still refer to it locally as "The Friendly" -- a slogan from an ad campaign in the '70s.  
  
The Free Press is owned by Gannett and has received eight Pulitzer Prizes.

About Reliable Corporation
--------------------------

FROM WHERE YOU LIVE  
TO WHAT YOU WEAR, WE’RE  
RIGHT THERE WITH YOU.  
  
At Reliable, we do what we love, and we take pride in doing it right. Quality, functionality, design and customer service play an equally important part in delivering what’s right for you. From irons to steam cleaners to sewing machines, you can count on us to be right there with you. That’s the Reliable Way.  
  
Founded in 1955 and headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, Reliable is a successful family owned business. Our extensive line of sewing and fabric care products are used in the garment industry/retail clothing stores, the alteration sector, in drapery workrooms, and in other markets.  
  
Our professional steam cleaning products are used in dental labs, jewelry stores, hospitals and restaurants among many other commercial applications. We also offer steam cleaners and garment care products for home use.  
  
We are gaining a dedicated following for the Reliable brand amongst consumers with a passion for quilting, fashion, and the home. Reliable is known for our customer focus, consistently providing both high-quality products and first-class customer service. Reliable has a long history of product innovation.  
  
Reliable is located in a modern 25,000 square foot facility in Toronto Ontario, and our products are available online, in catalogs, and from resellers across North America, Asia, and Europe.  
  
We are making significant progress into the bricks and mortar retail environment within the United States (most recently Crate & Barrel Clean Slate Stores) and look forward to many more years of economic growth and product expansion.

Rutgers University - Newark (RU-N) stands as a beacon of academic excellence and diversity in the heart of Newark, New Jersey. About ChristianaCare
--------------------

Providing value-based care to our community,  
ONE PERSON AT A TIME.  
  
ChristianaCare, headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, is one of the country’s largest health care providers, ranking 22nd in the nation for hospital admissions.  
  
ChristianaCare is a major teaching hospital with two campuses and more than 250 Medical-Dental residents and fellows. ChristianaCare is recognized as a regional center for excellence in cardiology, cancer and women’s health services. The system is home to Delaware’s only Level I trauma center for adults and children, the only center of its kind between Philadelphia and Baltimore. ChristianaCare also features a Level III neonatal intensive care unit, the only delivering hospital in the state to offer this level of care for newborns.  
  
A not-for-profit, non-sectarian health system, ChristianaCare includes two hospitals with more than 1,100 patient beds, a home health care service, preventive medicine, rehabilitation services, a network of primary care physicians and an extensive range of outpatient services.  
  
With more than 11,600 employees, ChristianaCare is the largest private employer in Delaware and among the top 10 in the Philadelphia region.

About e-Safe Systems Sdn Bhd
----------------------------

e-Safe Systems is a data security, governance, regulation and compliance (GRC) solution provider whose journey began in the year 2000 in the UK with a simple, but incredibly powerful, philosophy – "treat people as adults"; do not devote your whole energy toward trying to prevent them doing bad things, you will only frustrate the 95% of people who only want to stick to the rules anyway!  
  
We provide systems to ensure compliance to organisations’ or regulators’ rules by interacting directly with the users. Through a policy of "educate, trust and verify" we apply rules of behaviour and data handling specific to any given user or group of users and constantly monitor at the endpoint their compliance to those rules. Any potential transgression is then reported, with a clear audit trail, to the data owner or the user’s boss. This means that compliance is normally assured by influencing the mind-set of the user – certainty of capture is more effective than severity of punishment. This also ensures that many of the blanket “blockers” currently in use can be relaxed as people will self-police, allowing them access to otherwise blocked sites when appropriate. Security becomes everyone’s responsibility.  
  
Today our philosophy is being championed as People Centric Security by Gartner. Our flagship product, e-Safe Compliance, is a market leader in the area of behaviour management in IT systems and networks. Its key technologies include Data Centric Audit and Protection (DCAP), Encryption & Rights Management, and User Entity Behaviour Analytics (UEBA).  
  
With offices now in the UK, Malaysia and Australia, and a growing number of partners, our systems help to protect over a million users in areas as diverse as security services, finance, manufacturing, distribution, legal services and education.

About Odebrecht Ambiental
-------------------------

A Odebrecht Ambiental é a empresa da Organização Odebrecht que desenvolve soluções para a preservação dos recursos naturais e melhoria na qualidade de vida das pessoas através de sua atuação nos segmentos de Água e Esgoto, Utilities e Resíduos. Em Água e Esgoto, por meio de parcerias com companhias estaduais e privadas, Estados e municípios, complementa os investimentos públicos para a universalização dos serviços de abastecimento de água e tratamento de esgoto no Brasil. Atualmente, 16,1 milhões de pessoas são atendidas pela empresa em mais de 180 municípios brasileiros.  
  
Clientes industriais dos setores de metalurgia, petróleo, mineração, entre outros, terceirizam Centrais de Utilidades para a Odebrecht Ambiental, no segmento Utilities, garantindo uma gestão mais eficiente de seus ativos. Já na área de Resíduos, a empresa promove o diagnóstico e remediação de áreas contaminadas, atua no tratamento e destinação adequada de resíduos industriais, de construção civil e resíduos sólidos urbanos, valorização energética dos resíduos sólidos urbanos e TWM (gestão total de resíduos). Também presta serviços de resposta a emergências marítimas.  
  
A Odebrecht Ambiental trabalha pelo desenvolvimento e aperfeiçoamento de tecnologias inovadoras com o compromisso de promover a conservação do meio ambiente e contribuir para o desenvolvimento das comunidades onde atua.

About Bruno Mara

Bruno Mars is an American singer, songwriter, and record producer who has captivated audiences with his electrifying performances and chart-topping hits. Born in Honolulu, Hawaii, Mars (born Peter Gene Hernandez) was exposed to a variety of musical genres at a young age, which would later influence his distinctive sound.  
  
Mars began his musical career at a young age, performing in his family’s band and later pursuing a solo career in Los Angeles. He gained recognition as a songwriter, penning hits for artists like Flo Rida and Adam Levine before launching his own solo career. Mars released his debut album, "Doo-Wops & Hooligans," in 2010, which featured the smash hits "Just the Way You Are" and "Grenade." The album earned him widespread acclaim and established him as a rising star in the music industry.  
  
Known for his soulful vocals and dynamic stage presence, Mars has earned a reputation as one of the most versatile and talented performers in the industry. His music draws inspiration from a wide range of genres, including pop, R&B, funk, and reggae, creating a sound that resonates with audiences of all ages. Mars has cited artists like Michael Jackson, Elvis Presley, and James Brown as some of his biggest influences, and his performances often pay homage to their iconic stage presence and showmanship.  
  
In addition to his solo career, Mars has collaborated with some of the biggest names in the music industry, including Mark Ronson, Beyoncé, and Adele. His collaboration with Ronson on the hit single "Uptown Funk" became a global phenomenon, earning Mars his first Grammy Award for Record of the Year. He has also achieved success as a producer, working with artists like CeeLo Green and B.o.B, and demonstrating his versatility and talent behind the scenes as well as on stage.  
  
Mars has released several critically acclaimed albums, including "Unorthodox Jukebox" and "24K Magic," which have spawned a string of hits and further solidified his status as a music industry heavyweight. His 2016 album, "24K Magic," saw Mars embracing a funkier, more retro sound, and earned him multiple Grammy Awards, including Album of the Year and Record of the Year for the title track.  
  
In addition to his musical talents, Mars has also made a name for himself as a charismatic and engaging live performer. His high-energy stage shows and infectious charisma have earned him a devoted fan base and made him a sought-after headliner at music festivals and award shows around the world. Mars has also brought his showmanship to the small screen, delivering standout performances on shows like "Saturday Night Live" and "The Grammy Awards."  
  
With his undeniable talent and boundless energy, Bruno Mars continues to push the boundaries of music and redefine what it means to be a pop star. His ability to seamlessly blend different musical styles and his relentless commitment to entertaining audiences have cemented his status as a true icon of contemporary music. Whether he’s belting out a power ballad or tearing up the dance floor with one of his upbeat anthems, Mars never fails to leave a lasting impression on fans and critics alike. As he continues to evolve and grow as an artist, there’s no doubt that he will remain a force to be reckoned with in the music industry for years to come.

About City of Holland
---------------------

Holland is the All-American City with a Dutch accent located near the shores of Lake Michigan on Lake Macatawa in the western region of the Lower Peninsula of the U.S. State of Michigan.  
  
It was incorporated as a city in 1867 by its first mayor, Isaac Cappon. Today it utilizes a council/manager form of government. The day-to-day operations of the city are under the supervision of the City Manager and his/her staff.  
  
Holland's City Council is comprised of a mayor and eight city council members. The Mayor serves a two-year term, while two "at large" council members and six "ward" council members each serve four-year terms.  
  
The city is home to the annual Tulip Time festival, a celebration of Dutch heritage, Hope College, a private four-year liberal arts college, and the most extensive "snowmelt" system, covering more than 500,000 square feet of downtown Holland.

What services does Roaming Hunger offer for food truck operators?

Roaming Hunger provides a comprehensive suite of services for food truck operators, including marketing and advertising support, catering solutions, and a food truck locator to help connect them with potential customers. They also offer a marketplace where food trucks can buy and sell equipment and supplies, as well as promotional opportunities to increase visibility and sales.

How can businesses benefit from partnering with Roaming Hunger for catering events?

Businesses can enhance their events by partnering with Roaming Hunger for catering services. The company connects businesses with a variety of gourmet food trucks that can provide unique and delicious meal options for corporate events, parties, and festivals. This not only adds a fun and trendy element to events but also supports local food truck entrepreneurs.

What is the Food Truck Locator and how does it work?

The Food Truck Locator is an innovative tool provided by Roaming Hunger that allows users to find food trucks in their area. By entering a location or browsing a map, users can see real-time locations of food trucks, their menus, and hours of operation. This service is beneficial for food truck enthusiasts looking to discover new dining options and for food truck operators to increase their visibility.

Can Roaming Hunger assist with food truck promotions and marketing strategies?

Yes, Roaming Hunger specializes in experiential marketing and can assist food truck operators with tailored marketing strategies and promotional campaigns. They help food trucks reach a wider audience through social media marketing, event participation, and collaborations with local businesses, ensuring that food trucks can effectively engage with their target market.

What types of events can Roaming Hunger cater to?

Roaming Hunger can cater to a wide range of events, including corporate gatherings, weddings, festivals, and private parties. Their network of food trucks offers diverse cuisine options, allowing clients to customize their catering experience based on the theme and preferences of their event. This flexibility makes them a popular choice for various occasions.

Is Roaming Hunger involved in the buying and selling of food trucks?

Yes, Roaming Hunger operates a food truck marketplace where buyers and sellers can connect. This platform allows food truck operators to list their trucks for sale, while potential buyers can browse available options. The marketplace is designed to facilitate transactions and provide resources for those looking to enter the food truck industry or upgrade their existing operations.

His meticulous attention to detail and his ability to capture the essence of each story through his music has garnered him a reputation as a composer who consistently delivers exceptional work.  
  
Larkin’s talent and dedication to his craft have earned him a dedicated following of fans who appreciate his ability to create music that resonates on a deep emotional level. His compositions have a timeless quality that allows them to stand on their own as pieces of art, while also serving as integral components of the projects they were created for. Larkin’s ability to create music that is both captivating and emotionally impactful makes him a composer to watch in the world of film, television, and video games. Dick Hannah Dealerships. Believe in nice.

About Marjam Supply
-------------------

Marjam Supply Company was founded in 1979, with the purchase of a warehouse in Greenpoint, Brooklyn, a few thousand dollars in assets and the mission of providing a highly specialized and customer service driven distributor of lumber, plywood and other building materials to the trade. Since the beginning, MarJam has experienced continuous and sustained growth. MarJam now operates 30 "super centers" in ten states that serve the entire East Coast states of the U.S. and is one of the most respected businesses in the competitive construction supply industry in the United States. We owe this growth to the loyalty and repeat business of our valued customers. Despite our growth, we have made sure that the individual attention that made our reputation at our beginning is just as big a part of what drives every one of us at MarJam every day.  
  
MarJam sells acoustical ceiling systems, doors and frames, windows, roofing, siding, flooring, insulation, tools, hardware, equipment, wall systems, lumber, plywood, adhesives, masonry and specialty items to builders, contractors, architects, engineers, the government and the public.

About David Baldacci

David Baldacci is an accomplished American novelist and attorney known for his gripping and suspenseful thrillers that have captivated readers worldwide. Born and raised in Virginia, Baldacci's novels are often set in small southern towns, blending local charm with dark secrets and dangerous mysteries. His keen attention to detail and ability to weave intricate plots have made him one of the most recognized and popular authors in the genre.  
  
Before delving into the world of writing, Baldacci pursued a career in law. He graduated from the Virginia Commonwealth University School of Law and practiced law for many years, specializing in corporate litigation and trial work. His experiences as an attorney undoubtedly played a significant role in shaping his writing style, as he expertly crafts legal dramas and courtroom scenes that are both suspenseful and authentic.  
  
Baldacci's writing career took off with his debut novel, "Absolute Power," which was published in 1996. This gripping thriller tells the story of a burglary gone wrong that puts a career criminal at odds with the most powerful man in America. The novel was an instant success, becoming a bestseller and garnering critical acclaim. Its success also led to a film adaptation starring Clint Eastwood in 1997. With this debut, Baldacci established himself as a master of the genre, combining intricate plots, flawed yet relatable characters, and a talent for creating gripping narratives that keep readers on the edge of their seats.  
  
Since "Absolute Power," Baldacci has written numerous novels, each one showcasing his prodigious storytelling skills and ability to blend political intrigue, espionage, and suspenseful mystery. With recurring characters like Amos Decker, a former football player turned detective, and the Camel Club, a group of misfits who uncover dark conspiracies, Baldacci has created a compelling universe that enthralls readers with every page.  
  
In addition to his series, Baldacci has also penned standalone novels that explore a wide range of themes and settings. From the heart-wrenching tale of a young girl who mysteriously vanishes in "The Innocent" to "The Last Mile," where a wrongly convicted man fights to prove his innocence on death row, Baldacci consistently delivers complex and thought-provoking stories that resonate with readers.  
  
Baldacci's writing style is characterized by his attention to detail and meticulous research. His novels often delve into various fields, such as forensics or government operations, and he seamlessly incorporates this knowledge into the story. Readers are treated not only to thrilling plots, but also to a wealth of information that keeps them engaged and intrigued.  
  
Beyond his writing, Baldacci is actively involved in philanthropic endeavors. Alongside his wife, he established the Wish You Well Foundation, which supports family literacy programs across the United States. Through this foundation, Baldacci has demonstrated his commitment to giving back and helping others build a better future through education.  
  
In summary, David Baldacci is an American novelist and attorney renowned for his captivating thrillers. With his unique blend of legal expertise, attention to detail, and gripping storytelling, Baldacci has cemented his place among the great authors of the thriller genre. From his debut novel, "Absolute Power," to his series featuring memorable characters like Amos Decker and the Camel Club, Baldacci's books keep readers hooked from beginning to end. With his philanthropic work and dedication to supporting literacy, Baldacci has not only entertained countless readers but also made a lasting impact on the world.

About Allison Brennan

Allison Brennan is a distinguished American writer known for her gripping and suspenseful crime fiction novels. With her razor-sharp storytelling skills and keen eye for detail, Brennan has captivated readers around the world with her thrilling plots, complex characters, and high-stakes narratives. Her prolific career spans over two decades, during which she has established herself as a prolific and talented author in the crime and mystery genre.  
  
Brennan's writing career took off with the publication of her first novel, "The Prey," in 2005, introducing the world to her distinctive blend of suspense, drama, and psychological tension. Since then, she has gone on to pen numerous bestselling series, including the Lucy Kincaid series, the Maxine Revere series, and the Quinn & Costa Thrillers. Her willingness to tackle difficult subject matter with sensitivity and empathy has earned her a dedicated following of readers who appreciate the depth and substance of her work.  
  
As a New York Times and USA Today bestselling author, Brennan's influence in the crime fiction genre cannot be overstated. Her novels have been translated into multiple languages and have attracted a global fanbase, solidifying her reputation as a mainstay in the world of crime fiction. Her impact on the genre extends beyond her own writing, as she is also a passionate advocate for emerging writers and a respected voice in the writing community. Through her blog, social media presence, and public engagements, she generously shares her insights, advice, and encouragement with aspiring authors, paying it forward to the next generation of storytellers.  
  
In summary, Allison Brennan is a prolific and talented American writer whose name has become synonymous with gripping and compelling crime fiction. With her intricate plots, authentic characters, and fearless exploration of challenging themes, she has carved out a unique niche in the genre and continues to captivate readers with her electrifying storytelling. About Bridgend Motor Group
--------------------------

Established in 1930 and still family owned, Bridgend Group is SW Scotland's largest independent used car retailer.  
  
We offer the widest range of used cars in Ayrshire. Our Service Centres at all branches offer fixed price menu servicing as well as servicing to manufacturer specifications without the franchise price tag, MoT testing and mechanical repairs and our Accident Repair Centre process body repairs and accident damage.  
  
With four key locations across Ayrshire we are well placed to serve the people of SW Scotland.  
  
Our used car Autoplex in Kilwinning offers a huge choice of up to 500 used cars for sale, all makes and models with prices from £2,000 to £20,000 and have a full Service & MOT Centre.  
  
Irvine specialise in 4x4 vehicles and Japanese used car sales and a Service Centre.  
  
Our Ayr Autoplex also has up to 500 used cars for sale and a Service & MOT Centre.  
  
All branches provide up to 5 years used car warranties, finance and service plans, with the vast majority of our used cars being supplied serviced and MoT tested and with a warranty included.  
  
Bridgend Accident Repair Centre in Kilwinning is Ayrshire's largest independent accident repair centre. Repairs are carried out for all major insurance companies but their expert repair techniques are also available to private individuals looking to repair their car to a showroom finish without paying a hefty insurance excess via our Bodyshop Express Repairs.

Atlanta Public Schools (APS) is a dynamic educational district dedicated to fostering the growth and success of nearly 52,000 students across 87 schools. Headquartered at 130 Trinity Ave. SW, Atlanta, GA, APS is organized into nine K-12 clusters, encompassing 58 traditional schools, 18 charter schools, 6 partner schools, 2 citywide single-gender academies, and 3 alternative programs. The district’s mission is clear: to cultivate a caring culture of trust and collaboration that ensures every student graduates ready for college and career. With a vision of being a high-performing school district, APS strives to create an environment where students love to learn, educators inspire, families engage, and the community places trust in the educational system.  
  
At APS, the commitment to excellence is evident in the vibrant learning environments provided to students. The district boasts highly qualified teachers, the latest technology, and innovative educational practices that transcend geographic, racial, and economic barriers. By adopting the Common Core Georgia Performance Standards (CCGPS), APS aligns its curriculum with national expectations, ensuring that students are equipped with the knowledge and skills necessary for the 21st century. The district emphasizes high standards and expectations, aiming to prepare all students not only for academic success but also for their roles as productive citizens in a global society.  
  
For those interested in the educational landscape, the Atlanta Public Schools teachers list is a valuable resource, showcasing the dedicated professionals who contribute to the district's mission. APS believes that strong schools build a strong Atlanta, and through its comprehensive approach to education, it is committed to making this vision a reality. About Faith Alliance of Metro Atlanta
-------------------------------------

The Faith Alliance of Atlanta is a 501(c)(3) organization whose mission is the promotion of understanding, respect, prayer, interaction and unity among the diverse faiths in the greater Atlanta region, and the advancement of the influence of voices of the faith communities for social justice.  
  
We are not a uniform group: rather our board and membership we are pluralistic in practice and diverse with regard to age, race, sexuality, faith, culture, race and tradition. We believe that our organization, by intentionally manifesting and representing this diversity, can contribute positively to the Metro Atlanta community through:  
  
\- Communal prayer with those of other faith  
\- Education on religion and matters of social justice  
\- Dialogue and conversation, including during projects held in conjunction with our partners the Atlanta Food Bank and Habitat for Humanity  
\- Cooperation and networking with religious and social justice organizations  
\- Advocacy and action on matters of local and national importance

However, Estefan's career has not been without its challenges. In 1990, she suffered a devastating bus accident that left her with a fractured spine and required extensive rehabilitation. Determined to overcome her injuries, Estefan's sheer determination and unwavering spirit allowed her to make an astounding comeback. Her album "Into the Light," which chronicled her journey of recovery, became a testament to her resilience and strength.  
  
Estefan's impact extends far beyond the world of music and acting. As a philanthropist and advocate for various causes, she has always used her platform to make a difference. Estefan and her husband, Emilio Estefan, established the Gloria Estefan Foundation, which supports education, health, and cultural initiatives. Additionally, Estefan's activism for the rights of the LGBTQ+ community has been widely recognized and admired.  
  
Throughout her illustrious career, Gloria Estefan's music has resonated with millions of fans worldwide. Her ability to infuse joy, emotion, and cultural diversity into her work has allowed her to connect with people from all walks of life. As a trailblazer for Latin artists in the mainstream music industry, Estefan has undoubtedly left an indelible mark on the music landscape.  
  
In summary, Gloria Estefan's career has been nothing short of extraordinary. From her humble beginnings in Havana, Cuba, to becoming a global superstar, her story is a testament to the power of music and determination. With her unparalleled vocals, infectious rhythms, and magnetic stage presence, she has cemented her place as an iconic American singer and actress. About Jeff Anhang

Jeff Anhang serves as an Environmental and Social Specialist at the World Bank Group's International Finance Corporation (IFC), where he plays a pivotal role in assessing environmental and social risks associated with development projects. His expertise in environmental and social impact assessment is critical in ensuring that projects align with the IFC's sustainability goals and adhere to international standards. Jeff's work involves not only evaluating potential impacts but also identifying opportunities for enhancing community engagement and promoting corporate social responsibility within the projects financed by the World Bank.  
  
In his current role, Jeff has been instrumental in advising on the management of environmental and social risks, helping to establish frameworks that prioritize stakeholder involvement and transparency. He has also contributed significantly to the development of a public accountability mechanism, which reinforces the IFC's commitment to ethical practices and community welfare. His extensive knowledge of climate change, food security, and agricultural sustainability is reflected in his co-authored literature, available at \[Chomping Climate Change\](http://www.chompingclimatechange.org/read.html), which addresses critical intersections between environmental issues and socio-economic development.  
  
Jeff's skill set encompasses a wide range of competencies, including policy analysis, capacity building, and environmental management systems. His ability to navigate complex international development landscapes and foster collaboration among diverse stakeholders positions him as a leader in promoting sustainable practices that benefit both the environment and local communities. Through his ongoing projects, Jeff continues to advocate for innovative solutions that address pressing global challenges, particularly in the realms of renewable energy and climate resilience.

About Denihan Hospitality Group
-------------------------------

Denihan Hospitality Group, headquartered in the heart of New York City at 551 5th Ave., is a distinguished leader in the boutique and lifestyle hotel sector, boasting over 50 years of expertise as a privately-held, full-service hotel management and development company. With a portfolio that includes ten unique boutique hotels strategically located in major urban markets across the United States, Denihan has established a world-class lodging investment platform. The company excels in acquiring, repositioning, and managing independent hotels, creating exceptional value and memorable guest experiences.  
  
Denihan's commitment to a guest-centric approach has positioned it as an industry pioneer in hospitality, property development, and hotel operations. The company operates under notable brands such as Affinia Hotel Collection and The James, alongside luxury independent properties like The Benjamin and The Surrey. Each hotel is designed to reflect the local culture while providing high-end amenities and services, including chef-driven dining experiences. Guests can indulge in culinary delights at renowned restaurants helmed by celebrated chefs, such as Geoffrey Zakarian’s The National Bar and Dining Rooms at The Benjamin, Daniel Boulud’s Café Boulud at The Surrey, and David Burke’s David Burke Kitchen at The James New York.  
  
Denihan leverages advanced technologies and innovative marketing strategies to enhance guest engagement and operational efficiency, ensuring a seamless experience from booking to check-out. With a focus on sustainability and community engagement, Denihan Hospitality Group continues to redefine the boutique hotel experience, making it a preferred choice for discerning travelers seeking personalized service and unique accommodations.

About RENDER
------------

It all began 18 years ago with a recently-graduated architect, a PC and a basement. The old school way of representations of Real Estate projects were through water colors and blueprints. This is where a business opportunity came about, and we started to develop new ways to showcase projects. Thanks to that vision, projects began to develop into something more modern, tangible and attractive. That is the way RENDER was founded.  
  
But what exactly is RENDER? Literally, it is a company based on a process of generating images or videos through the use of GI lighting. We use 3 dimensional models or digital images as well as 3 dimensional software to create our projects.  
  
Presently, our mission at RENDER, is all about developing new and different ways to promote any kind of project. We work in the Real Estate, entertainment and industrial domains to name a few.  
  
At the beginning, we only focused on the virtual representations of architecture. But we evolved as the expectations and demands of our clients changed. Little by little, we became more competitive and diverse. Today, RENDER can offer our clients a wide variety of techniques and strategies in order to achieve their goals. We now use multi-media, augmented reality, real estate films and design applications. Above all, we provide our clients the Rendering Experience.

Desta forma, podemos garantir os benefícios de uma força de trabalho consistente e motivada que não é comprometida pelas longas cargas de trabalho. Estamos constantemente a actualizar a nossa base de dados de trabalhadores de forma a continuamente corresponder às exigências do mercado.

About BSRM
----------

In 1952, Bangladesh Steel Re-rolling Mills (BSRM) began its journey as the first steel re-rolling mills in the then East Bengal. We strived to change the civil construction landscape of Bangladesh through constant innovation. To be trusted, reliable, and safe, we meticulously met international standards of steel, able to compete with the global market. We introduced the first Grade 500W reinforcing steel, branded as XTREME, steel for special moment resisting frames ULTIMA, the best cost-effective steel – MAXIMA and the only corrosion resistant Fusion Bonded Epoxy coated rebar CENTURA for sustainable constructions in saline areas. The journey of these years has seen many peaks and valleys, but our flame never dimmed, we were diligent in our efforts to illuminate the future of Bangladesh. We not only produced steel but preserved the environment by recycling slag and installing European standard Air Pollution Control system and Water Treatment Plants. We also embarked on CSR projects focusing on the well-being of people and environment. Over the years, we gradually became the forerunner in our field and established ourselves as a symbol of reliance.  
BSRM is an equal opportunity employer. It has a total work force of over 2,800 people which consists of highly skilled professionals, technicians & workers. BSRM has a big annual procurement budget for consulting services in information technology, human resources, ﬁnance, engineering, legal services and marketing services which engage hundreds of highly skilled professionals in the country. The Group’s in-house, on-the-job training enhances the skills of hundreds of young professionals, and contributes to the overall skills base in the country. BSRM always strives to recruit, train and develop the very best young men and women available in the country’s talent pool. The BSRM Group further indirectly employs about 1,500+ unskilled and semi-skilled people through contractors for raw materials and ﬁnished goods handling.

Frankie's dancing journey commenced at the age of 10 when he began training at the prestigious Pittsburgh CLO Academy. Frankie also choreographed music videos for popular artists such as Demi Lovato and Lance Bass. His creative vision and innovative dance moves added a unique touch to these visual masterpieces.  
  
Apart from his remarkable accomplishments in the entertainment industry, Frankie is an avid activist and advocate for various causes close to his heart. He is openly gay and strives to promote LGBTQ+ rights and acceptance. Frankie actively supports organizations like GLAAD, the Human Rights Campaign, and the Trevor Project, using his platform to foster inclusivity and equality.  
  
Frankie Grande is much more than just Ariana Grande's brother. He is a multifaceted talent with a gift for dance, a mesmerizing energy that commands attention, and a heart full of passion for making a positive impact on the world. About Landers Superstore (Southeastasia Retail Inc.)
----------------------------------------------------

Landers Superstore, operated by Southeastasia Retail Inc., is a pioneering membership-based retail establishment that has transformed the shopping landscape in the Philippines since its inception on June 22, 2016. Headquartered in Manila, Landers combines the convenience of a supermarket with the variety of a department store, positioning itself as a one-stop shop for families seeking quality products and exceptional service. Catering primarily to business professionals and select employee groups, Landers offers a curated selection of top-tier imported and local brands, ensuring that members enjoy a blissful shopping experience with every visit.  
  
With branches strategically located in Balintawak, Cebu, Alabang, and ArcoVia City, Landers Superstore is committed to providing a diverse range of products that meet the needs of its members. From grocery essentials to household goods, electronics, and lifestyle products, Landers serves various industries, including food and beverage, home improvement, and personal care. The store's unique membership model not only enhances customer loyalty but also allows for exclusive access to special promotions and discounts, further elevating the shopping experience.  
  
In addition to its extensive product offerings, Landers Superstore emphasizes customer engagement through personalized recreation areas, making shopping a more enjoyable and interactive experience. The company leverages modern retail technologies to streamline operations and enhance customer service, ensuring that members can easily navigate the store and find what they need. As Landers continues to expand its footprint, it remains dedicated to redefining membership shopping and delivering unparalleled value to its members.
