About Danny Boyle

Danny Boyle is a visionary director and film producer who has consistently crafted captivating stories that challenge conventions and push the boundaries of cinematic storytelling. With his dynamic visual style, distinctive storytelling techniques, and diverse range of film genres, Boyle has become a highly respected figure in the world of filmmaking.  
  
Born on October 20, 1956, in Radcliffe, England, Boyle discovered his passion for cinema at an early age. He studied drama and English at Bangor University, where he honed his creative skills and nurtured his love for theatre and film. After completing his education, Boyle started his career in the theater, directing numerous successful productions and developing his unique approach to storytelling.  
  
In the 1990s, Boyle transitioned from the theater to the world of film, making his directorial debut with "Shallow Grave" (1994). This dark and intense crime thriller instantly put him on the map as a filmmaker to watch, earning critical acclaim and commercial success. It was a sign of great things to come.  
  
Boyle's breakthrough film came in 1996 with "Trainspotting," a groundbreaking cult classic that captured the essence of 1990s youth culture with its raw portrayal of drug addiction in Edinburgh, Scotland. The film's energetic cinematography, pulsating soundtrack, and bold narrative choices resonated with audiences and brought Boyle international acclaim. "Trainspotting" showcased his ability to create visually stunning and emotionally charged works of cinema that leave a lasting impact.  
  
Continuing his exploration of different genres, Boyle's next endeavor was the critically acclaimed "A Life Less Ordinary" (1997). This romantic-comedy-crime film featured his signature blend of whimsical storytelling, dark humor, and visually stunning sequences. Although not a major box office success, the film solidified Boyle's reputation as a director willing to take risks and venture into uncharted territories.  
  
In 2000, Boyle achieved widespread commercial and critical success with "The Beach," a visually stunning drama-adventure film based on the novel by Alex Garland. Starring Leonardo DiCaprio, it brought Boyle's talents to a global audience and cemented his status as a director capable of delivering ambitious and visually captivating films. The film showcased Boyle's ability to immerse viewers in a visceral experience, transporting them to exotic locations while exploring complex themes of isolation, exploration, and the human condition.  
  
Boyle's versatility as a filmmaker was highlighted yet again with "28 Days Later" (2002), a post-apocalyptic horror film that redefined the zombie genre. With its gritty and realistic portrayal of a virus outbreak in London, the film injected new life into the genre, showcasing Boyle's ability to craft tension and suspense without relying solely on jump scares. "28 Days Later" became a commercial success and further solidified Boyle's status as a director capable of reinventing genres and creating thought-provoking films.  
  
In 2008, Boyle reached new heights with "Slumdog Millionaire," a rags-to-riches tale set in the slums of Mumbai, India. The film won numerous awards, including eight Academy Awards, and catapulted Boyle into the mainstream spotlight. With its vibrant colors, kinetic editing, and powerful storytelling, "Slumdog Millionaire" showcased Boyle's ability to seamlessly blend different cultural elements while telling a universal story of hope and resilience.  
  
Boyle continued to explore new genres and storytelling techniques in films like "127 Hours" (2010), a harrowing tale of survival based on a true story, and "Steve Jobs" (2015), a biographical drama exploring the life of the Apple co-founder. Both films received critical acclaim, and Boyle's distinctive style and attention to detail were once again recognized.  
  
In addition to his work as a director, Boyle has also produced numerous films, collaborating with up-and-coming filmmakers to bring their unique visions to the screen. His production company, "Decibel Films," has championed independent cinema and supported emerging talent, further solidifying Boyle's commitment to the art of filmmaking.  
  
Danny Boyle's remarkable career spans over three decades, during which he has consistently pushed the boundaries of storytelling. With his dynamic visual style, creative narrative choices, and ability to elicit powerful performances from his actors, Boyle has left an indelible mark on the world of cinema. From cult classics to mainstream blockbusters, his films defy expectations and challenge our understanding of what cinema can be. As a director and producer, Boyle continues to inspire aspiring filmmakers and captivate audiences worldwide with his unique and visionary storytelling.

About Greater Baltimore Medical Center (GBMC)
---------------------------------------------

GBMC HealthCare, Inc. is a private, not-for-profit corporation that owns and operates Greater Baltimore Medical Center (GBMC), a regional community hospital in Towson, Maryland, two miles north of Baltimore City. GBMC HealthCare is comprised of GBMC, GBMC Health Partners, Greater Baltimore Health Alliance, the GBMC Foundation and Gilchrist. GBMC Health Partners is a collective of more than 300 primary care providers, specialists, advanced practice clinicians, and hundreds of support staff, all working together to care for our community. The GBMC Foundation coordinates fundraising for the healthcare network. Gilchrist is Maryland’s leading nonprofit provider of serious illness and end-of-life care.  
  
The Mission of GBMC is to provide medical care and service of the highest quality to each patient and to educate the next generation of clinicians, leading to health, healing and hope for the community.  
  
As our national healthcare system evolves, for GBMC to maintain its status as a provider of the highest quality medical care to our community, we must transform our philosophy and organizational structure, and develop a model system for delivering patient-centered care. We define patient-centered care as care that manages the patient's health effectively and efficiently while respecting the perspective and experience of the patient and the patient's family.  
  
To every patient, every time, we will provide the care that we would want for our own loved ones!

About GMW Personaldienstleistungen GmbH

Seit 1977 ist die GMW Personaldienstleistungen GmbH in Südwestdeutschland tätig. Als mittelständisches Unternehmen sind wir mit unseren 18 Niederlassungen in der Region verwurzelt. Denn der direkte Kontakt und die Präsenz vor Ort sind Grundlage für eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit.  
  
Als seriöser Personaldienstleister verfügen wir über eine unbefristete Erlaubnis zur Arbeitnehmerüberlassung und sind aktives und engagiertes Mitglied im iGZ, dem mitgliederstärksten Arbeitgeberverband der Zeitarbeitsbranche. Wir sind Partner zahlreicher Unternehmen und schaffen Arbeitsplätze mit Perspektive.

Wir werden für Sie tätig im Bereich Zeitarbeit, On-Site-Management oder Personalvermittlung.  
  
Sie suchen eine interessante Stelle und neue Herausforderung? Wir bringen Farbe in Ihr Berufsleben! Wir bieten Ihnen interessante Stellen in unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen bei namhaften Unternehmen in Ihrer Region und sind ein zuverlässiger Arbeitgeber mit persönlicher und individueller Betreuung durch unsere Niederlassungen vor Ort. Durch unsere langjährige Erfahrung finden wir die zu Ihren Qualifikationen und Wünschen passende Stelle.

About GPRC - CRI National Bee Diagnostic Centre - Technology Access Centre (NBDC-TAC)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The NBDC is the first comprehensive laboratory in Canada to provide a full array of diagnostic services for honeybee pests, diseases, and parasites. It comprises a new facility with state-of-the-art equipment for classical and molecular diagnosis, and a team of highly trained and motivated staff that apply the latest techniques on pathogen identification.  
  
The NBDC is the result of a partnership between the GPRC-CRI and the Beaverlodge Research Farm (Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada) where it is located. The project attracted the strategic investment of the Federal Government through the Western Economic Diversification Canada and of the Provincial Government through the Rural Alberta Development Fund.  
  
The Centre will provide diagnostic services for beekeepers, researchers, agencies and industry with the aim to contribute towards a healthy, sustainable and profitable apiculture in Canada. We employ cell culture, microscopy and molecular techniques to identify bacteria, fungi, mites and viruses that affect honey bees. These maladies reduce honey production, weaken hive strength and in many cases produce colony collapse.  
  
Beekeepers and Apiary SME's can also access information and resources to help advance their new product ideas into the marketplace. This includes material on patenting, engineering, prototypes, market development and accessing angel capital.

About Assistance League of Atlanta
----------------------------------

Assistance League® of Atlanta for 40 years is part of Assistance League, a national, nonprofit, volunteer community service organization that helps children & adults in need.  
  
Our partner network includes 235 elementary & middle schools in DeKalb County, Fulton County & the Atlanta Public Schools; 7 Georgia colleges & universities; numerous hospitals & medical centers; police & fire departments; & more than 15 social agencies & other charities.  
  
To best serve the community, social workers, directors & financial aid officers identify those in need & act as liaisons between recipients & Assistance League. Although the Covid-19 pandemic curtailed activities in the last three months of our fiscal year, we still continued to help the community as much as possible. Here are the highlights for our fiscal year ending May 31, 2020:  
  
Backpack Buddies, provided 30 elementary school children with 1,050 bags of food over a period of 30 weeks.  
  
Bears for Children provided 5,960 cuddly bears to small children who have been injured/traumatized.  
  
Links to Education awarded over $60,000 in scholarships to 41 students in 7 colleges & universities for the 2019-2020 academic year.  
  
New Beginnings served 32,000 children & adults in need through 8 social agencies of which 5 are committed to homeless outreach & 3 are sexual assault centers.  
  
Operation School Bell® worked with social workers in 235 elementary & middle schools to provide 4,709 students with a week’s worth of school clothing. 1,789 (38%) were homeless or fire victims. An additional 5,626 students received selected items of clothing & hygiene kits. We also distributed 6,200 children’s books to their schools.  
  
Shepherd Center Patient Support served over 290 patients who are victims of brain & spinal cord injuries.  
  
Waste Not distributed excess items that we cannot sell in our Attic Treasures Thrift Shop, valued at $50,000, to social agencies & other charities.  
  
Wee Help provided 880 layettes to 10 medical centers and agencies.

About Wharton Alumni Angels
---------------------------

Founded in 2016, Wharton Alumni Angels is an active angel investment group composed of University of Pennsylvania alumni and non-Penn alumni who have joined their angel community. Their members are entrepreneurs, senior business executives, and institutional investors with a global reach. Wharton Alumni Angels' over 500 members in 23 countries have invested in more than 50 early-stage companies. Wharton Alumni Angels members seek to add value 'beyond the deal' and actively provide mentoring and assistance to young companies. They are enthusiastic about entrepreneurs and passionate teams pursuing their dreams. Through a global membership and the Wharton alumni community, the organization has a deep network and close relationships with venture capital funds, other angel networks, and innovation ecosystems worldwide to cultivate the growth of start-ups. Wharton Alumni Angels participates most often in seed and Series A investments, and occasionally later-stage rounds and does not focus on specific verticals or industries.

What types of services does Human Factors International offer?

Human Factors International specializes in a range of services focused on enhancing user experience (UX). Our offerings include User Experience Design, Web Design, Usability Testing, and Persuasive Design. We also provide training to build UX capabilities within organizations and offer onsite and offshore UX teams to tackle complex user experience challenges.

How does Human Factors International approach user experience design?

Our approach to user experience design is centered around understanding the needs and behaviors of users. We employ a research-driven methodology that includes user interviews, usability testing, and iterative design processes. This ensures that our solutions are not only aesthetically pleasing but also functional and aligned with user expectations, ultimately leading to improved customer satisfaction and engagement.

Can Human Factors International help with building in-house UX capabilities?

Yes, we offer tailored training programs designed to build in-house UX capabilities. Our training sessions cover essential UX principles, methodologies, and best practices, empowering your team to effectively design and implement user-centered solutions. We also provide ongoing support to ensure that your team can successfully integrate these practices into their workflows.

What industries does Human Factors International serve?

Human Factors International serves a diverse range of industries, including technology, healthcare, finance, and e-commerce. Our expertise allows us to address the unique challenges and requirements of each sector, ensuring that our solutions are relevant and impactful. We have successfully partnered with Fortune 500 companies across these industries to drive significant improvements in customer experience.

How does Human Factors International measure the success of its UX solutions?

We measure the success of our UX solutions through a combination of qualitative and quantitative metrics. This includes user satisfaction surveys, usability testing results, and key performance indicators (KPIs) such as conversion rates and user engagement levels. By analyzing these metrics, we can assess the effectiveness of our solutions and make data-driven adjustments to optimize user experience further.

What is the process for engaging Human Factors International for a project?

Engaging Human Factors International begins with an initial consultation to discuss your specific needs and objectives. From there, we conduct a thorough assessment of your current user experience and identify areas for improvement. We then develop a customized proposal outlining our recommended approach, timeline, and budget. Once approved, we collaborate closely with your team throughout the project to ensure alignment and successful implementation.

What services does Equitable Hiring Group offer?

Equitable Hiring Group provides a range of services aimed at promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion in the hiring process. They also offer tailored solutions to help organizations develop equitable job descriptions and implement bias-free interview techniques.

Equitable Hiring Group supports organizations by conducting comprehensive audits of their current hiring practices, identifying areas for improvement, and providing actionable recommendations. They offer workshops and training sessions focused on unconscious bias, inclusive interviewing, and creating a welcoming workplace culture. Additionally, they assist in developing strategic diversity hiring plans that align with the organization's goals and values.

Equitable Hiring Group serves a wide range of industries, including but not limited to technology, healthcare, education, finance, and non-profit organizations. Yes, Equitable Hiring Group is well-equipped to assist organizations with remote hiring practices. Their training and resources are designed to help organizations adapt their hiring processes to the evolving landscape of remote work.

What is the process for engaging with Equitable Hiring Group's services?

Engaging with Equitable Hiring Group typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss the specific needs and goals of the organization. About Lincraft
--------------

Lincraft has always been led by skilled retailers with a vision that has allowed the company to diversify and grow, with over 67 stores in Australia and New Zealand.  
  
Beginning as a fabric stall in Melbourne in the 1950’s, Lincraft was nurtured by three generations of the Ross family before current owners John Maguire and Brian Swersky established Lincraft Australia in 2005.  
  
Lincraft specialises in craft, fabric, yarn, haberdashery, window furnishings, manchester, fashion accessories and much more. We value the ever changing and evolving world of craft, sending our most passionate buyers to the ends of the earth to the world’s major craft, yarn and fabric fairs, with strict instructions to source the latest in fashion and creative ideas, and return with fresh inspiration for our customers.  
  
Here at Lincraft, we know that nothing is more rewarding than creating something with your own hands, and once the love of craft starts, it can be difficult to stop! That’s the inspiration behind Lincraft’s “How To Make” series – bags to bolero’s, slippers to hoodies, patchwork quilts to Christmas scrapbooks - an entire library of free projects that are easy to do, hard to resist and available in store or online!  
  
Australia’s biggest online craft store is now open for business at www.lincraft.com.au.

At Barrett & Farahany, we advocate on behalf of wronged employees in all matters of employment law. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, we have locations throughout the country. B&F has worked for almost twenty-five years to preserve the rights of working people and is dedicated to making sure their issues are not only heard but addressed.  
  
We represent clients in a variety of cases, including sexual harassment, overtime, payroll disputes, unfair retaliation claims, and violations of the Family Medical Leave Act (FMLA). No matter the issue, we take not only the hard road, but the right road, turning over every stone along the way. We leave no piece of evidence unexamined and compile all the necessary information to ensure accurate and compelling representation. We work hard to find the solution that best fits not only the case but also the desired outcomes of our clients.  
  
Our law firm is known for its innovative, persistent and motivated attorneys and staff. In employment law cases, often people feel powerless and that they have no authority to address the wrongs committed against them. We work against that misconception by explaining to our clients their basic rights and collaborating with them to assert those rights. Our law firm has a reputation for thorough examination and solid representation of the facts. About Key Lime Interactive
--------------------------

Key Lime Interactive is a Customer Experience and User Experience research, strategy and design services agency focused on helping companies take a human-first approach to building better brand experiences, products and services. Key Lime’s UX experts provide actionable insights for every industry sector to help our growing list of Fortune 500 clients understand and effectively engage their customers. Ultimately, KLI empowers teams to use consumer insights and user experience data at all phases of product development, from strategy to implementation. Our experts share the true perspective of a client’s target users to help them design exceptional consumer-driven solutions. Research studies are delivered with KLI’s proprietary Inclusivity Index™ report that makes it easy to identify how studies meet broad inclusivity goals to build a more inclusive brand, product, or service.  
  
We make it our business to answer research questions that help a company move the needle in terms of acquisition, convergence, and customer experience differentiation. Our customers note that it’s easy to design products in your own vision, but moving beyond your own perspective introduces challenges.  
  
Key Lime Interactive becomes your lens. We strive to intimately understand your product, we consult with your consumers on a level they can relate to in order to view the world and your offering the way they do. At the end of the day, we excel at blending the two to direct you down the path of innovative, thoughtful, intuitive and consumer-driven solutions.  
  
Offerings include:  
  
✔ Usability and Market Research  
✔ Usability expert consultations/Expert reviews

What types of research methodologies does Key Lime Interactive utilize in their projects?

Key Lime Interactive employs a variety of research methodologies to ensure a comprehensive understanding of user needs and behaviors. These include qualitative methods such as ethnography and moderated usability testing, as well as quantitative approaches like surveys and eye tracking. By combining these methodologies, we can provide actionable insights that inform design and strategy.

How does Key Lime Interactive ensure a human-first approach in their UX design services?

At Key Lime Interactive, we prioritize a human-first approach by deeply understanding user needs and experiences through extensive research. This includes creating user personas, journey mapping, and conducting usability tests to gather feedback directly from users. Our goal is to design products and experiences that resonate with users on a personal level, ultimately enhancing customer satisfaction and loyalty.

What industries does Key Lime Interactive serve?

Key Lime Interactive serves a diverse range of industries, including but not limited to technology, healthcare, finance, retail, and education. Our adaptable research and design methodologies allow us to tailor our services to meet the unique challenges and requirements of each industry, ensuring that our clients receive relevant and impactful insights.

Can Key Lime Interactive assist with remote user testing?

Yes, Key Lime Interactive offers remote testing services to accommodate the needs of our clients and their users. Our remote testing solutions allow us to gather valuable feedback from participants in their natural environments, providing insights that are often more reflective of real-world usage. We utilize tools like UserZoom to facilitate these tests and ensure a seamless experience for both clients and participants.

What is the process for developing user personas at Key Lime Interactive?

The development of user personas at Key Lime Interactive involves a thorough research process that includes user interviews, surveys, and data analysis. We gather qualitative and quantitative data to identify key user segments and their specific needs, goals, and pain points. This information is then synthesized into detailed personas that guide our design and strategy efforts, ensuring that we create solutions that truly resonate with users.

How does Key Lime Interactive measure the success of their UX design projects?

Key Lime Interactive measures the success of UX design projects through a combination of qualitative and quantitative metrics. We utilize tools such as usability testing, surveys, and analytics to assess user satisfaction, task completion rates, and overall engagement. Additionally, we often conduct follow-up research to gauge long-term user satisfaction and the impact of design changes on business goals.

About Thomas Szasz

Thomas Szasz was a Hungarian-American psychiatrist who made significant contributions to the field of mental health and was a controversial figure in the psychiatry community. Born in Budapest in 1920, Szasz immigrated to the United States in 1938 to escape the persecution of Jews in Hungary. He attended the University of Cincinnati and later received his medical degree from the University of Cincinnati College of Medicine. Szasz completed his psychiatric training at the University of Chicago and went on to become a professor of psychiatry at the State University of New York Upstate Medical University in Syracuse.  
  
Szasz is best known for his influential and controversial views on mental illness, particularly his critique of the concept of mental illness itself. He argued that mental illness is a myth and that the term is used as a way to control and stigmatize individuals whose behavior deviates from societal norms. Szasz believed that so-called mental illnesses are really just problems of living and should be treated as such, without the need for psychiatric intervention. He contended that labeling someone as mentally ill only serves to strip them of their autonomy and individual responsibility, and that the psychiatric system is inherently coercive and oppressive.  
  
Szasz's views on mental illness and the psychiatric system sparked debate and controversy within the field of psychiatry and beyond. Many mental health professionals and organizations rejected his ideas, arguing that mental illness is a valid medical condition that requires treatment. However, Szasz's work also garnered support and admiration from those who shared his belief in the importance of individual autonomy and personal responsibility. Regardless of one's stance on his controversial views, there is no denying that Szasz's contributions to the field of psychiatry have had a lasting impact on the way mental illness is understood and treated.  
  
In addition to his views on mental illness, Szasz also addressed the ethical and legal implications of psychiatric treatment. He was a vocal critic of involuntary psychiatric commitment and treatment, arguing that it violates the basic human rights of individuals. Szasz believed that individuals should have the right to refuse psychiatric treatment and that the use of coercive measures in psychiatry is a form of violence and oppression. He also advocated for the decriminalization of drugs and the abolition of the legal insanity defense, further challenging conventional attitudes towards mental health and the law.  
  
Szasz's work as a psychiatrist and scholar has left a lasting legacy in the field of mental health. He authored over 35 books and numerous articles, and he was a prolific lecturer and advocate for individual rights and liberties. Szasz's impact on the field of psychiatry is undeniable, as his uncompromising critique of the psychiatric system has forced professionals and society at large to critically examine the prevailing attitudes towards mental illness and the treatment of individuals who are deemed mentally ill.  
  
Overall, Thomas Szasz was a pioneering figure in the field of psychiatry who challenged the established norms and practices of the psychiatric system. His controversial views on mental illness and psychiatric treatment continue to spark debate and discussion among mental health professionals, scholars, and the general public. Regardless of one's opinion on his ideas, there is no denying the impact that Szasz has had on the way mental illness is understood and approached, and his legacy continues to influence the field of psychiatry to this day.

Mahd-e-Tage Group Company uses advanced process technologies and experienced technical staff in quality assurance and research development laboratories to provide a wide range of chemical and personal care products and detergents in domestic and export markets.  
Maintaining and improving product quality, continuous improvement of production processes and ensuring customer satisfaction is the company's strategic goals.

Behdash Chemical Co. is also the first and the only manufacturer of Zeolite in Iran.  
  
2\. Jam Partou Company  
Jam Partou Co. is a trading company provides raw materials and production equipment for Mahd-e-Tage Group Co and its subsidiary as well as other customers.  
  
3\. Behdad Chemical Company  
Behdad Chemical Company, established in 1984, is one of the biggest and oldest producers of variety of detergents, such as detergent powder, washing powder, foam, oily and normal soaps, dishwashing liquid, surface cleaners, laundry liquids, toothpaste, personal hygiene and moisturizers, in Iran. Behdad Company also manufactures variety of its own packaging items, including cardboard and bottles.  
  
4\. Pakhsh Pishgam Lia Company  
Pakhsh Pishgam Lia Co. was established in 2003. This company has 17 branches and warehouses in major cities and is responsible for distributing and selling products of Behdad Chemical

About Ad Pages Solutions
------------------------

Ad Pages was started as a direct mail magazine in Dallas, Texas in February of 1988 by our founder and current president, Bill Squiric. At the time Ad Pages had zero employees, zero capital and zero customers. Ad Pages did have, however, a wonderful idea to offer direct mail coupons within a magazine format. The goal was to create a magazine so attractive and so filled with usable coupons that readers would notice it in the mailbox and then value it enough to keep it around the house for constant use.  
  
We succeeded and the concept has worked exceptionally well. Now, 34 years later, we are mailing over 25 Million homes throughout 80+ individual DFW, Austin, San Antonio and St. Louis communities and suburban markets every year.  
  
In addition, offer many digital marketing options such as mobile coupon apps, social media marketing, mobile marketing, e-commerce solutions, website creation, SEO & SEM, targeted digital marketing campaigns, blended direct mail and online marketing campaigns, as well as a full suite of digital solutions built for SMB's.  
  
We also own and operate a large commercial printing and direct mail operation which services our own companies as well as the general business public.

About Rawle & Henderson LLP

Rawle & Henderson, LLP, is a Mid-Atlantic regional law firm with over 100 attorneys engaged in the defense of civil trial litigation. The firm is devoted to meeting the needs of the new millennium and continuing an unbroken tradition of service over three centuries. Founded in Philadelphia, PA in 1783 as the Rawle Law Offices, we have been recognized by the American Bar Association as the oldest law firm in continuous practice in the United States.  
  
Rawle & Henderson, LLP, serves clients from 11 offices: Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, Blue Bell and Harrisburg, PA; Wilmington, DE; Mt. Laurel, Hackensack, and Cherry Hill, NJ; Wheeling, WV; New York City and Long Island, NY.  
  
Rawle & Henderson, LLP, offers a wide scope of legal representation. Our clients come from nearly every industry, service and profession. Our cases range from relatively small matters handled by a single attorney to complex litigation, requiring the resources that only a major firm can provide. Our areas of practice include Appellate, Architects & Engineers, Aviation, Casualty & Premises Liability, Catastrophic Loss, Commercial Litigation, Commercial Motor Vehicle, Commercial Transactions, Construction, Employment Relations, Environmental, Mass & Toxic Torts, Immigration Law, Policy & Strategy, Insurance Coverage, Maritime, Medical Professional Liability, Product Liability, Professional Liability, and Worker's Compensation.

About Heidi Thomas

Heidi Thomas is a talented screenwriter and playwright known for her impressive body of work that spans across both television and stage. With a career that has seen her work on popular and critically acclaimed projects, she has established herself as a formidable force in the entertainment industry.  
  
Thomas gained widespread recognition for her work on the television series "Call the Midwife," which follows the lives of midwives working in the East End of London during the late 1950s and early 1960s. Her ability to capture the essence of the era and create compelling storylines has endeared her to audiences and critics alike. The show has received numerous accolades and has become a beloved staple of British television, cementing Thomas's reputation as a skilled storyteller.  
  
In addition to her work on "Call the Midwife," Thomas has also made significant contributions to the adaptation of classic literary works for the screen. She penned the screenplay for the BBC's adaptation of "Cranford," based on the novel by Elizabeth Gaskell. Her ability to adapt complex and beloved novels for television while remaining true to the source material has garnered praise from literary purists and fans of the original works.  
  
Thomas's talent for storytelling extends beyond the small screen, as she has also made a significant impact in the world of theater. Her play "The House of Special Purpose" premiered at the Chichester Festival Theatre in 2018, receiving critical acclaim for its compelling narrative and nuanced characters. The play explores the story of the Romanov family and the events leading up to the Russian Revolution, showcasing Thomas's ability to bring historical events to life on stage.  
  
One of Thomas's greatest strengths as a writer is her ability to create rich, multidimensional characters that resonate with audiences. Whether she is exploring the lives of midwives in post-war London or delving into the tumultuous history of a royal family, Thomas brings a depth of humanity to her characters that makes them relatable and compelling.  
  
Thomas's ability to tackle a diverse range of subjects and genres speaks to her versatility as a writer. She effortlessly navigates between historical dramas, adaptations of classic literature, and contemporary stories, showcasing a breadth of talent that sets her apart in the industry. Her work reflects a deep understanding of human nature and an unwavering commitment to storytelling that captivates and inspires.  
  
As a screenwriter and playwright, Heidi Thomas has left an indelible mark on the entertainment industry through her compelling storytelling, memorable characters, and ability to bring historical and literary works to life. Her work on "Call the Midwife" and other projects has garnered widespread acclaim, earning her a well-deserved reputation as a talented and versatile writer. With a career that continues to evolve and inspire, Thomas is undoubtedly a creative force to be reckoned with, and her contributions to television and theater are sure to leave a lasting impact for years to come.

About Arcus Global

We know that the public sector is special. And we’re special too.  
  
We build innovative Cloud based products that help people doing the most important jobs to do them better. Jobs that keep our streets clean, our children safe and our communities thriving.  
  
At Arcus we want to make a difference. We want to enable the public sector to use Cloud-computing in the most innovative and cost effective way, to continue to deliver and improve their vital services.  
  
We’ve got the expertise, skills and creative talent to continue to meet new challenges, always maximizing the latest technology to its maximum potential. To date, we’ve developed more than 50 products and services to cover many aspects of public sector service provision.  
  
Our staff have expert knowledge and experience in architecting, building, implementing and managing on the SalesForce platform.  
  
We offer industry leading services to help take your legacy line of business applications and on premise infrastructure and re-imagine them on technology defining platforms; connecting you more closely with your citizens.  
  
Arcus has its own Cloud based line of business offerings such as planning and development, contract management, environmental services, child care, licensing and trading standards to name a few.  
  
We align our advisory and service management operations to ITIL & Agile best practices. We are a trusted and accredited G-Cloud supplier with a proven record in helping local government improve service performance, quality and efficiency.

About SOCAN
-----------

SOCAN is a rights management organization that links more than four million creators and publishers of music and visual artists worldwide. We do this by administering legal licenses for the public performance and reproduction of their work. The money collected from these licenses is distributed as royalties to the creators and publishers who have rightfully earned them in Canada and worldwide.  
  
More than 350 employees work with SOCAN. We are a team dedicated to supporting the national and global music ecosystem through our creativity, innovation, commitment, and passion in an ever-changing music and business landscape. We have offices in Toronto, Vancouver, Montréal, and Los Angeles.  
  
We love music and visual arts and believe that the creators and publishers provide a truly priceless and essential aspect of national pride and culture. This belief permeates our work and heavily influences a workplace culture of which we are immensely proud.  
  
As we blaze trails during one of the fastest-changing times in our industry, we continue to revolutionize and modernize music monetization through state-of-the-art, innovative technology.  
  
SOCAN is Canada’s largest member-based rights management organization. We’re always looking for innovative, industrious, and creative new team members, who share our passion and commitment.  
  
Visit SOCAN.com to learn more about what we do.

About Bluebox Research
----------------------

B2B Pharmaceutical Market Research Company  
  
EXPERTS IN B2B MARKET RESEARCH  
Bluebox Research was founded in 2008 with the goal of breathing new life into the B2B market research industry. Founded just outside of Hong Kong, Bluebox Research quickly made a name for itself through providing superior market research combined with extraordinary business insights and communication of results through innovative data visualizations.  
  
Our team of researchers come from a variety of backgrounds allowing for greater synergistic insights to be drawn from each study. This variation in talent is crucial to accurate market research data interpretation in the B2B marketing space due to the dynamic macroeconomic effects of substitute and complement industries.  
  
“GARBAGE IN, GARBAGE OUT”  
At the core of each of our research studies is the phrase “Garbage In, Garbage Out”. At Bluebox Research we understand the fundamental role data quality plays in the overall integrity of the market research findings and interpretations. To ensure the integrity of our reports, we have a dedicated department of panelist quality control who use validation techniques focused on ensuring the highest quality of data possible.  
  
WHY B2B MARKET RESEARCH?  
B2B market research is typically focused more on strategic decision making rather than consumer insights. In this regard, when considering a major decision many executives, committees, and board members prefer the quantitative validation offered through proper statistical analysis of B2B research studies.  
  
Normally the cost of a B2B research study is less than 1/10th the opportunity cost associated with operating under false assumptions drawn from “gut feelings”. With such a stark cost/benefit ratio it is a wonder that decisions are ever made without the backing of a proper B2B market research study.

About Battle Creek Community Foundation
---------------------------------------

The Battle Creek Community Foundation is a public foundation built by generous residents who have donated their time, talent and treasure to make Battle Creek a better place to live. It was founded in 1974 by Leonard White, Robert B. Miller, and Harry Davidson. Their goal was to create a way for people of all means to be able to give back to their community.  
  
Over the years, the Community Foundation has received gifts from individuals, corporations and organizations. These gifts are placed in endowment funds, and these funds are then invested to generate earnings. The Community Foundation uses these earnings to distribute grants to a variety of nonprofit programs, organizations and other community-oriented charitable efforts that benefit Battle Creek residents. Funds are also created to provide scholarships to local students.  
  
The Community Foundation also provides community leadership by bringing diverse groups of individuals and organizations together to develop community-wide solutions for problems and issues.  
  
A volunteer board of local leaders, representing the interests of the Battle Creek community, governs the Community Foundation’s administration and distribution of funds. The generosity of donors, the vision of our Board of Trustees, and the dedication of our many volunteers and professional staff are what enable the Community Foundation to continually respond to the changing needs of our community.

About Independent Corrugator Inc.
---------------------------------

Independent Corrugator Inc. (ICI) is a supplier of Unique Substrates and Coatings for Graphic Packaging and Display Manufacturers.  
  
More than just a “brown box” substrate supplier, we specialize in niche products within the Corrugated Industry that our competitors often overlook or don’t have the capabilities and expertise to successfully execute.  
  
We take immense pride in our ability to properly prepare each of our clients’ requests and deliver professional, quality results with limited waste, benefitting both the customer and the environment with our paper-based products.  
  
As one of the only companies in North America supplying both N and F Flute corrugated products to the open market, our Microflute corrugated board series is a lighter material ideal for many printing methods and an excellent alternative to solid fibre for the Folding Carton Market.  
  
Our Environment Friendly Products Include:  
\- I-COAT™: Our exclusive, specially designed water-based colours and functional coatings system.  
\- I-BOARDS: A Microflute alternative to solid fibre with a narrow profile that ensures a smoother surface for cleaner, more vibrant Offset printing. In addition, a collection of Corrugated grades specifically tailored for the Large Format Digital Print Industry.  
\- I-BOARDZ: Corrugated fanfold options that maximize your space and help resolve complex shipping and storage demands.  
  
At Independent Corrugator Inc. we are a trusted partner, driven to help our clients meet evolving industry demands in the packaging industry. Contact us directly to see the difference decades of manufacturing and innovative excellence can make for your products.

Lorestan University of Medical Sciences, located in Khorramabad, Lorestan, Iran, has a rich history that dates back to the early 1980s. Today, the university comprises nine faculties, including Medicine, Nursing and Midwifery, Health and Nutrition, Paramedical Sciences, Dentistry, and Pharmacy, along with several affiliated nursing schools across the province.  
  
With a dedicated faculty of 221 members, including six full professors and 27 associate professors, the university prides itself on its academic excellence and commitment to healthcare education. More than half of the faculty members are local to the province, fostering a strong connection to the community. Currently, Lorestan University of Medical Sciences serves approximately 2,929 students across 32 academic programs, with a diverse student body comprising 64% women and 36% men.  
  
The university is not only focused on education but also plays a crucial role in healthcare services and research in the region. About Southern Ohio Copperheads
-------------------------------

Since 2002, the Southern Ohio Copperheads have been a focal point of summer entertainment in Athens, Ohio. For the past 16 seasons and counting, the Copperheads have provided families an opportunity to expose their children to the great American pastime that is baseball.  
  
The inception of the Copperheads can be traced back to the Team USA vs. Great Lakes Summer Collegiate League All-Star Game that took place on July 15th, 2001 at Bob Wren Stadium. Over 1,000 fans came out to enjoy baseball at the Wren in a “test run” to see if a summer baseball team would be viable in Athens. After the success of that game, Ohio University baseball coach Joe Carbone, Dr. Alan Geiger, and Dr. Andrew Kreutzer of the Ohio Sports Management Department believed that Southern Ohio could support a GLSCL team.    
  
A steering committee was organized including leaders from the University and from Southeast Ohio’s business communities. After three months of planning, the GLSCL gave the approval to go ahead with the Southern Ohio baseball team based in Athens.    
  
All that was needed was a team name.  The new Board of Directors held a two-week contest throughout all the local elementary schools located in Southeast Ohio to decide what the team name would be.  “Copperheads” beat out “Flying Squirrels” among other choices to become the name of the GLSCL baseball team in Athens. Local artist Tad Gallagher designed the team’s logo.   
  
Over the next few seasons, the Copperheads won over the hearts of the people of Southeast Ohio, combining family-friendly entertainment with great baseball. We are #CommunityOwnedStudentOperated and strive to create incredible memories at the ballpark for all of Southeast Ohio.

About Hudson Guild
------------------

Now celebrating its 125th anniversary, Hudson Guild was founded as a settlement house to serve the needs of the growing immigrant population in the then industrial neighborhood of Chelsea. Today Hudson Guild is an anchor institution in a vibrant multicultural community, which has expanded to 17 service locations in Chelsea, Hell’s Kitchen, and Lincoln Square. Our mission is to create and sustain a strong, effective community that acknowledges and responds to the potential, achievements, and interdependence of its diverse members. Rooted in and primarily focused on the Chelsea neighborhood, we seek to empower all individuals and families to achieve their highest potential, while maintaining a priority focus on those in economic need.  
  
Hudson Guild offers six dynamic programs to 14,000 people annually. These include:  
  
Arts Programs-Hudson Guild provides opportunities for everyone in our community to explore their interests in performing and visual arts, both as active participants and new audience members.  
  
Adult Services-Hudson Guild’s Adult Services program helps older adults age “55 & better” live in independence and with dignity as contributing members of the community.  
  
Community Building-Hudson Guild serves a primary role in making the Chelsea neighborhood a place where people come together to help others and themselves through education, skills-building, and joint action.  
  
Early Childhood Education-Our nurturing environment fosters independence in children, promoting the development of school readiness and social-emotional skills.  
  
Mental Health-Hudson Guild provides a broad array of mental health prevention and intervention services, in our own facilities and out in the community.  
  
Youth Development & Education-Young people, ages 5-24, attend Hudson Guild for academic achievement, life skills development, college and career training, employment experience, recreation, and social/emotional support.

What types of health information technology solutions does CNSI offer?

CNSI provides a comprehensive range of health information technology solutions tailored to meet the needs of state and federal agencies. We focus on delivering innovative and high-quality products that enhance healthcare delivery and improve patient outcomes.

How does CNSI support government agencies in managing Medicaid programs?

CNSI specializes in Medicaid solutions that streamline program management and enhance service delivery. We offer customizable MMIS that help agencies manage claims processing, provider enrollment, and eligibility determination efficiently. Our solutions are designed to comply with federal regulations while providing robust reporting and analytics capabilities to support decision-making and improve program outcomes.

Can CNSI assist with consumer engagement in healthcare?

Yes, CNSI provides consumer engagement solutions that empower patients and healthcare providers to communicate effectively. Our platforms facilitate access to health information, enable appointment scheduling, and support personalized care management. By leveraging technology, we enhance patient involvement in their healthcare journey, leading to better health outcomes and increased satisfaction.

What industries does CNSI serve beyond healthcare?

Our expertise in telecommunications infrastructure and enterprise mobility solutions allows us to support a diverse range of state and federal agencies. We are committed to delivering innovative technology solutions that address the unique challenges faced by different industries.

How does CNSI utilize predictive analytics in its solutions?

CNSI integrates predictive analytics into our health IT solutions to help agencies make data-driven decisions. By analyzing historical data trends, we provide insights that can predict patient needs, optimize resource allocation, and improve program effectiveness. Our predictive analytics tools enable agencies to proactively address potential issues, enhancing overall healthcare delivery.

What is CNSI's approach to identity and access management (IAM)?

CNSI's identity and access management solutions are designed to ensure secure access to sensitive health information while maintaining compliance with regulatory standards. Our IAM services include user authentication, role-based access control, and audit trails to monitor access activities. We prioritize data security and privacy, helping agencies protect patient information and maintain trust in their systems.

What types of services does Chiropractic Economics provide?

How can Chiropractic Economics help me grow my chiropractic practice?

Chiropractic Economics stays updated on industry trends through a combination of research, expert contributions, and feedback from practitioners. Project Centre, part of Marston Holdings, is a leading design, engineering and landscape architecture consultancy that is passionate about designing places for the people that use them. We have offices in London, Manchester, Ashford, Slough, Edinburgh and Brighton.  
  
Our approach to integrated design produces award winning results that have won international recognition. We have been very successful in winning major industry awards with our clients for road safety, public realm regeneration and sustainability.

Recognising that our strength is the people we employ Project Centre is committed to equality of opportunity and employment, providing a workplace free of discrimination – we are also an Investors in People Champion. We welcome individuals on all career levels seeking to join Project Centre in the near future!  
  
Project Centre is part of the NSL group of companies that employs over 5,000 people worldwide.

The Finance Department manages the financial operations of the City of Sedalia. Across all budgets and funds, the city spends in excess of $25 million a budget year and the Finance Director is responsible for accounting for those funds in a manner consistent with generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP).  
  
The Department is responsible for daily management of all financial services including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, investing city funds and preparing financial statements for City Council and public record. The Finance Department processes payment of invoices and issues checks for all 15 departments, accounts for all revenue received by the city and processes payroll and issues checks for the city's 200 full-time and approximately 75 part-time and seasonal employees.  
  
The Finance Department includes the collections and licensing function of City government and Sedalia's Municipal Court office.

About Anthony Fantanos

Anthony Fantano is a prominent American music critic and YouTuber known for his engaging and insightful content. With over 2.2 million subscribers on his main channel, The Needle Drop, Fantano has become a widely respected voice in the music industry. His candid reviews and in-depth analyses of albums, songs, and music trends have garnered him a loyal fanbase and solidified his reputation as a tastemaker in the music world.  
  
Fantano's journey to becoming a renowned music critic began in the late 2000s when he started posting reviews on YouTube. His honest and straightforward approach to critiquing music quickly gained traction, and before long, he had amassed a sizable following. What sets Fantano apart from other music critics is his ability to articulate his opinions on a wide range of genres, from hip-hop and rock to electronic and experimental music. His willingness to explore and deconstruct various styles of music has made him a trusted source for music enthusiasts looking to discover new artists and expand their musical horizons.  
  
One of the key elements that contribute to Fantano's success is his dedication to providing fair and well-informed critiques. Whether he's dissecting an underground hip-hop release or a chart-topping pop album, Fantano always offers a balanced assessment, highlighting both the strengths and weaknesses of the music at hand. This approach has earned him the respect of both fans and artists alike, as they appreciate his commitment to giving each piece of music a fair shake, regardless of its popularity or reputation.  
  
In addition to his reviews, Fantano also creates a variety of other content, including interviews, discussions, and video essays on music-related topics. He often delves into subjects such as the evolution of certain genres, the impact of technology on the music industry, and the cultural significance of specific artists or movements. Through these videos, Fantano showcases his deep knowledge of music history and his ability to analyze complex trends in the industry, further solidifying his position as a thought leader in the music community.  
  
Beyond his work on YouTube, Fantano has expanded his reach through various other platforms, including podcasting and social media. On his podcast, The Needle Drop, he engages in long-form discussions with fellow music enthusiasts, covering a wide array of topics related to music and pop culture. Additionally, Fantano uses platforms like Twitter and Instagram to interact with his audience, share updates on his latest projects, and offer his thoughts on current music news.  
  
Ultimately, Anthony Fantano has established himself as a pivotal figure in the music criticism landscape, using his platform to champion diverse voices and push for greater inclusivity within the industry. His willingness to engage with a wide range of musical styles and his dedication to offering fair and insightful critiques have earned him the respect of both fans and artists alike. As he continues to evolve and expand his reach, there's no doubt that Fantano will remain a significant force in shaping the conversation around music for years to come.

About Корпорация «Проект-техника»
---------------------------------

«Проект-техника» — один из глобальных лидеров по разработке и производству решений в области мобильной инфраструктуры специального назначения.  
  
Основными активами Корпорации являются Инженерный центр, заводы по производству мобильной техники (Шумерлинский завод специализированных автомобилей, Орелтекмаш), Центр сервисных решений, завод по производству электротехники (Проектэлектротехника).  
  
Коллектив Корпорации — 2500 сотрудников, работающих в 7 городах европейской части России.  
  
Сложность продукции варьируется от контейнеров, поставляемых для дальнейшей комплектации, до полнофункциональных мобильных сервисных центров, полевых лагерей, полевых медицинских и штабных комплексов со всей необходимой инфраструктурой (жизнеобеспечение, энергетика, связь).  
  
Продукция представлена в 21 стране мира как самостоятельные изделия и комплексы, либо в составе комплексов противовоздушной обороны и радиоэлектронной борьбы. Также она включена в список изделий государственной программы вооружения РФ до 2020 года.  
  
По отдельным видам инициативно разработанных изделий Корпорация является единственным поставщиком Министерства Обороны РФ.

About Angel Shed Theatre Company
--------------------------------

Angel Shed Theatre Company is a charity supported solely by sponsorship and donation, and the only truly inclusive theatre company in Islington. We run theatre workshops and stage performances that bring together children and young people aged 7-16 from all parts of the community whatever their social or educational background. Our inclusive approach sets us apart. We believe in giving every child, regardless of their educational or physical needs, or their socio-economic, religious or ethnic backgrounds, the chance to be involved in the performing arts. We give children and young people – who otherwise might not have had the opportunity to do so – the chance to explore a whole new, rich, exciting and safe creative world. In the process they grow in confidence and develop respect for themselves and each other. They also develop the ability to engage with the performing arts in a variety of different ways. We began life in September 2004 as part of the initiative of renowned theatre company, Chickenshed, to create a network of independent ‘sheds’ working with their inclusive methods. Since then we’ve continued to grow and develop to become an established inclusive theatre workshop provider in Islington. We retain links with Chickenshed, who provide training opportunities for our volunteers, advice and a communications network with other sheds. We remain, however, financially and artistically independent.

------------------------

Miracle Foundation is an international nonprofit that helps orphans and foster children find a safe, stable, and permanent family. Whether in an orphanage or in the Foster Care System, our mission is a family for every child in our lifetime.  
  
For the past 22 years, Miracle Foundation has improved the lives of more than 164,000 children—but this is just the beginning. Today, we are a worldwide leader ending the need for orphanages by 2040. To achieve this, we are actively uniting children with families, we are educating the social work force to prevent children from entering the system, and we are creating technology to easily scale our work.  
  
Founded in 2000, Miracle Foundation has earned the highest rating by Charity Navigator, an organization that evaluates charities for effectiveness and financial transparency.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Miracle Foundation

Who is the CEO of Miracle Foundation?

Kusum Mohapatra is the CEO of Miracle Foundation. To contact Kusum Mohapatra email at [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)
 or [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)
.

Who are the decision makers in Miracle Foundation?

The decision makers in Miracle Foundation are Anne Broyles, Arghya Mukherjee, Aruna Krishnan, etc. Click to Find [Miracle Foundation decision makers emails](https://contactout.com/dashboard/search?company=Miracle%20Foundation&seniority=founder%7Cc_suite%7Cvice_president%7Cowner%7Cdirector)
.

What services does Miracle Foundation provide to support orphans and foster children?

Miracle Foundation offers a range of services aimed at improving the lives of orphans and foster children. These include family-based care programs that help children find permanent homes, life skills education to prepare them for independent living, and caregiver training to ensure that foster parents and caregivers are equipped to provide nurturing environments. Additionally, the organization focuses on child protection and rights, ensuring that every child has access to a safe and supportive environment.

How does Miracle Foundation measure the impact of its programs?

Miracle Foundation employs a comprehensive approach to measuring impact, which includes both qualitative and quantitative assessments. The organization collects data on key performance indicators such as the number of children placed in permanent homes, improvements in emotional and psychological well-being, and educational achievements. Regular feedback from children, families, and caregivers is also gathered to refine programs and ensure they meet the needs of those they serve.

What is the importance of life skills education for children in foster care?

Life skills education is crucial for children in foster care as it equips them with the necessary tools to navigate adulthood successfully. This education covers essential skills such as financial literacy, communication, problem-solving, and self-care. By providing these skills, Miracle Foundation aims to empower children to become independent, confident adults who can thrive in society, reducing the risk of homelessness and unemployment.

How can I get involved with Miracle Foundation as a volunteer or donor?

There are multiple ways to get involved with Miracle Foundation, whether through volunteering or donating. Volunteers can participate in various programs, including tutoring, mentoring, and organizing community events. Donors can contribute financially or provide in-kind donations to support specific programs. To learn more about opportunities, visit the 'Get Involved' section on the Miracle Foundation website, where you can find detailed information on how to make a difference.

What types of training does Miracle Foundation provide for caregivers?

Miracle Foundation offers specialized training programs for caregivers that focus on best practices in child care, emotional support, and developmental needs. These training sessions cover topics such as attachment theory, trauma-informed care, and effective communication strategies. The goal is to equip caregivers with the knowledge and skills necessary to create a nurturing and stable environment for children in their care.

What is family-based care, and why is it important for children in the foster care system?

Family-based care refers to the practice of placing children in a family environment rather than in institutional settings. This approach is important because it provides children with the emotional support, stability, and sense of belonging that they need for healthy development. Miracle Foundation advocates for family-based care as it has been shown to lead to better outcomes in terms of mental health, education, and overall well-being for children in the foster care system.

About Community Action Commission of Santa Barbara County
---------------------------------------------------------

Community Action Commission of Santa Barbara County is now CommUnify. With this new identity comes a refreshed strategic plan that allows us to further our commitment to UNIFY the whole COMMUNITY to address inequalities.  
  
CommUnify is a nonprofit organization that works collaboratively with the community to find innovative solutions to assist Santa Barbara County residents in living healthy, resilient and financially secure lives. We offer a variety of education and support services aimed at promoting the independence of individuals of all ages.  
  
CommUnify:  
• Assists over 12,000 individuals in Santa Barbara County each year  
• Operates 24 Head Start and Early Head Start Centers  
• Serves over 350,000 healthy meals to low-income children and seniors annually  
• Provides utility assistance services to over 1400 low-income households per year  
• Provides mentorship to over 5500 youth and young adults  
• Operates Santa Barbara County's 2-1-1 Health & Human Services Resource Helpline (www.211sbco.org)  
• & much more!  
  
Learn more at: www.CommUnifySB.org  
  
Our Mission:  
In partnership with the community, we provide education and supportive services to residents of Santa Barbara County resulting in improved economic security and self-sufficiency.

About Vox Magazine
------------------

Vox blends Columbia’s urban mentality and hometown familiarity into a smart, small-city tabloid. We profile the human condition, expose local culture and provide reviews, tips and trends that tell our readers what’s happening and where to be. Every week we keep an ear to the underground and an eye out for the unique to bring you an analysis and reflection of contemporary issues. Vox is something new, something useful, something provocative.  
  
Vox began in the spring of 1998 when the Columbia Missourian merged its two weeklies, Weekend, an entertainment magazine, and Ideas, the Sunday magazine. Since its inception, Vox has aimed to be a print version of that really cool friend of yours, the one who always knows what’s going on, can provide an intelligent viewpoint on any number of subjects, has a way with words that’s a combination between being snarky and knowing something, and is fun to hang with. Our lofty goals are outlined in our mission statement below.  
  
The magazine is published by the Columbia Missourian and produced by magazine students at the world’s oldest (and we’d like to think best) journalism school. Don’t worry, it’s much more than some college newspaper. And we have faculty supervise us. Really. The magazine has won numerous awards, including the prestigious General Excellence award given by the Association for Education in Journalism and Mass Communications. In other words, Vox was named the best magazine produced by college students in the whole darn country. We also believe it is the only weekly magazine in the country produced by a staff that totally changes three times a year. Some think this is a challenge. We like to see it as a good thing — we never get stale or boring.

Our system automates calculations for wages, taxes, and deductions, reducing the risk of human error. Additionally, our team of payroll experts conducts regular audits and stays updated on tax regulations to ensure compliance and accuracy in every payroll cycle.

Can Paymedia help with time and attendance tracking?

Yes, Paymedia provides robust time and attendance tracking solutions that integrate seamlessly with our payroll system. Our tools allow businesses to monitor employee hours, manage schedules, and track attendance in real-time. This helps organizations improve workforce productivity and ensures accurate payroll processing based on actual hours worked.

What benefits management services does Paymedia provide?

Paymedia offers comprehensive benefits management services that include administration of employee benefits programs, enrollment support, compliance management, and employee communication. We help businesses navigate the complexities of benefits offerings, ensuring that employees receive the support they need while helping employers maintain compliance with regulations.

How can I get started with Paymedia's services?

Getting started with Paymedia is easy! Simply visit our website and fill out the contact form, or call our customer service team. We will schedule a consultation to understand your business needs and provide a tailored solution that fits your requirements. Our team will guide you through the onboarding process to ensure a smooth transition to our services.

About IMAC Systems, Inc.
------------------------

IMAC Systems Inc., has been providing products and services to the gas measurement and precision machining industry since its establishment in 1978. IMAC Systems, Inc. specializes in natural gas including: measurement, transmission, regulation and conditioning. IMAC Systems, Inc. offers a variety of products and services.  
  
As a master distributor and representative for several leading manufacturers of measurement and control products including Romet, Peterson Equipment, ScottCan, UNASCO, Badger Meter, Elster, American Meter, Elster-Amco Water Meters, and USI Valves, IMAC Systems, Inc. offers in-stock products to guarantee a fast delivery.  
  
As a manufacturer IMAC Systems, Inc. specializes in high quality products to meet the needs of natural gas users. IMAC Systems, Inc. has manufactured products since its establishment including: Pulsimatic Transmitter (retrofitting pulse outputs to gas meters), MCS Pop-Relief Valve (token style relief valve), Filter-Dryers (high pressure filters, with desiccant), Aluminum Vents, Strainers (Gasket & 'T'), Odorant Exhaust Filters, Barlow Pipeline Products (pipeline monolithic insulators and surge arrestors), VLP - Vent Line Protection Device (to protect vent lines from floods), high pressure stainless steel filters, and more. IMAC Systems, Inc. is always looking for special projects and customization.  
  
As a service provider IMAC Systems, Inc. specializes in repair and calibration of gas meters and gas volume correctors.

What types of services does IMAC Systems, Inc. offer in the natural gas industry?

IMAC Systems, Inc. specializes in a range of services tailored to the natural gas industry, including natural gas transmission, measurement, conditioning, and filtration. Our solutions are designed to ensure accurate measurement and efficient transmission of natural gas, while our conditioning and filtration services help maintain the quality and safety of gas products.

How does IMAC Systems ensure the accuracy of natural gas measurement?

IMAC Systems employs advanced technology and industry best practices to ensure the accuracy of natural gas measurement. We utilize high-quality measurement equipment and regularly calibrate our systems to meet industry standards. Our team of experts also conducts thorough testing and validation processes to guarantee that all measurements are precise and reliable.

What industries does IMAC Systems serve?

IMAC Systems primarily serves the natural gas industry, including companies involved in gas transmission, distribution, and processing. Our solutions are also applicable to related sectors that require precision machining and gas measurement technologies, ensuring that we can meet the diverse needs of our clients across various applications.

Can IMAC Systems provide custom solutions for specific gas measurement needs?

Yes, IMAC Systems is committed to providing tailored solutions that meet the unique requirements of our clients. We work closely with customers to understand their specific challenges and develop custom gas measurement and conditioning systems that enhance efficiency and accuracy in their operations.

What is the importance of natural gas conditioning and filtration?

Natural gas conditioning and filtration are crucial for maintaining the quality and safety of gas products. Conditioning processes help remove impurities and contaminants that can affect the performance of gas systems, while filtration ensures that only clean gas is transmitted. This not only protects equipment but also enhances the overall efficiency and reliability of gas operations.

How can I contact IMAC Systems for support or inquiries?

You can contact IMAC Systems through our website's contact form, or by calling our customer service hotline. Our team is available to assist you with any inquiries regarding our products and services, and we are committed to providing timely and effective support to all our clients.

Cambridge 105 Radio is the Community Radio station for the City of Cambridge.

During the day we broadcast a mix of music, news and information from our Gwydir Street studios. In the evening and across the weekend we open a window on the city. There’s specialist music shows covering indie, folk, rock and country with an emphasis on Cambridge artists and live performance. You’ll also hear a wide range of feature programmes on topics including film, books, food & drink and the arts.  
  
Cambridge 105 Radio is regulated by Ofcom.  
  
Cambridge 105 Radio is a voluntary, not-for-profit organisation, registered as a “Limited by Guarantee” company. Whilst we are not a registered charity, we operate with charitable aims and are recognised as doing so by the Cambridgeshire Community Foundation.  
  
We’re funded by a mix of advertising and member donations.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Senior Services Associates, inc,

Who are the decision makers in Senior Services Associates?

The decision makers in Senior Services Associates are Amy Zavala, Bette Schoenholtz, Brigette Roehr, etc. Click to Find [Senior Services Associates decision makers emails](https://contactout.com/dashboard/search?company=Senior%20Services%20Associates&seniority=founder%7Cc_suite%7Cvice_president%7Cowner%7Cdirector)
.

What types of services does Senior Services Associates offer for seniors?

Senior Services Associates provides a wide range of services tailored to meet the needs of seniors, including transportation assistance, case management, home-delivered meals, and a senior companion program. We also offer volunteer opportunities, activities for social engagement, and home repair assistance to ensure seniors can live safely and comfortably in their own homes.

How can I access transportation services for seniors?

To access transportation services, seniors or their caregivers can contact Senior Services Associates directly. We provide transportation for medical appointments, grocery shopping, and other essential errands. Our team will guide you through the process of scheduling a ride and inform you of any eligibility requirements or fees associated with the service.

What is the Senior Companion Program and how does it work?

The Senior Companion Program connects seniors with trained volunteers who provide companionship and assistance with daily activities. This program aims to reduce isolation and improve the quality of life for seniors. Interested individuals can apply to either become a senior companion or to receive companionship services. Our team will conduct an assessment to match companions with seniors based on their needs and preferences.

Are there any costs associated with the services provided by Senior Services Associates?

Many of the services offered by Senior Services Associates are free or offered at a low cost, especially for those who meet certain income criteria. However, some services, like home-delivered meals or transportation, may have nominal fees. We encourage seniors and their families to reach out to us for detailed information on costs and available financial assistance options.

How can I volunteer with Senior Services Associates?

Volunteering with Senior Services Associates is a rewarding way to give back to the community. We welcome individuals who are interested in helping seniors through various roles, including transportation, companionship, and organizing activities. Interested volunteers can fill out a volunteer application on our website or contact us directly to learn more about current opportunities and the application process.

What types of activities does Senior Services Associates offer for seniors?

Senior Services Associates organizes a variety of activities designed to promote social interaction and engagement among seniors. These activities may include exercise classes, arts and crafts, educational workshops, and social events. We aim to create a welcoming environment where seniors can connect with peers and participate in enriching experiences. A schedule of upcoming activities can be found on our website or by contacting our office.

WE KNOW SEARCH  
  
At Homrich, Klein & Associates we know a search is about more than just the job or candidate requirements. In the end, a resume or job description are just words on paper-they can’t tell you what you need to know to connect a person or opportunity. That’s where we come in!  
  
Homrich, Klein & Associates is a specialized, consultative boutique firm with a personalized approach. We want to know what matters to you. As an individual evaluating your next opportunity what are your hot buttons? Is it the corporate culture? Location? Quality of life? About IPC Europe (European Independent Purchasing Company Limited)
------------------------------------------------------------------

IPC Europe, officially known as IPC EMEA (European Independent Purchasing Company Limited), was established in 2001 with the mission of empowering Subway Franchisees to maximize their purchasing power. By leveraging collective buying strength, IPC Europe enables its members to access significant discounts on a wide range of products and services, enhancing profitability and operational efficiency. Headquartered in High Wycombe, Bucks, the organization has evolved alongside the Subway brand, expanding its geographic reach and service offerings to meet the dynamic needs of Franchisees across Europe.  
  
IPC Europe specializes in procurement and supply chain management, focusing on delivering high-quality food and non-food products essential for the fast-food industry. The company’s extensive portfolio includes everything from fresh ingredients and packaging solutions to equipment and maintenance supplies. By employing advanced procurement strategies and technologies, IPC Europe ensures that Franchisees benefit from competitive pricing and reliable supply chains, ultimately driving value and quality in their operations.  
  
In addition to traditional purchasing services, IPC Europe is committed to fostering innovation within the industry. The organization actively explores new technologies and sustainable practices to enhance product offerings and streamline operations for its members. By staying attuned to market trends and Franchisee feedback, IPC Europe continues to adapt and grow, solidifying its role as a vital partner in the success of Subway Franchisees throughout the EMEA region. With a focus on collaboration and efficiency, IPC Europe remains dedicated to delivering exceptional value and support to its members in an ever-evolving marketplace.
