What types of children's books does Educational Development Corporation (EDC) publish?

Educational Development Corporation specializes in a wide range of children's books, including picture books, early readers, chapter books, and educational materials. Their offerings are designed to engage young readers and support literacy development, with a focus on high-quality illustrations and age-appropriate content.

How can I purchase books from EDC?

Books from Educational Development Corporation can be purchased through their direct sales representatives, at various events, and online through their official website. Additionally, EDC partners with independent consultants who can assist you in selecting the right books for your needs and provide personalized recommendations.

Does EDC offer any educational resources or programs for schools and educators?

Yes, EDC provides a variety of educational resources and programs tailored for schools and educators. These include book fairs, reading programs, and curriculum-aligned materials designed to enhance classroom learning and promote a love of reading among students.

What industries does EDC serve beyond individual consumers?

In addition to serving individual consumers, Educational Development Corporation supports various industries including education, childcare, and retail. Their products are utilized in schools, libraries, and daycare centers, as well as being sold through independent consultants and at community events.

How does EDC ensure the quality and appropriateness of its children's books?

EDC is committed to publishing high-quality children's books by employing a rigorous selection process for manuscripts and illustrations. They collaborate with experienced authors and illustrators, and their editorial team reviews each title to ensure it meets educational standards and is suitable for the target age group.

Can I become a consultant for EDC and sell their books?

Yes, Educational Development Corporation offers opportunities for individuals to become independent consultants. As a consultant, you can sell EDC's books through direct sales, host book parties, and participate in community events. Interested individuals can find more information about becoming a consultant on EDC's website.

About WAVY-TV
-------------

WAVY-TV, Channel 10, signed on the air September 1, 1957, as the NBC affiliate in Hampton Roads, Virginia. Originally started by Tidewater Teleradio as an offshoot to their radio station, WAVY-AM (now known as WGH-AM), WAVY-TV was purchased in 1968 by LIN Broadcasting, Inc.  
  
On December 19, 2014, Media General closed on its business combination with LIN, creating one of the nation’s largest multimedia companies. Media General operates 71 television stations in 48 markets, along with the industry’s leading digital media business.  
  
Since its inception, WAVY-TV has set the standard in Hampton Roads television. It was the first local station to broadcast in “living color” (1957); the first to utilize a helicopter in its news gathering activities (1982); and the first to broadcast in stereo (1985). WAVY-DT signed on March 22, 2001: the first digital station in Hampton Roads! In 2008, we began broadcasting in High Definition – proving again that we are in the forefront in the industry.  
  
WAVY-TV also leads the way in local News broadcasts. It was the first local station to offer 90 minutes of local evening news (1994); the first to broadcast a 5:00 AM and 5:30 AM newscast (1992); and the first to offer a Saturday Morning newscast (1995).  
  
In 1995, WAVY-TV entered into a local marketing agreement with Hampton Roads’ independent station, WVBT (now also known as FOX 43). On January 31, 2002, LIN Television purchased FOX 43.  
  
WAVY and FOX 43’s Online Component  
  
WAVY.com is Hampton Roads’ #1 TV website, known and respected for breaking news, weather sports, and streaming video. The site serves as the interactive portal for The Hampton Roads Show with live streaming and online chat. WAVY.com is 10 On Your Side, 24/7. WAVY.com is a powerhouse in digital media on multiple platforms: mobile, social media networks, blogging, email and text alerts.  
  
FOX43TV.com is Hampton Roads’ website for both local and national entertainment news.

Hy-Vee is on a mission to make customers’ lives easier, healthier and happier in our more than 250 locations around the Midwest. As an employee-owned company, Hy-Vee offers a culture of autonomy, service, entrepreneurship, ownership, agility, passion and pride. With annual sales of more than $10 billion, Hy-Vee has been honored by national and trade media for its commitment to innovation, technology and customer service.  
Hy-Vee employees work in areas as varied as produce merchandising to television production, all while never losing their focus on providing a helpful smile – whether in the aisles or beyond. Visit hy-vee.com to learn more about our operations, which include distribution centers in Chariton, Iowa; Cherokee, Iowa; and Ankeny, Iowa, as well as a financial company and a specialty pharmacy. What types of filtration solutions does Pall Industrial offer?

Pall Industrial provides a wide range of filtration solutions tailored to various industries. These include liquid and gas filtration systems, membrane filtration, and depth filtration technologies. Specific applications include oil and gas filtration, chemical processing, and power generation.

How does Pall Industrial support the oil and gas industry?

Pall Industrial offers specialized filtration and separation solutions for the oil and gas industry, focusing on upstream, midstream, and downstream applications. Our products help in the removal of particulates, water, and other contaminants from crude oil and natural gas. We also provide fluid management solutions that enhance operational efficiency and reduce downtime, ensuring that our clients can maintain high productivity levels while adhering to environmental regulations.

Can Pall Industrial assist with fluid condition monitoring?

Yes, Pall Industrial provides advanced fluid condition monitoring solutions that help industries maintain the integrity and performance of their fluids. This proactive approach minimizes equipment wear and extends the lifespan of critical components, ultimately leading to cost savings and improved operational efficiency.

What industries can benefit from Pall's purification technologies?

By utilizing our purification technologies, companies can enhance product quality, reduce waste, and improve overall process efficiency.

Does Pall Industrial provide OEM filtration solutions?

We work closely with OEMs to develop solutions that enhance the performance and reliability of their products, ensuring that they meet the demands of their end-users.

How can I get technical support for Pall Industrial products?

About American Arbitration Association
--------------------------------------

The American Arbitration Association® (AAA®), with its long history and experience in the field of alternative dispute resolution, provides services to individuals and organizations who wish to resolve conflicts out of court.  
  
The AAA role in the dispute resolution process is to administer cases, from filing to closing. The AAA provides administrative services in the U.S., as well as abroad through its International Centre for Dispute Resolution® (ICDR®). The AAA's and ICDR's administrative services include assisting in the appointment of mediators and arbitrators, setting hearings, and providing users with information on dispute resolution options, including settlement through mediation. Ultimately, the AAA aims to move cases through arbitration or mediation in a fair and impartial manner until completion.  
  
Additional AAA services include the design and development of alternative dispute resolution (ADR) systems for corporations, unions, government agencies, law firms, and the courts. The Association also provides elections services as well as education, training, and publications for those seeking a broader or deeper understanding of alternative dispute resolution.

Dan Humphrey, as Co-Founder and Director of Employer Engagement at Communities At Work, is at the forefront of a transformative movement dedicated to bridging the gap between community needs and employer demands. His expertise in talent acquisition and strategic planning enables him to effectively identify and cultivate partnerships with local employers, ensuring that they not only meet their workforce needs but also contribute to the community's economic vitality.  
  
At Communities At Work, Dan leads key projects aimed at creating pathways to living wage careers for at-risk young adults, veterans, individuals with disabilities, and those in chronic poverty. His innovative approach to employer engagement emphasizes the importance of understanding the unique challenges faced by these populations, allowing him to tailor recruitment strategies that resonate with both job seekers and employers. By leveraging his skills in brand development and marketing, Dan effectively promotes the value of inclusive hiring practices, fostering a culture of collaboration among stakeholders.  
  
Dan's commitment to process improvement and negotiation has resulted in the successful implementation of programs that not only enhance workforce readiness but also drive meaningful change within the community. His vision for Communities At Work is rooted in the belief that by connecting people with opportunities, he can create a ripple effect that uplifts entire communities, making a lasting impact on the lives of those he serves.

About Riddhi Parekh

Riddhi Parekh is a dedicated Manufacturing Engineer at Zimmer Biomet, where she leverages her robust background in Biomedical Engineering, particularly in Electronics and Instrumentation, to drive innovation and quality in the manufacturing of medical devices. With a keen focus on compliance, Riddhi plays a pivotal role in reviewing and approving design control drawings (DOE) and mechanical drawings, ensuring they meet stringent EU-MDR, ISO, and FDA standards, as well as Zimmer's own SMS standards and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). Her expertise in Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) according to ASME standards is crucial for the precise laser marking of various in-vitro class-III instruments, which are vital for patient safety and efficacy.  
  
Certified as a Lean Six-Sigma Green Belt, Riddhi is adept at applying Lean Manufacturing principles to streamline processes, reduce waste, and enhance product quality. Her proficiency in statistical analysis tools such as Minitab and MATLAB allows her to conduct thorough risk analysis and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), ensuring that potential issues are identified and mitigated early in the product lifecycle. Additionally, her knowledge of ISO 13485 standards and quality control methodologies positions her as a key contributor to Zimmer Biomet's commitment to excellence in medical device manufacturing.  
  
Currently, Riddhi is involved in several high-impact projects that focus on optimizing manufacturing processes and improving product reliability. Her analytical skills, combined with her hands-on experience in clinical data management and testing and validation, enable her to contribute significantly to the development of innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of the healthcare industry. Riddhi's passion for advancing medical technology is evident in her work, as she continuously seeks to enhance operational efficiencies while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance.

The Center for Law, Brain and Behavior (CLBB) at Massachusetts General Hospital promotes the sound translation of brain-based and behavioral science into law, finance, and public policy.  
  
The Center for Law, Brain and Behavior engages the brightest researchers across many disciplines to work collaboratively on problems that arise at the intersection of science, law, and public policy. By virtue of its location within the Massachusetts General Hospital Department of Psychiatry, the Center draws upon a unique depth of clinical and research expertise in psychiatry, neurology and neuroscience. CLBB has established a vibrant community of investigators with rich collaborations across many disciplines, including leading scientists and legal scholars from the Harvard Department of Psychology, Harvard Law School and Harvard Medical School. We are guided by a board of advisors uniquely talented in finance, law, academia, politics, media, and biotechnology. Our influence occurs through academic research and publications, educational outreach, media campaigns, informing decision-makers, and training future leaders.  
  
Visit us at www.clbb.org, and follow us on Twitter (@MGHCLBB) and Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/MGHCLBB).

About Kymera Therapeutics
-------------------------

Kymera is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering and developing novel small molecule therapeutics that selectively degrade disease-causing proteins by harnessing the body’s own natural protein degradation system. Kymera’s proprietary targeted protein degradation platform, called Pegasus, enables us to discover highly selective small molecule protein degraders with activity against disease-causing proteins throughout the body. We believe that our small molecule protein degraders have significant advantages over existing therapies and allow us to address a large portion of the human genome that was previously intractable with traditional modalities. Kymera focuses on biological pathways that have been clinically validated but where key biological nodes/proteins have not been drugged or have been inadequately drugged. To date, we have utilized our Pegasus platform to design novel protein degraders focused in the areas of immunology-inflammation and oncology, and continue to apply our platform’s capabilities to additional therapeutic areas. Learn more at www.kymeratx.com

Noble Royalties, Inc. specializes in the acquisition and management of oil and gas royalties, mineral interests, and overriding royalty interests (ORRI). About Congressional Hispanic Caucus Institute
---------------------------------------------

In 1978, a small group of Hispanic members of Congress established the Congressional Hispanic Caucus Institute (CHCI) to develop the next generation of Latino leaders with a clear vision of a strong America made possible with the many contributions of educated and civic-minded Latino leaders engaged in and contributing to all aspects of U.S. society. This vision was founded on three cornerstones for success: education attainment and college access, leadership development programs in D.C., and access to a powerful network of Latino leaders in the United States.  
  
Today CHCI is the premier Hispanic nonprofit and nonpartisan 501(c)(3) leadership development organization in the country firmly rooted in the same three mission cornerstones laid by our founders:  
  
Educate. Empower. Connect.  
  
By promoting education attainment and college access, providing unmatched career development experience, and offering award-winning leadership programs that connect program participants to the most powerful network of U.S. leaders, CHCI’s mission is unwavering and more powerful and critical than ever before in our nation’s history. The success of our more than 11,800 young Latinos served across the country, will determine the nation’s success in this century.  
  
With its comprehensive approach to leadership development, CHCI directly impacts the lives of over 1,700 students and young professionals each year through its fellowships, congressional internships, scholarships, Ready to Lead (R2L®) college readiness program, and R2L NextGen program, a dramatic increase from the 46 students served in 1999.

Who is the CEO of Congressional Hispanic Caucus Institute (CHCI)?

Who are the decision makers in Congressional Hispanic Caucus Institute (CHCI)?

The decision makers in Congressional Hispanic Caucus Institute (CHCI) are Aly Mennuti, Caroline Gonzalez Scott, Caroline Gonzalez Scott, etc. Click to Find [Congressional Hispanic Caucus Institute (CHCI) decision makers emails](https://contactout.com/dashboard/search?company=Congressional%20Hispanic%20Caucus%20Institute%20(CHCI)&seniority=founder%7Cc_suite%7Cvice_president%7Cowner%7Cdirector)
.

What types of leadership development programs does CHCI offer?

CHCI offers a variety of leadership development programs aimed at empowering Latino youth and professionals. These include high school leadership programs, graduate fellowships, and public policy fellowships. Each program is designed to enhance skills, provide mentorship, and create opportunities for networking within the Latino community and beyond.

How can I apply for the CHCI graduate fellowship program?

To apply for the CHCI graduate fellowship program, interested candidates must complete an online application available on the CHCI website. The application process typically includes submitting a resume, a personal statement, and letters of recommendation. It's important to check the specific eligibility criteria and deadlines for the program, as they may vary each year.

What is the purpose of CHCI's Congressional Internship program?

The Congressional Internship program at CHCI is designed to provide Latino college students with hands-on experience in the legislative process. Interns work in congressional offices, gaining valuable insights into public policy, advocacy, and the inner workings of government. This program aims to cultivate future leaders by equipping them with practical skills and professional connections.

Who is eligible to participate in CHCI's high school leadership programs?

CHCI's high school leadership programs are primarily aimed at Latino high school students who demonstrate leadership potential and a commitment to community service. Eligibility criteria typically include being enrolled in high school, maintaining a minimum GPA, and having a passion for civic engagement and leadership development. Specific requirements may vary, so it's advisable to check the program details on the CHCI website.

What industries does CHCI focus on for its professional development initiatives?

CHCI focuses on a wide range of industries for its professional development initiatives, including government, public policy, education, healthcare, and non-profit sectors. The organization aims to prepare Latino leaders to excel in various fields by providing them with the necessary skills, resources, and networking opportunities to succeed in their chosen careers.

How does CHCI support alumni after they complete their programs?

CHCI provides ongoing support to its alumni through various initiatives, including networking events, professional development workshops, and access to job opportunities. The organization fosters a strong alumni community that encourages collaboration and mentorship among former participants, helping them to continue their growth as leaders in their respective fields.

About Compaq Computer Corporation
---------------------------------

Compaq (a portmanteau of Compatibility And Quality; occasionally referred to as CQ prior to its final logo) was a company founded in 1982 that developed, sold, and supported computers and related products and services. Compaq produced some of the first IBM PC compatible computers, being the first company to legally reverse engineer the IBM Personal Computer. It rose to become the largest supplier of PC systems during the 1990s before being overtaken by Hewlett-Packard (HP) in 2001. Struggling to keep up in the price wars against Dell, as well as with a risky acquisition of Digital Equipment Corporation (DEC), Compaq was acquired for US$25 billion by HP in 2002. The Compaq brand remained in use by HP for lower-end systems until 2013 when it was discontinued.  
  
The company was formed by Rod Canion, Jim Harris and Bill Murto—former Texas Instruments senior managers. Murto (SVP\[clarification needed\] of Sales) departed Compaq in 1987, while Canion (President and Chief Executive Officer) and Harris (SVP of Engineering) left under a shakeup in 1991, which saw Eckhard Pfeiffer appointed President and CEO. Pfeiffer served through the 1990s. Ben Rosen provided the venture capital financing for the fledgling company and served as chairman of the board for 18 years from 1983 until September 28, 2000, when he retired and was succeeded by Michael Capellas, who served as the last Chairman and CEO until its merger with HP.  
  
Prior to its takeover, the company was headquartered in a facility near the unincorporated area of Kohrville in Harris County, Texas, that remains HP's largest United States facility.  
  
\[from Wikipedia\]

About Levy Konigsberg LLP
-------------------------

LEVY KONIGSBERG LLP ("LK") is one of the nation's premier law firms specializing in asbestos exposure, lead paint poisoning, toxic exposures, birth defects, fraud and personal injury law. LK has litigated precedent-setting cases and obtained significant rulings and judgments - which have included some of the highest awards for mesothelioma and asbestos exposure, lead paint poisoning and fraud. Personal Injury and Wrongful Death - For more than a generation, LK has worked to protect the rights of individuals and groups whose lives have been disrupted or cut short because of personal injury or wrongful death. LK has amassed scores of verdicts in the millions and tens of millions of dollars. Toxic Chemical Exposure, Mesothelioma, and Pharmaceutical Litigation - LK has been a pioneer in representing victims of asbestos exposure. The firm's lawyers have been at the forefront in the fight against other dangerous products and pharmaceuticals such as Bextra, Vioxx, Depo Provera, DES, and the Dalkon Shield. Lead Poisoning and Birth Defects - LK is a leading representative of children exposed to lead paint. LPK has spearheaded litigation against the semiconductor industry to eliminate the use of ethylene glycol ethers, which have caused birth defects in the children of semiconductor workers. Others are of expertise include - Medical Malpractice, Construction Accidents, and other Catastrophic Incidents - Employment Discrimination Law - Appellate Practice

What types of carbon offset projects does The Climate Trust support?

The Climate Trust supports a diverse range of carbon offset projects across various sectors. This includes biogas projects that convert organic waste into renewable energy, forestry projects that enhance carbon sequestration through sustainable land management, and grassland conservation initiatives that protect and restore natural ecosystems. Additionally, we invest in innovative building models that reduce energy consumption and promote sustainability.

How can businesses purchase carbon offsets through The Climate Trust?

Businesses can purchase carbon offsets directly from The Climate Trust by visiting our website and exploring our available projects. We provide detailed information on each project, including the amount of carbon offset generated and the environmental benefits. Our team is also available to assist businesses in understanding their carbon footprint and selecting the most suitable offsets to meet their sustainability goals.

What is the process for developing a carbon mitigation program with The Climate Trust?

Developing a carbon mitigation program with The Climate Trust involves several steps. Initially, we conduct a thorough assessment of your organization's emissions and sustainability goals. Then, we collaborate with you to design a tailored program that aligns with your objectives, leveraging our expertise in climate policy and conservation finance. Throughout the process, we ensure compliance with relevant regulations and standards, ultimately helping you achieve measurable emissions reductions.

What industries can benefit from The Climate Trust's carbon offset solutions?

The Climate Trust's carbon offset solutions are beneficial across a wide range of industries, including agriculture, energy, manufacturing, and real estate. Companies in these sectors can leverage our projects to offset their emissions, enhance their sustainability practices, and meet regulatory requirements. Our expertise in diverse areas such as biogas, forestry, and building innovation allows us to provide tailored solutions that fit the unique needs of each industry.

How does The Climate Trust ensure the credibility of its carbon offset projects?

The Climate Trust ensures the credibility of its carbon offset projects through rigorous monitoring, reporting, and verification (MRV) processes. Each project undergoes third-party validation to confirm that it meets established standards for carbon offset generation. We also adhere to best practices in project management and maintain transparency with stakeholders by providing regular updates and detailed documentation of project outcomes.

Can individuals participate in carbon offset projects through The Climate Trust?

Yes, individuals can participate in carbon offset projects through The Climate Trust by purchasing carbon offsets for personal use. This allows individuals to offset their own carbon footprints, such as emissions from travel or home energy use. By supporting our projects, individuals contribute to meaningful climate action and help fund initiatives that reduce greenhouse gas emissions in their communities and beyond.

About KickStart International
-----------------------------

KickStart’s mission is to get millions of people out of poverty quickly, cost effectively and sustainably. KickStart creates opportunities for poor, rural, entrepreneurial farmers in Sub-Saharan Africa to make money and offers a permanent solution to address the deepest root of poverty; lack of income.  
  
KickStart designs and mass markets simple, money-making tools that open up business opportunities for poor smallholder farmers. MoneyMaker brand, human powered, irrigation pumps are the most widely used of these products and provide an ideal and environmentally friendly solution that will quickly enable poor farming families to access water and grow crops.  
  
These low-cost ($35 and $100 USD) pumps are sold in local retail shops (KickStart works with factories, shippers, distributors and dealers to ensure that our pumps are made widely available and accessible to poor communities and in rural areas), and once purchased, enable farmers to move from rain-fed farming to irrigated agriculture at which point they can grow crops year-round and sell their crops at a profit during the dry season when prices are high.  
  
With increased income, they lift themselves out of poverty and improve their quality of life by being able to access: plentiful food, clean water, education for their children and healthcare for their families.

About Country Road Group

COUNTRY ROAD GROUP  
  
Country Road Group is one of Australia's largest specialty fashion retailers with a market leading position in the mid to upper tier of the segment. Comprising five iconic brands - Country Road, Mimco, Trenery, Witchery and Politix - be it modern Australian designs, urban sophistication or accessories with a quirk, each brand has its own inspiring story to tell.  
  
Country Road Group is part of leading Southern Hemisphere retail group, Woolworths Holdings Limited (South Africa).  
  
COUNTRY ROAD  
  
Country Road is an iconic Australian fashion lifestyle brand for Woman, Man, Child and Home.  
For over 40 years natural simplicity, beauty and an inherent understanding of the Australian way of life have underpinned Country Road's design philosophy. Focusing on style, quality and versatility, Country Road delivers modern Australian design for effortless living, every day.  
  
MIMCO  
  
MIMCO is as an accessible luxury accessories brand, designed with a touch of quirk. With a dedicated design team based in Melbourne, quality, innovation and creativity are at the heart of everything MIMCO does.  
  
POLITIX  
  
POLITIX is a premium Australian fashion brand setting the bar for men's style.  
With a focus on directional and design-driven menswear and accessories, POLITIX has been outfitting style conscious Aussie men for over 40 years.  
  
TRENERY  
  
Trenery designs are modern in approach and timeless in style. We believe less is more, that beauty lies in simplicity; the flattering cut, subtle details, the colour palette and fabrication. Combining traditional craftsmanship with fabrics sourced from some of the world’s finest mills we create effortless, enduring designs with lasting integrity.  
  
WITCHERY  
  
Witchery is the first and last word in style. Always at the forefront, Witchery seamlessly captures the ever-shifting fashion mindset from across the globe and delivers highly sought after, inspired designs. No one does it like Witchery.

About Harvey Cushing

Harvey Cushing was an influential American neurosurgeon and pathologist who made groundbreaking contributions to the field of medicine. Born in Cleveland, Ohio in 1869, Cushing was a pioneer in the study and treatment of brain tumors and other neurological disorders. His work revolutionized the field of neurosurgery and laid the foundation for modern surgical techniques and practices.  
  
After completing his medical degree at Harvard Medical School in 1895, Cushing began his career as a researcher and physician. In his early years, he worked at Johns Hopkins Hospital, where he conducted extensive research on the pituitary gland and its role in regulating the body's functions. This research laid the groundwork for his later work in the field of neurosurgery and endocrinology.  
  
In 1913, Cushing was appointed as the first professor of neurosurgery at Harvard Medical School. It was during his time at Harvard that Cushing made some of his most significant contributions to the field of medicine. He developed several groundbreaking surgical techniques for treating brain tumors and other neurological conditions, including the use of local anesthesia and the use of x-rays to guide surgical procedures.  
  
One of Cushing's most famous achievements was the development of the "Cushing reflex," a crucial understanding of how the body responds to changes in intracranial pressure. This discovery revolutionized the diagnosis and treatment of head injuries and other neurological conditions, and it is still used in clinical practice today.  
  
In addition to his clinical work, Cushing was also a prolific writer and researcher. He published numerous papers and books on topics ranging from brain surgery to the history of medicine. His most famous work, "The Life of Sir William Osler," a biography of his mentor and friend, was an instant classic and solidified Cushing's reputation as a leading figure in the medical community.  
  
Cushing's impact on the field of medicine extended beyond his pioneering surgical techniques and research. He was also instrumental in the establishment of the American Board of Neurological Surgery and the American Association of Neurological Surgeons, both of which have played a crucial role in advancing the field.  
  
Cushing's dedication to his work and his relentless pursuit of excellence earned him numerous honors and awards throughout his career, including the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 1933. This recognition was a testament to the profound impact Cushing had on the field of neurosurgery and the broader medical community.  
  
In addition to his professional achievements, Cushing was also known for his compassionate and empathetic approach to patient care. He was deeply committed to improving the quality of life for his patients and was widely admired for his bedside manner and dedication to the well-being of those under his care.  
  
After a long and illustrious career, Cushing retired from his position at Harvard Medical School in 1932. However, his legacy lived on through the countless lives he had touched and the enduring impact of his contributions to the field of medicine.  
  
Today, Harvey Cushing is remembered as a pioneering figure in the field of neurosurgery, whose work laid the foundation for modern practices and techniques. His groundbreaking discoveries and innovative surgical techniques have saved countless lives and continue to inspire and inform the work of neurosurgeons and medical researchers around the world. Harvey Cushing's impact on the field of medicine is immeasurable, and his legacy continues to shape the way we understand and treat neurological conditions today.

Paws Up is home to 36 safari-style luxury tents and 28 expansive private homes—all offering guests the rare opportunity to surround themselves in pristine nature while reveling in world-class comfort.  
  
To take full advantage of the sprawling ranch, guests can choose from more than 70 outdoor activities, such as whitewater rafting, fly-fishing, waterskiing, clay shooting and cattle driving. The Resort also hosts events year-round that celebrate the best in wine, music and horsemanship, as well as culinary weekends that draw top chefs from around the world.  
  
It is a testament to our phenomenal staff that, despite the incredible outdoor adventures, fine cuisine and spectacular views at Paws Up, our most frequent feedback is a glowing thank-you to the employees who made our guests’ stay unforgettable. Clear Blue Sea is a nonprofit 501(c)(3) dedicated to cleansing the oceans of plastic pollution. What services does Clear Blue Sea provide to combat ocean plastic pollution?

Clear Blue Sea offers a range of services aimed at reducing ocean plastic pollution. These include innovative project management solutions that focus on the design and implementation of robotic systems for collecting plastic waste from waterways. We also engage in educational outreach programs to raise awareness about ocean plastic issues and provide internship opportunities for students interested in environmental science and engineering.

How does Clear Blue Sea's technology work in addressing plastic pollution?

Our technology utilizes advanced robotics and engineering principles to create efficient systems for collecting plastic debris from oceans and waterways. These robotic systems are designed to operate in various marine environments, enabling us to gather data on plastic pollution while simultaneously removing waste. The collected data helps us refine our methods and improve our impact on the marine ecosystem.

What industries does Clear Blue Sea collaborate with to further its mission?

Clear Blue Sea collaborates with various industries, including environmental organizations, educational institutions, and technology companies. By partnering with these sectors, we aim to leverage resources, expertise, and innovative solutions to enhance our efforts in combating ocean plastic pollution. Our collaborations also extend to local communities and government agencies to promote sustainable practices and policies.

How can individuals get involved with Clear Blue Sea's initiatives?

Individuals can get involved with Clear Blue Sea in several ways. We welcome volunteers for our beach clean-up events and educational outreach programs. Additionally, we offer internship opportunities for students who are passionate about marine conservation and engineering. Donations are also crucial to our mission, and individuals can contribute financially to support our projects and initiatives.

What educational resources does Clear Blue Sea provide for schools and communities?

Clear Blue Sea provides a variety of educational resources aimed at raising awareness about ocean plastic pollution. We offer workshops, presentations, and interactive activities for schools and community groups. Our educational outreach programs are designed to engage participants in understanding the impact of plastic waste on marine ecosystems and inspire them to take action in their own communities.

What impact has Clear Blue Sea made in the fight against ocean plastic pollution?

Clear Blue Sea has made significant strides in the fight against ocean plastic pollution through our innovative robotic systems and community engagement initiatives. We have successfully removed tons of plastic waste from waterways and have educated thousands of individuals about the importance of protecting marine ecosystems. Our ongoing research and data collection efforts continue to inform best practices and drive further action against plastic pollution.

What types of security solutions does Robotic Assistance Devices (RAD) offer?

Robotic Assistance Devices (RAD) specializes in artificial intelligence-based security solutions that include mobile and stationary robotics. Their offerings encompass autonomous security robots that patrol premises, monitor for unusual activities, and provide real-time alerts. Additionally, RAD provides workflow automation tools and supplemental concierge services to enhance overall security and operational efficiency.

How can RAD's robotic solutions improve security for my organization?

RAD's robotic solutions enhance security by providing 24/7 surveillance capabilities, reducing the need for human security personnel in high-risk areas. The AI-driven technology allows for real-time monitoring and immediate response to potential threats, which can lead to quicker incident resolution. Furthermore, the robots can be deployed in various environments, including corporate offices, retail spaces, and industrial sites, ensuring comprehensive coverage and peace of mind.

What industries can benefit from RAD's services?

RAD's services are designed to support a wide range of industries, including retail, healthcare, education, transportation, and critical infrastructure. Each sector can leverage RAD's AI-driven security solutions to address specific challenges, such as theft prevention in retail, patient safety in healthcare, or enhanced security in educational institutions. The versatility of RAD's technology allows for tailored implementations based on the unique needs of each industry.

Are RAD's robots capable of integrating with existing security systems?

Yes, RAD's robotic solutions are designed to seamlessly integrate with existing security systems, including CCTV cameras, access control systems, and alarm systems. This interoperability allows organizations to enhance their current security infrastructure without the need for a complete overhaul. The integration facilitates a more cohesive security strategy, enabling better data sharing and improved incident response.

What are the benefits of using AI in security solutions?

The use of AI in security solutions offers numerous benefits, including enhanced accuracy in threat detection, reduced response times, and the ability to analyze large volumes of data for actionable insights. AI can identify patterns and anomalies that may go unnoticed by human operators, allowing for proactive security measures. Additionally, AI-driven automation helps optimize resource allocation, enabling organizations to focus on higher-level security tasks while routine monitoring is handled by robots.

How does RAD ensure the safety and privacy of individuals monitored by their robots?

RAD prioritizes safety and privacy by implementing strict data protection measures and compliance with relevant regulations. The robots are equipped with advanced sensors and cameras that operate within predefined parameters to ensure they do not infringe on individual privacy. Additionally, RAD employs encryption and secure data storage practices to protect sensitive information collected during monitoring. Regular audits and updates are also conducted to maintain high standards of safety and privacy.

What types of services does E Source offer to utilities and cities?

E Source provides a comprehensive range of services designed to help utilities and cities innovate and achieve sustainability goals. Our offerings include predictive data science, market intelligence, consulting, and advisory services. We specialize in energy efficiency, solar energy, electric vehicles, customer experience, and grid optimization, among others. Our goal is to empower our partners with the insights and strategies they need to enhance operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

How does E Source utilize predictive data science in its solutions?

E Source leverages predictive data science to analyze vast amounts of data related to energy consumption, customer behavior, and market trends. By employing advanced analytics and machine learning techniques, we help utilities forecast demand, optimize resource allocation, and identify opportunities for energy savings. This data-driven approach enables our clients to make informed decisions that enhance their operational efficiency and sustainability efforts.

Can E Source assist with the implementation of energy efficiency programs?

Yes, E Source has extensive experience in designing and implementing energy efficiency programs tailored to the specific needs of utilities and their customers. Our team collaborates with clients to develop strategies that promote energy-saving technologies and practices. We provide insights into program design, customer engagement, and performance evaluation to ensure that initiatives are effective and deliver measurable results.

What industries does E Source support beyond traditional utilities?

In addition to supporting electric and water utilities, E Source also works with municipalities and organizations involved in distributed energy resources, such as solar energy and electric vehicle infrastructure. Our expertise extends to various sectors, including commercial and industrial clients, helping them optimize energy use and improve customer experiences through innovative solutions and technologies.

How can E Source help improve customer experience for utilities?

E Source provides utilities with tools and strategies to enhance customer experience through better communication, engagement, and service delivery. We conduct research to understand customer preferences and behaviors, enabling utilities to tailor their offerings and improve satisfaction. Our advisory services also include developing effective marketing strategies and implementing customer feedback mechanisms to foster a more responsive and customer-centric approach.

What role does vegetation management play in E Source's services?

Vegetation management is a critical component of maintaining the reliability and safety of utility infrastructure. E Source offers consulting services that help utilities develop effective vegetation management programs to minimize risks associated with tree-related outages and enhance grid resilience. Our approach includes data analysis, risk assessment, and best practices for managing vegetation near power lines, ensuring compliance with regulations while promoting environmental stewardship.

How does Post Intelligence's deep learning model work?

Post Intelligence's deep learning model operates by analyzing vast amounts of data from user interactions on social media platforms. It learns from the types of posts that generate the most engagement for each user, considering factors like timing, content type, and audience demographics. Over time, the model continuously refines its recommendations, ensuring that users receive increasingly effective strategies for their social media presence.

Which industries can benefit from Post Intelligence's solutions?

Post Intelligence's solutions are versatile and can benefit a wide range of industries, including e-commerce, entertainment, travel, and education. Businesses in these sectors can leverage Pi's AI-driven insights to create engaging content that attracts followers, drives traffic, and ultimately increases conversions. Can Post Intelligence help with both organic and paid social media strategies?

Post Intelligence is designed to cater to both individual users and businesses. About Sewer Equipment
---------------------

Sewer Equipment is the corporate home of Sewer Equipment Co. of America, RAMVAC Vacuum Excavators and Mongoose Jetters. With over 75 years of experience, Sewer Equipment manufactures the most innovative, high quality sewer cleaning and excavation equipment for the municipal and contractor markets around the world.  
  
Sewer Equipment is a third generation family-owned company that was started in 1941 by H.T. O’Brien in the basement of his Chicago, Illinois home, He designed a small hand operated tool that was built to assist plumbers in cleaning drains. This tool was comprised of a short coiled cable attached to a hand drill. The flexible cable allowed the tool to navigate around turns and bends and better attack the blockage. This innovation gave birth to Sewer Equipment, that has recognized significant growth since its very humble beginnings. Over the years, the O’Brien family has grown the business with on-going commitment to designing and manufacturing innovative, high quality equipment and providing world class customer service. Sewer Equipment's current product offering includes combination sewer cleaners, truck jets, trailer jets, easement machines, vacuum excavators, bucket machines, mechanical rodders and parts/accessories.  
  
Sewer Equipment has a long history of introducing innovative products into the market, including the first trailer mounted jetter with a rotating hose reel, the 800-HPR truck jet with its patented all-weather design, the Model 900 ECO combination sewer cleaning with its patented hydro drive system, the first jet-tv system using umbilical cord technology, the first mid-size hydro excavator (Ram-Vac HX-6), and the first easement machine with hydraulic push-out wheels…just to name a few.  
  
Sewer Equipment: Best Products. Best Local Support.

About MyFootballClub
--------------------

The MyFootballClub community is the first Internet organisation to buy and takeover a real-world football club. Become more than just a fan. In 2007, myfootballclub purchased Ebbsfleet United, in England's Blue Square Premier League. In 2013, members voted to sell the club and start a new venture.  
  
In June 2013, members voted to become sponsors of Slough Town FC. "The Rebels", currently plays in the Southern Football League Division One Central. That’s level 8 in the English Football Pyramid and 4 levels below professional League 2.  
  
MyFootballClub is a unique internet venture that uses the principle of crowdsourcing and crowdfunding to run a real football club. As owners of Ebbsfleet United, myfootballclub members each contributeed small amounts annually, and voted on key management decisions like the budget, transfer deals, kit supplier contracts, kit design, election of Club officials, and even approved the Manager's contract!  
  
This model brings a unique dialogue between the club and the community, with local fans sharing knowledge about the club, and global members contributing their expertise and skills that would otherwise cost the club. Members are able to bring fresh ideas, which are discussed and voted on as a community, for action by the Club  
  
It also brings a level of transparency into the Club management which is rarely seen, with members even able to discuss line items from the Monthly budget with the Club accountant openly as a community.

### Frequently Asked Questions about NAMM

Who is the CEO of NAMM?

Bui Khuong is the CEO of NAMM. To contact Bui Khuong email at [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)

Who are the decision makers in NAMM?

What is the primary mission of NAMM?

The National Association of Music Merchants (NAMM) is dedicated to strengthening the music products industry, which is valued at approximately $17 billion. NAMM aims to support its members through advocacy, education, and networking opportunities, ensuring that the music industry continues to thrive and evolve.

Who can become a member of NAMM?

NAMM membership is open to a wide range of stakeholders in the music products industry, including manufacturers, distributors, retailers, and service providers. With approximately 10,300 members globally, NAMM provides resources and support tailored to the unique needs of each segment within the industry.

What types of resources does NAMM provide to its members?

NAMM offers a variety of resources to its members, including educational programs, industry research, marketing support, and access to exclusive events such as trade shows. Members can also benefit from advocacy efforts that promote the interests of the music products industry at local, state, and national levels.

How does NAMM support music education?

NAMM is committed to promoting music education as a vital component of a well-rounded education. The association advocates for music programs in schools and provides resources for educators, including grants, scholarships, and partnerships with organizations that support music education initiatives.

What are the benefits of attending NAMM trade shows?

Attending NAMM trade shows provides members with invaluable opportunities to network with industry professionals, discover new products, and gain insights into market trends. These events also feature educational sessions, product demonstrations, and the chance to connect with potential business partners and customers.

How can I stay updated on NAMM events and initiatives?

To stay informed about NAMM events, initiatives, and industry news, you can subscribe to the NAMM newsletter, follow NAMM on social media platforms, and regularly check the NAMM website. These channels provide timely updates on upcoming events, educational opportunities, and industry developments.

At High Street TV we develop, source and sell innovative and proven products for everyday life. We are the home of bestselling lifestyle brands such as Pressure King Pro, Drew&Cole, New Image and Sleep Origins, as well as the exclusive distributer for some of the world’s most successful ‘As Seen On TV’ products such as NutriBullet, XHose, MaxiClimber and Power Air Fryer.

High Street TV is truly multi-channel – we provide opportunity for customers to purchase our products wherever and whenever most convenient to them. Our products can be bought via our shopping channels, our call centre, our website, online, on Amazon and ebay or in-store at over 2,000 outlets including well-known high-street retailers such as John Lewis, Argos, Tesco, ASDA, Selfridges, Boots and John Dyas. Our products are available in over 87 countries and we work with leading international partners to bring HSTV products to customers around the world.

Trijicon has led the industry in the development of superior any-light aiming systems since the company’s founding in 1981. World-renowned for its innovative applications of tritium and advanced fiber-optics, Trijicon manufactures the most advanced riflescopes and sights for tactical and sporting applications.  
  
Backed by a Limited-Lifetime Warranty, Trijicon’s aiming systems are proven on the range and in the field. As a result, Trijicon has earned the trust of those who are most in need of aiming accuracy and dependability. The company is proud to count as our customers the United States Marine Corps, United States Army, United States Special Operations Forces, United States Government, and state and local Law Enforcement, just to name a few. Trijicon is fast becoming the preferred scope among dedicated hunters for all types of game, as well as shooting enthusiasts worldwide.  
  
An ISO 9001:2015 rated company, Trijicon Inc., is committed to Customer Satisfaction through the design, development, and manufacture of superior quality products while offering expert technical support. Trijicon’s commitment to continuous improvement of products and services is paramount in their endeavors to continue as a world leader in the design and manufacture of high quality, innovative sighting systems.

Every day, our users collaborate to organize on local, national and global issues; hold corporations to account; and demand action from decision makers at the highest levels of government and business. This hybrid structure of two mutually supporting organizations enables us to combine the ambition and growth trajectory of a tech company with the mission-focused stewardship of a nonprofit.  
  
As an organization, Change.org is committed to providing the tools, resources and support needed to empower anyone, anywhere to create the change they want to see.  
  
We love serving our incredible users, and we love our staff too. We show it with competitive salaries, unlimited vacation, 18 weeks of parental leave, and a high impact, low-ego team that can’t wait to learn from you and teach you what they know.

About American Geographical Society
-----------------------------------

Established in 1851, the American Geographical Society (AGS) is the oldest professional geographical organization in the United States. It is recognized world-wide as a pioneer in geographical research and education in Geography for over 170 years. The mission of AGS is to advance geographic knowledge and the recognition of its importance in the contemporary world. AGS promotes the use of geography in business, government, science, and education with a goal to enhance the nation’s geographic literacy so as to engender sound public policy, national security, and human well-being worldwide. AGS is the only organization focused on bringing together academics, business people, those who influence public policy (including leaders in local, state and federal government, not-for-profit organizations and the media), and the general public for the express purpose of furthering the understanding of the role of geography in our lives. AGS provides leadership to frame the national discussion of the growing importance of geography and geo-spatial tools. The Society maintains its headquarters in New York, New York.

Logan Crow is a passionate advocate for the transformative power of cinema, serving as the Founder and Executive Director of The Frida Cinema, Orange County's only independent, 501(c)(3) not-for-profit film theater. Under his leadership, The Frida has become a vibrant cultural hub, dedicated to enriching, connecting, and educating the community through a diverse array of cinematic experiences. Logan's expertise in motion picture programming and exhibition is evident in the theater's carefully curated lineup, which emphasizes independent, foreign, and documentary films, alongside special events that blend film with live music and multimedia performances.  
  
Logan's commitment to fostering a love for cinema extends beyond traditional screenings; he actively engages with the community through innovative programming that includes film festivals, educational workshops, and collaborative events with local artists and organizations. His proficiency in online marketing and social media strategies has been instrumental in building The Frida's brand and expanding its reach, ensuring that the theater remains a beloved destination for film enthusiasts and newcomers alike.  
  
In addition to his work at The Frida, Logan is involved with various initiatives aimed at promoting the arts in the region, further solidifying his role as a key figure in the independent film landscape. His creative writing skills and experience in public relations enhance his ability to communicate the theater's mission and vision effectively, while his background in music enriches the live events that accompany many film screenings. Through his multifaceted approach, Logan Crow continues to inspire and cultivate a thriving community centered around the appreciation of cinema.

Paritaire et mutualiste, constitué en architecture fédérale et multi-affinitaire, Humanis est profondément ancré dans les valeurs de l’économie sociale et entend bâtir les solutions d’avenir de la protection sociale responsable et innovante des personnes tout au long de leur vie.  
  
Humanis s’engage à apporter durablement à ses clients, particuliers et entreprises, des solutions et des services de qualité, pour aider chacun à mieux vivre, à tout âge et dans toute situation.  
  
Acteur majeur de la protection sociale, l’expertise d’Humanis se décline dans un ensemble de solutions conçues pour accompagner chaque personne face aux aléas de la vie.  
  
Humanis intervient notamment  dans les domaines de la retraite, de la santé, de la prévoyance et de la dépendance, de l'épargne. Des garanties spécifiques sont proposées pour répondre aux besoins des expatriés et des salariés de l’Outre-Mer.   
  
Humanis propose également des services innovants d’accompagnement social.et développe une politique d’aide aux populations les plus fragiles qui met la priorité sur l'autonomie, le bien vieillir ou le retour à l'emploi des plus fragiles.  
  
En matière de développement durable, Humanis souhaite répondre aux besoins du présent mais aussi anticiper les besoins du futur et fait du développement durable un moteur d’action.

About Spindletop Community Impact Partners
------------------------------------------

Spindletop Community Impact Partners is a 501(c)(3) not-for-profit corporation that enhances the lives of at-risk youth through funding and volunteering from the energy industry, while promoting fellowship and networking among its participants.  
  
Since 1966, Spindletop has contributed nearly $25 million to aid programs supporting at-risk youth. This has been possible through hosting annual events attended by energy industry executives and future leaders. We have been making a positive impact for youth, mostly in the Greater Houston Area, which include successful programs targeting child abuse prevention; pediatric medical research and special needs; human tracking prevention and recovery; substance abuse prevention and rehabilitation; education and scholarships, including after-school programs; residential centers and foster care; family health and well-being and much more.

About NSB
---------

We love bass, beats and breakbeats. Tune in to our award-winning live streaming online internet radio. Discuss music and life with other 25,000 others in our forum. Chat with listeners and DJs in our chat room. Download over 10,000 hours of archive radio shows. This is breakbeat, we are NSB.  
  
We believe breaks and our music policy should be genre-defying, a melting pot of styles where the music can go in any direction - incorporating hip hop, funk, dubstep, drum and bass, house, bass, techno, whatever - as long as it sounds good and gets the party started. So that's what we play.  
  
Established in 2004, we've been broadcasting live, every day, for the last 5,000 days and counting. Unlike other stations, the music on our radio station is mixed and played by real DJs - there are no random tracks being played by software somewhere.  
  
Because our DJs are real people, you can send a shout-out, chat to the DJ, request a song, and chat with other listeners in our chat room. NSB is curated by real people not algorithms, finding the best tracks for your enjoyment, not to fulfil a playlist commitment. Tune in.

Davinci Roofscapes is now part of the Westlake Royal Building ProductsTM family. An expression of style and an investment that should last, a roof is much more than the sum of its parts. In fact, a roof is an integral part of a home's elevation and its curb-appeal.  
  
That's why DaVinci Roofscapes develops and manufactures superior polymer roofing system products paired with unparalleled customer service. It's a unique approach that allows DaVinci to deliver a degree of luxury, performance, and satisfaction that continues to make us the preferred choice for owners, installers, and designers alike.  
  
Quality is crucial to lasting beauty and structural integrity. DaVinci puts quality into our entire line of synthetic roofing tiles. Our composite slate shingles are carefully engineered to provide the authentic look and durability of natural slate roofs. For those who desire the natural appearance of hand-split shake shingles or machine-sawn shake, our composite shake shingles are reminiscent of the texture of natural cedar, but with unsurpassed durability and a life cycle savings of up to 50% compared to natural shake roofing. DaVinci utilizes a proprietary state-of-the-art engineered polymer to deliver durability and beauty for years to come.  
  
It's easy to see that the authentic appearance, durability, and lifetime cost advantages of DaVinci synthetic roof tiles - plus a 50-year limited warranty - add up to an exceptional value for any discerning homeowner.

Andrea Manning is a passionate restaurateur and the proud owner of Bona Casa, a cherished Italian restaurant in Cumberland, WI, that has been a staple in the community since its founding by her great-grandparents in 1957. With a deep-rooted commitment to preserving family traditions, Andrea has taken the helm alongside her husband, infusing the restaurant with their unique flair while honoring the authentic recipes from her great-grandmother's cookbook. This dedication to heritage not only enriches the dining experience but also fosters a sense of community, as patrons gather to enjoy classic Italian dishes that evoke nostalgia and warmth.  
  
Under Andrea's leadership, Bona Casa has embarked on several key projects aimed at enhancing the customer experience and expanding its reach. One notable initiative includes the introduction of seasonal menus that showcase locally sourced ingredients, allowing the restaurant to celebrate the flavors of each season while supporting local farmers. Additionally, Andrea has embraced digital marketing strategies, leveraging social media platforms like Instagram and Facebook to engage with customers and share the restaurant's story, special events, and mouthwatering dishes.  
  
With a background that spans various creative industries, Andrea brings a wealth of skills to her role, including expertise in design and vendor management. Her proficiency in tools like Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator has allowed her to create visually appealing marketing materials that reflect the restaurant's cozy ambiance and Italian heritage. As Bona Casa continues to thrive, Andrea remains committed to fostering a welcoming environment where the community can come together over delicious food, making every meal a celebration of family, tradition, and love.

About Frank Gomez

Frank Gomez is a seasoned Chiropractic Physician at Immediate Chiropractic Care, PC, where he leverages over three decades of experience to help patients regain and enhance their health, fitness, and overall vitality. Since earning his state licensure in New York in 1987, Frank has dedicated his career to advancing the field of chiropractic care, particularly in sports medicine and rehabilitation. His extensive education, including a Diplomate from the American Board of Chiropractic Sports Physicians and specialized certifications from the New York Chiropractic College, underscores his commitment to excellence in patient care.  
  
At Immediate Chiropractic Care, Frank is at the forefront of innovative treatment methodologies, utilizing specific blood testing and analysis to tailor vitamin and nutrient recommendations to each patient’s unique physiological needs. This personalized approach eliminates the guesswork often associated with nutrition, empowering patients to make informed decisions about their health. His expertise in rehabilitation psychology and musculoskeletal conditions positions him as a trusted resource for those recovering from sports injuries or chronic pain.  
  
In addition to his clinical practice, Frank is passionate about education and community outreach. He frequently conducts workshops and seminars on topics ranging from injury prevention to optimal fitness strategies, reinforcing his role as a fitness coach and educator. His ability to network within the healthcare community enhances collaborative efforts, ensuring that patients receive comprehensive care. With a skill set that encompasses physical therapy, training, and rehabilitation, Frank Gomez continues to make a significant impact on the lives of his patients, guiding them toward sustainable health and wellness.

What services does MediaBank offer for video content management?

MediaBank provides a comprehensive suite of services for video content management, including rights management, content distribution, and digital asset management. Our platform enables users to easily upload, organize, and manage their video assets while ensuring compliance with licensing agreements. Additionally, we facilitate the trade of professional TV and film rights, streamlining the entire content transaction process from acquisition to delivery.

How does MediaBank support the rights trade process?

MediaBank simplifies the rights trade process by offering a user-friendly platform where content owners and buyers can connect. We provide tools for listing available content, negotiating terms, and finalizing agreements. Our system ensures transparency and security throughout the transaction, allowing users to track the status of their rights and manage their portfolios effectively.

Which industries does MediaBank cater to?

MediaBank serves a diverse range of industries, including television networks, film production companies, streaming services, and digital media agencies. Our platform is designed to meet the needs of content creators, distributors, and broadcasters, providing them with the tools necessary to navigate the complexities of media rights and content management in today's digital landscape.

Can I use MediaBank to distribute my content globally?

Yes, MediaBank is designed for global content distribution. Our platform allows users to reach a wide audience by facilitating the trade of media rights across various regions and markets. Whether you are looking to distribute your content to local broadcasters or international streaming platforms, MediaBank provides the necessary tools and connections to help you achieve your distribution goals.

What types of media content can I manage on MediaBank?

MediaBank supports a wide variety of media content, including television shows, feature films, documentaries, and short films. Our platform is equipped to handle various formats and resolutions, making it easy for users to manage their entire library of video assets. Additionally, we provide features for tagging, categorizing, and searching for content, ensuring that users can efficiently locate and utilize their media.

Is there customer support available for users of MediaBank?

Absolutely! MediaBank offers dedicated customer support to assist users with any inquiries or issues they may encounter while using the platform. Our support team is knowledgeable about the media industry and can provide guidance on content management, rights trading, and technical aspects of the platform. Users can reach out via email, phone, or through our online help center for prompt assistance.

About The Pitt News
-------------------

The Pitt News has been the University of Pittsburgh’s award-winning daily student newspaper since 1910. The newspaper publishes daily during the fall and spring semesters, and weekly during the summer, with 10,000 copies distributed to campus newsstands. The paper has won prestigious awards from the Associated College Press (widely considered to be the “Pulitzer Prizes” of college journalism), Columbia Scholastic Press Association, College Media Business & Advertising Managers and the Pennsylvania NewsMedia Association.  
  
Funded through advertising revenue, The Pitt News employs more than 200 students who sell ads, edit and design the print newspaper, write opinions and cover news, culture, sports and more. The Pitt News strives to promote discourse on campus and inform the Pitt student body about issues affecting college students at the University and across the country.  
  
Our staff has gone on to work at The New York Times, Wall Street Journal, New York Daily News, South China Morning Post, CNN, Vanity Fair, CNBC, CBS Sports, Time Magazine, National Geographic, Bloomberg News, Hearst Magazines, Men’s Health, Pittsburgh Post-Gazette, Pittsburgh Business-Times, Tribune-Review, PublicSource and numerous other outlets.

About di Rosa Center for Contemporary Art
-----------------------------------------

di Rosa Center for Contemporary Art presents contemporary exhibitions and educational programs for all ages and maintains a permanent collection of notable works by artists living or working in the San Francisco Bay Area from the mid-twentieth century to the present day. A wide range of styles, media, and subject matter provides an overview of the creative energy and freedom to experiment that characterize this region of California. Protected in perpetuity under the Napa County Land Trust, di Rosa features multiple galleries, a sculpture park, and a 35-acre lake, all located on 217 scenic acres in Napa Valley’s famed Carneros region. For more information, visit dirosaart.org.

About Infinity Pharmaceuticals
------------------------------

We are relentlessly pursuing excellence – daring to believe that a cure can be a reality.  
  
Infinity Pharmaceuticals, Inc., is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing eganelisib (IPI-549), a potentially first-in-class, oral, immuno-oncology macrophage reprogramming therapeutic which addresses a fundamental biologic mechanism of immune suppression in cancer in multiple clinical studies. MARIO-275 is a randomized, controlled combination study of eganelisib combined with Opdivo® in I/O naïve urothelial cancer. MARIO-3 is the first eganelisib combination study in front-line advanced cancer patients and is evaluating eganelisib in combination with Tecentriq® and Abraxane® in front-line TNBC and in combination with Tecentriq and Avastin® in front-line RCC. In collaboration with Arcus Biosciences, Infinity is evaluating a checkpoint inhibitor-free, novel combination regimen of eganelisib plus etrumadenant (AB928, a dual adenosine receptor antagonist) plus Doxil® in advanced TNBC patients. In 2019, Infinity completed enrollment in MARIO-1, a Phase 1/1b study evaluating eganelisib as a monotherapy and in combination with Opdivo (nivolumab) in patients with advanced solid tumors including patients refractory to checkpoint inhibitor therapy. With these studies, Infinity is evaluating eganelisib in the anti-PD-1 refractory, I/O-naïve, and front-line settings. For more information on Infinity, please refer to Infinity's website at www.infi.com.

Our mission is to create, produce and distribute high quality programs and services that educate, inform and entertain our audiences and enrich the quality of their lives.  
  
Our Family  
  
Television  
Georgia Public Broadcasting's nine public television stations deliver quality PBS and locally produced programming to every county in Georgia, and to significant portions of surrounding states.  
  
Radio  
Since 1984, Georgia Public Broadcasting's listener-supported public radio network has been Georgia's source for great music and National Public Radio (NPR) news.  
  
Education  
Georgia Public Broadcasting's education service is Georgia's electronically delivered classroom for all Georgia learners, and Georgia educators' source for top-quality multiple media educational products and services. With a network of 2,428 satellite dishes, GPB broadcasts educational video programming to every public school, regional library, adult technical education center, youth development center, and public college and university in Georgia, serving over 115,000 teachers and approximately 1.6 million students across the state via satellite, the web and open-air broadcasts.

Paideia School, located in the heart of Druid Hills, Atlanta, is a distinguished independent pre K-12 institution that prides itself on fostering a nurturing and intellectually stimulating environment. With a commitment to strong academics, vibrant arts, and competitive athletics, Paideia has earned a reputation for providing individualized attention to its diverse student body. The school’s ethos is deeply rooted in community; teachers, families, and students collaborate to create a supportive atmosphere where education is celebrated as a lifelong journey.  
  
At Paideia, educators are not just instructors; they are mentors who genuinely care about the holistic development of their students. The school values its teachers, providing them with the respect and autonomy necessary to design engaging and meaningful curricula. About State of Florida
----------------------

Join Florida’s talented workforce to fulfill your professional goals and achieve a meaningful career. Our talented public servants work hard to serve more than 19 million residents across Florida, and you, too, can realize success in the Sunshine State.  
  
Working in Florida’s state government means being responsive to the issues impacting the taxpayers of our state. Florida’s state government boasts both fast-paced work environments in which critical thinking and creative problem-solving are a must as well as steady employment opportunities that prize consistent service to our state’s residents. In some positions, state employment means being able to influence policy decisions and help implement change. In others, state employment means being the reliable resource that our taxpayers have come to expect from Florida’s public servants. All positions offer the ability to gain valuable experience quickly, improving your overall skillset. The State of Florida is seeking individuals with leadership skills, creativity and dedication to their fellow Floridians and individuals who recognize the professional development opportunities and achievements possible through state service.  
  
Florida boasts the third largest population in the country and is richly diverse in both population and landscape. With an award-winning park system, warm weather and beautiful bodies of water, Florida is the perfect environment for recreational activities and outdoor enthusiasts. Our favorable tax climate means your income goes further and our business-friendly policies foster private sector growth. Joining Florida’s talented, diverse workforce provides the opportunity to achieve your professional goals while living in a state that values quality of life, culture and recreation. For employment opportunities with the State of Florida, visit https://jobs.myflorida.com.

About Hellenic Army (Technical Corps)
-------------------------------------

The Hellenic Army, formed in 1828, is the land force of Greece. Along with the Hellenic Air Force (HAF) and the Hellenic Navy (HN), it makes up the Hellenic Armed Forces. It is currently the largest branch of the three. The army is headed by the chief of the Hellenic Army General Staff (HAGS), which in turn is under the command of Hellenic National Defence General Staff (HNDGS).  
  
The motto of the Hellenic Army is Eleútheron tò Eúpsychon, "Freedom Stems from Valour", from Thucydides's History of the Peloponnesian War (2.43.4). The Hellenic Army Emblem is the two-headed eagle with a Greek Cross escutcheon in the centre, representing the links between modern Greece, the Greek Orthodox Church, and the Byzantine Empire.  
  
The Hellenic Army, apart from being the largest component participating in it, is also leading the Balkan Battle Group (otherwise known as "HELBROC" (an acronym for HELlas, Bulgaria, ROmania and Cyprus)), which is the largest military formation of NATO in Southeast Europe.

About YWCA El Paso del Norte Region
-----------------------------------

The YWCA El Paso del Norte Region is a nonprofit organization founded in 1909. It as a member of the national YWCA, the oldest and largest multicultural organization in the world. We share a common vision for peace, justice, freedom and dignity for all people. More than 50,000 people in our community are served every year by the YWCA El Paso del Norte Region, through hundreds of programs, classes and support groups.  
  
The YWCA El Paso del Norte Region strives every day to achieve:  
  
• Race and gender equity  
• Economic independence for women  
• Respect for diverse cultures  
• A place where children and youth thrive  
• A community that is vibrant and healthy  
  
The mission of the YWCA El Paso del Norte Region is eliminating racism, empowering women and girls, and promoting peace, justice, freedom and dignity for all. Our vision is to be the most trusted and effective change agent in the journey to eliminate racism and sexism in our community. As the largest and most comprehensive YWCA in the United States. Families depend on us for a menu of services.  
  
The YWCA El Paso del Norte Region stands for a fully inclusive community in which each person is healthy and valued, and where racial justice, gender equality and human dignity are promoted and sustained through bold and effective women's leadership. We invite you to stand with the YWCA El Paso del Norte Region in our mission and our work.

About Okanagan Regional Library
-------------------------------

The Okanagan Regional Library (ORL) is YOUR library – your most green, relevant, and economical resource for information and entertainment. Established in 1936, the ORL serves over 350,000 people across an area covering 59,600 square kilometres through 29 branches and online. Each year, we circulate more than 3 million items and get over 1 million hits on www.orl.bc.ca  
Membership is FREE to people within our library regions, giving you access to the 16th largest library in Canada. In addition to the immense selection of fiction and non-fiction books, magazines, newspapers, and reference materials available at your local branch, did you know your library card gives you access to:  
\- a myriad of programs for children and adults  
\- free internet at our workstations or wirelessly on your own laptop in our branches  
\- online book clubs  
\- hundreds of feature film DVD titles  
\- great selection of databases on-line  
\- downloadable Audio books and eBooks online  
\- a variety of special needs services for members who are visually disabled, living in remote areas of our region, or wanting materials in other languages  
\- meeting rooms  
\- research and reference help, exam proctoring, and more!
