About The Hite Company
----------------------

Since our beginnings in 1949, we have grown to serve our customers in Pennsylvania, southwestern New York, and northern West Virginia from 22 locations. And our mission remains as strong as ever: to offer a broad spectrum of quality electrical products and value added services, enhanced by a team of professionals who maintain the highest standards of business principles and integrity.  
  
As well as the electrical products and lamps and lighting we are most known for, we have expanded our product lines through the years to include automation and control, data communications, electronic components, heating and ventilation, professional audio/video, power quality, and surveillance and security.  
  
Our customer base consists of electrical contractors, purchasing agents, builders, maintenance personnel, and end users representing residential, commercial, industrial, institutional and government markets, and our sales force is ready to provide solutions for customers in all of these segments.  
  
Our roots remain solidly grounded in the desire to provide you with the utmost in service you expect and deserve from The Hite Company!  
  
The Hite Company is also certified by the PA labor industry to conduct a workplace safety committee as well as a registered service provider for the PA Gaming Control Board.

Her strategic planning and project management skills are instrumental in forging meaningful relationships between diverse suppliers and corporate, governmental, and academic entities. Leah's expertise in clinical research and healthcare information technology positions her as a thought leader in the industry. She is particularly passionate about leveraging her entrepreneurial spirit to develop sustainable business models that empower small disadvantaged businesses. Tegan's impact extends beyond her music, as she has been an outspoken advocate for LGBTQ+ rights and social justice issues. Her advocacy work has included supporting organizations like GLAAD, the Ally Coalition, and the It Gets Better Project, as well as using her platform to speak out on important issues facing marginalized communities. Tegan's commitment to using her influence for positive change has earned her admiration from fans and activists alike, solidifying her legacy as an artist with a purpose.

Throughout our history, the broad missions of teaching, research, and service have helped to guide the university and will continue to do so. When considered in the context of our tradition, resources, and national reputation, these five areas provide the university with important opportunities for greater service and distinction in the coming decade.  
  
Assuring Access: Our resources and programs exist first and foremost to serve the people of North Carolina, especially as we shape the workforce of tomorrow. We are committed to a spirit of access to all the opportunities afforded by a major research and teaching university. We will develop and sustain programs that support this ideal.  
  
Supporting Student Success: Even as our research and extension enterprise grows, we remain committed to providing a great education in the classroom and to preparing tomorrow’s leaders through engagement, community service, and meaningful leadership experiences.  
  
Creating Opportunity for the East: No institution is more important to eastern North Carolina than East Carolina University. Our Colleges of Business, Technology and Computer Science, and Fine Arts and Communication, as well as our health sciences schools, are significant drivers of the new economy.  
  
Forging Effective Partnerships: We are committed to building relationships with a wide range of partners for the benefit of the people of North Carolina.  
  
Responding to the Greatest Needs: The founding, growth, and continued success of East Carolina are all closely related to our effective response to the critical needs of communities and individuals.

About Power Pallet and Recycling
--------------------------------

Power Pallet and Recycling is an environmentally friendly family-owned business that manufactures and recycles wooden pallets of all sizes. All the residuals from the recycling and manufacturing process are reconfigured to reuse on finished pallets or ground up into wood chips for eco-friendly landscaped mulch. Power Pallet and Recycling services over 200 customers throughout a 120-mile radius and serves as a one stop shop and full-service provider to each of its customers.  
  
Features and Specialities:  
  
• 200,000 square foot state of the art automated facility  
• 40 acres of property  
• Wooden Pallets, Standard and Custom Sizes, NEW, Combination, Recycled  
• Removal of all repairable, standard, and odd size pallets  
• Spotted trailers at customer sites  
• Recyclables: baled cardboard and baled shrink wrap – customer rebates for full loads, mill direct shipments  
• Wood Chips – colored landscape mulch, boiler fuel, animal bedding  
• Dedicated Fleet for pallet deliveries and pickups as well as outside freight  
• Robotic and automated nailing systems for high quality, high volume produced pallets  
• Pallet tracking system which provides customers with timely and accurate pallet counts upon demand

About Brett Ratner

Brett Ratner is a prominent American film director known for his dynamic storytelling, visually stunning films, and ability to captivate audiences with his unique style. With a career spanning over two decades, Ratner has established himself as one of Hollywood's most successful and influential directors, leaving an indelible mark on the industry.  
  
Ratner was born on March 28, 1969, in Miami Beach, Florida. Fascinated by the world of film from an early age, he began making his own short films with a Super 8 camera that his grandfather gave him. Recognizing his passion and talent, Ratner's parents sent him to a filmmaking program at the prestigious New York University's Tisch School of the Arts.  
  
Upon completing his education, Ratner wasted no time in launching his directing career. He quickly gained recognition for his unique visual style and ability to create engaging narratives that resonated with audiences. In 1997, Ratner directed his feature film debut, "Money Talks," starring Chris Tucker and Charlie Sheen. The film's success opened doors for Ratner, allowing him to work on bigger projects.  
  
One of Ratner's most iconic works is the action-comedy franchise "Rush Hour." Released in 1998, the film starred Jackie Chan and Chris Tucker and became a massive hit, grossing over $244 million worldwide. Ratner's ability to balance comedy and action seamlessly captivated audiences, making "Rush Hour" an instant classic. The film's success spawned two equally successful sequels, solidifying Ratner's status as a director who could deliver crowd-pleasing films.  
  
In addition to the "Rush Hour" series, Ratner directed a diverse range of films that showcased his versatility as a filmmaker. He helmed the epic action adventure "X-Men: The Last Stand" in 2006, which became one of the highest-grossing films of the year, further cementing Ratner's reputation as a director capable of handling big-budget productions. He also directed the enchanting adventure film "The Family Man," starring Nicolas Cage, and the thrilling "Red Dragon," a prequel to the acclaimed "Silence of the Lambs."  
  
Ratner's ability to bring out the best in his actors is evident in the performances he elicits. He has a knack for casting the perfect actors, enabling them to deliver stellar performances under his direction. His collaborations with notable actors such as Robert De Niro, Ben Stiller, and Eddie Murphy have resulted in some of their most memorable roles.  
  
Beyond his success in feature films, Ratner has also ventured into producing. He founded RatPac Entertainment, a film production company, in partnership with billionaire James Packer. Through RatPac, he produced major Hollywood blockbusters, including "The Revenant," which won three Academy Awards, including Best Director for Alejandro González Iñárritu.  
  
While Ratner has undoubtedly achieved great success as a director, he has also faced his fair share of controversy. In 2017, multiple women accused Ratner of sexual misconduct and harassment, which led to a significant backlash against him. As a result, he stepped down from various projects and distanced himself from the Hollywood scene.  
  
Despite the controversy, Brett Ratner's impact on the film industry cannot be overlooked. His ability to craft compelling narratives, create visually stunning scenes, and work with some of Hollywood's biggest stars has left an indelible mark on cinema. His films continue to entertain and captivate audiences, showcasing his talent as a director who knows how to entertain and engage with audiences on a profound level.

With a strong commitment to fostering a love for learning, ZIS emphasizes the importance of striking the perfect balance in education. The school offers both bilingual and international educational pathways, encouraging local and foreign national students to come together, develop mutual understanding, and enhance their language skills in English and German, along with other world languages.  
  
At ZIS, the curriculum is designed to challenge students while igniting their passion for exploration and engagement across various subjects. The school believes in nurturing lifelong learners who are empathetic, open-minded, and eager to discover their unique interests. With state-of-the-art facilities and a diverse community, Zurich International School creates a supportive environment where students feel a sense of belonging and confidence to thrive.

Their clash showcased Kai's exceptional skills and ability to tell a story in the ring. The match elevated her status even further and solidified her as one of the top talents in women's wrestling.  
  
Outside the ring, Dakota Kai's presence extends beyond the squared circle. She often uses social media platforms to interact with fans, sharing snippets of her personal life and offering words of encouragement to those who need it. About Jack Fetkovich

Jack Fetkovich is currently making significant contributions as a part-time Embedded Software Engineer at John Deere, where he leverages his expertise in electrical engineering and embedded programming. As a dedicated Electrical Engineering student at North Carolina State University, Jack has cultivated a strong foundation in electronics, which he applies to real-world projects in the agricultural technology sector. His role primarily involves using the C programming language and Simulink models to implement innovative features in vehicle controllers, enhancing the functionality and reliability of agricultural machinery.  
  
One of Jack's key projects includes researching and implementing Unified Diagnostic Services (UDS), a critical component for diagnostics in new agricultural vehicles. This initiative not only showcases his technical acumen but also his commitment to improving vehicle performance and maintenance efficiency. Additionally, Jack utilizes the Simulink Test suite to rigorously verify that new features operate correctly, ensuring that the solutions he develops meet the high standards expected in the industry.  
  
Jack's experience extends beyond his academic pursuits; he has several years of hands-on experience working with competition robotics teams and volunteering in youth robotics programs. This background has honed his skills in control theory and analog-to-digital conversion, making him adept at tackling complex engineering challenges. His proficiency in tools such as Git for version control and his knowledge of CAD further enhance his ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams. With a passion for engineering and technology, Jack Fetkovich is poised to make a lasting impact in the field of embedded systems and agricultural innovation.

About Patricia Piccini

Patricia Piccinini is an Australian artist renowned for her thought-provoking and often controversial works that blur the lines between the natural and the artificial. Born in Sierra Leone in 1965 and raised in Australia, Piccinini's multicultural background has significantly influenced her artistic vision. She studied at the Victorian College of the Arts in Melbourne and has since gained international recognition for her unique and captivating creations.  
  
Piccinini's work often delves into themes of bioethics, genetic engineering, and the impact of technology on the human body. Her sculptures and installations are incredibly lifelike and often challenge viewers to confront their perceptions of beauty, monstrosity, and the boundaries between living organisms and synthetic materials. Drawing inspiration from the world around her, Piccinini's art challenges traditional notions of what it means to be human and the role of technology in shaping our future.  
  
One of Piccinini's most famous works is "The Young Family," a hyperrealistic sculpture of a human-animal hybrid family that garnered widespread attention and sparked intense debates about the ethics and possibilities of genetic manipulation. The piece features a mother creature breastfeeding her young, blurring the line between human and animal characteristics. "The Young Family" serves as a powerful commentary on the rapidly advancing field of biotechnology and its potential impact on our understanding of kinship and empathy.  
  
In addition to her sculptures, Piccinini also creates intricate, detailed drawings and digital illustrations that further explore her fascination with the intersection of biology and technology. These works often depict surreal, fantastical creatures that challenge traditional ideas of evolution and the natural world. Through her art, Piccinini encourages viewers to question the ethical implications of scientific advancements and the responsibility of humans to the world they inhabit.  
  
Piccinini's art has been exhibited in prestigious venues around the world, including the Venice Biennale, the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao, and the Art Gallery of South Australia. Her thought-provoking installations have garnered widespread acclaim and have pushed the boundaries of contemporary art, sparking conversations about the impact of technology on society and the environment. Piccinini's work continues to provoke and inspire audiences, challenging them to reconsider their perspectives on the natural world and the potential consequences of human intervention.  
  
In addition to her art practice, Piccinini is also a passionate advocate for the arts and education. She has frequently collaborated with educational institutions and museums to create engaging, interactive programs that encourage creativity and critical thinking among young people. Through her workshops and public speaking engagements, Piccinini seeks to inspire the next generation of artists and thinkers to explore the complex relationship between humans, technology, and the natural world.  
  
Overall, Patricia Piccinini is a visionary artist whose work pushes the boundaries of traditional art forms and challenges viewers to confront difficult questions about the future of humanity. Her thought-provoking sculptures and installations continue to captivate audiences around the world and spark important conversations about the ethical implications of scientific progress. With a diverse and dynamic body of work, Piccinini is an artist who has left an indelible mark on the contemporary art world and continues to inspire curiosity and reflection in all who encounter her creations.

From 1987, ASC was the prime contractor for the design, manufacture and delivery of the Royal Australian Navy's (RAN) fleet of six Collins Class submarines. About Steven Holl

Steven Holl is a highly acclaimed American architect known for his innovative and thought-provoking designs that push the boundaries of traditional architecture. Born in 1947 in Bremerton, Washington, Holl has become a prolific figure in the world of architecture, with his work being celebrated and recognized on a global scale.  
  
Holl’s architectural style is characterized by his focus on light, geometry, and the integration of nature into his designs. He is known for his ability to create spaces that are not only visually stunning but also functionally efficient and environmentally sustainable. His designs often incorporate natural light and materials, creating a sense of harmony and balance within the built environment.  
  
One of Holl’s most iconic works is the Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art in Kansas City, Missouri. Completed in 2007, this striking building features a series of translucent glass pavilions that are connected by a series of landscaped gardens. The museum’s design takes inspiration from the surrounding landscape, with its reflective surfaces mirroring the lush greenery and the changing seasons. Holl’s ability to seamlessly blend architecture with nature is evident in this project, as the building appears to emerge organically from its surroundings.  
  
Another notable project by Holl is the Simmons Hall dormitory at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT). Completed in 2002, this unconventional dormitory features a series of interconnected, undulating towers that create a dynamic and visually captivating interior space. The building’s design emphasizes communal living and interaction, with its open layout and shared amenities encouraging a sense of community among its residents. Holl’s ability to challenge traditional notions of architecture and create spaces that promote social interaction is evident in this project, making it a standout example of his innovative approach to design.  
  
Holl’s international influence can be seen in his design for the Linked Hybrid complex in Beijing, China. Completed in 2009, this mixed-use development features eight interconnected towers that are linked by a series of sky bridges. The complex includes residential, commercial, and recreational spaces, creating a vibrant and dynamic urban environment. Holl’s design for the Linked Hybrid complex embraces sustainable principles, with features such as green roofs, natural ventilation, and solar panels contributing to its environmentally-friendly footprint. This project demonstrates Holl’s commitment to creating buildings that not only serve their practical purposes but also contribute positively to the surrounding community and environment.  
  
In addition to his architectural designs, Holl is also recognized for his contributions to architectural education and theory. He has taught at various prestigious institutions, including Columbia University and the University of Washington, and has published several books on architecture and design. His writings often delve into the connections between architecture, philosophy, and the human experience, offering insights into his creative process and the deeper meanings behind his designs.  
  
Throughout his prolific career, Holl has been the recipient of numerous awards and honors for his contributions to the field of architecture. He has been recognized with the American Institute of Architects (AIA) Gold Medal, the Praemium Imperiale, and the RIBA International Prize, among others. His work continues to inspire and influence the next generation of architects, as he remains an active and influential figure in the architectural community.  
  
In conclusion, Steven Holl is a visionary architect whose innovative designs have left an indelible mark on the world of architecture. His ability to seamlessly blend architecture with nature, challenge traditional conventions, and create spaces that promote community and sustainability has solidified his reputation as a leading figure in the field. With a diverse portfolio of iconic projects around the world, Holl’s impact on the built environment is undeniable, making him a revered and influential figure in the realm of architecture.

About Piaggio Group
-------------------

Established in 1884 by Rinaldo Piaggio, since 2003 the Piaggio Group has been controlled by Immsi S.p.A., an industrial holding listed on the Italian stock exchange.  
  
The Piaggio Group product range includes scooters, mopeds and motorcycles marketed under the Piaggio, Vespa, Gilera, Aprilia, Moto Guzzi, Derbi and Scarabeo brands. The Group also operates in the three- and four-wheel light transport sector.  
The Piaggio Group is headquartered in Pontedera (Pisa, Italy) and has production plants around the world: in Pontedera (Pisa), which produces Piaggio, Vespa and Gilera branded two-wheelers, light transport vehicles for the European market and engines for scooters and motorcycles; Noale (Venice), a technical centre for the development of motorcycles and the base of Aprilia Racing; Scorzè (Venice), which produces Aprilia and Scarabeo branded two-wheelers; Mandello del Lario (Lecco, Italy), which produces Moto Guzzi vehicles and engines; Baramati (in the Indian state of Maharashtra), which produces three- and four-wheel light transport vehicles for the Indian market, diesel and turbodiesel engines for the Group’s commercial vehicles, and, since the beginning of 2012, the Vespa scooter for sale on the Indian market; Vinh Phuc (Vietnam), which produces Vespa and Piaggio scooters for the local market and the ASEAN area.  
The Piaggio Group also operates in China with a joint venture.

About Telmate
-------------

Our Vision  
Telmate is a leading provider of inmate communications services with a primary mission to create innovative technologies that lower recidivism by increasing the secured connections between inmates and their friends and family. Studies show that the more an inmate is connected to their community on the outside, the less likely they are to reoffend. As a result, every Telmate initiative is aimed at making more connections simple, affordable, positive and convenient.  
Our tech innovations emerge from our headquarters in San Francisco, CA. We also have a 24/7/365 call center in Ontario, OR, and staff located throughout the US and Canada. Telmate provides SaaS inmate phones, video visits, messaging, photo sharing, education, entertainment and more in nearly 200 facilities in over 30 states and in Canada.  
  
Customer Activity  
During an average day the Telmate solution facilitates and records on average: 22 million data requests (or 15,000 data requests per minute) made up of usage such as: concurrent phone calls, video visits, messages sent and received, deposits, Telmate Investigator inquiries, recording downloads and much more. Telmate is the industry leader in installed secure, inmate wireless tablets, with installations in over 50 facilities, with the most usage in the industry.  
  
Community Outreach  
Telmate is committed to supporting and honoring those on the front lines of corrections and law enforcement, as well as the communities we serve. Through our community outreach programs such as Telmate Cares, Telmate Heroes and Telmate Fallen Heroes, Telmate on a regular bases acknowledges and honors active and fallen officers. Telmate works closely with the Boys and Girls Club of Western Treasure Valley and recently served as a Badge of Honor Partner at the National Law Enforcement Officers Memorial Fund’s National Police Week activities in Washington, DC.

Our strategy is to provide places which meet the needs of our customers and respond to changing lifestyles - Places People Prefer. We do this by creating great environments both inside and outside our buildings and use our scale and placemaking skills to enhance and enliven them. This expands their appeal to a broader range of occupiers, creating enduring demand and driving sustainable, long-term performance.  
  
Sustainability is embedded throughout our business. Our places, which are designed to meet high sustainability standards, become part of local communities, provide opportunities for skills development and employment and promote wellbeing.  
  
We are a diverse, curious team that believes in shared success and enabling people to be themselves and work in ways they work best. Our small expert team works alongside other expert people on some of the most ambitious, innovative projects in the country, and we are committed to offering our people a rewarding career journey where you can shape how you grow. About Cast, Doncaster
---------------------

Cast welcomes audiences and participants of all ages from across the borough of Doncaster and beyond.  
  
All the diverse, creative experiences that we offer are enjoyed in an atmosphere that is both welcoming and supportive.  
  
Cast is committed to ensuring there is a parity of inclusivity for people with additional needs to engage with our programme, through adapted performances, supporting access for those with disabilities, and continuous barrier removal.  
  
Cast offers life-changing prospects to children and young people within Doncaster, with the aim of ensuring that every child and young person has the opportunity to experience the richness of the arts.  
  
We wouldn’t be where we are today, in our seventh successful year of operation, without the support of our staff, the Board, our supporters, members, partners and key financial stakeholders – not to mention our incredible audiences, customers and participants of the past, present and future.  
  
Cast’s artistic ambition is to ensure that we continue to grow as a destination of choice and a vibrant centre for the arts.  
  
We play a major role as a performance venue for Doncaster and beyond. We’re a resource and a focal point in the community, and asset in the creative ecology, and a driver in the local economy.  
  
Most importantly, Cast provides a safe space for all people to come together to see, listen, engage, make and understand quire simply to enjoy the arts in all of their many and varied aspects.

About Wurrly
------------

Our Vision  
  
WURRLYedu’s Mission is to revolutionize the way music is taught in schools.  
  
We believe all kids should have access to high quality music education and that it shouldn’t be restricted to the confines of the classroom walls.  
  
Our technology makes it easy for teachers to offer emotionally relevant content on multiple devices (including personal, class and teacher levels) in an environment of accountability for teacher and students.  
  
Our Philosophy  
  
We believe that the best learning is EXPERIENTIAL in nature.  
  
By definition, that means the DOING of something, AND THE REFLECTION on what was just done. Most people think of music as being experiential as you are doing something, but if you are not recording the performance how can there be any reflection? That is why we place such an importance on the video and audio recording tools in WURRLYedu.  
  
Secondly, we believe lessons with an "emotional hook" are the best way to engage students. It's not what but HOW lessons are presented that make them relatable.  
  
We believe our philosophy helps hone life skills that go far beyond music education, including analytical skills, communication and collaboration skills and problem solving.

What services does WURRLYedu offer for music education?

WURRLYedu provides a comprehensive suite of services designed to enhance music education in schools. Our platform offers interactive music lessons, curriculum resources, and tools for remote learning. We focus on engaging students through innovative technology, allowing them to learn instruments, music theory, and composition at their own pace. Additionally, we offer training and support for educators to effectively implement our resources in their classrooms.

How does WURRLYedu support remote learning in music education?

WURRLYedu is committed to making music education accessible, especially in remote learning environments. Our platform includes a variety of online resources, including video tutorials, interactive exercises, and virtual collaboration tools. Educators can easily assign lessons and track student progress, ensuring that learning continues seamlessly regardless of location. We also provide professional development for teachers to adapt their teaching strategies for online formats.

What age groups and educational levels does WURRLYedu cater to?

WURRLYedu caters to a wide range of age groups and educational levels, from elementary school students to high school learners. Our curriculum is designed to be adaptable, allowing educators to tailor lessons to meet the needs of their specific students, whether they are beginners or more advanced musicians. We believe that music education should be inclusive and accessible to all students, regardless of their prior experience.

Can WURRLYedu's resources be integrated into existing music programs?

Yes, WURRLYedu's resources are designed to be easily integrated into existing music programs. Our platform complements traditional teaching methods and can enhance the curriculum with additional materials and interactive content. Educators can select specific lessons and resources that align with their current program, allowing for a seamless transition and enrichment of their music education offerings.

What types of music education solutions does WURRLYedu provide for schools?

WURRLYedu provides a variety of music education solutions tailored for schools, including curriculum development, lesson planning tools, and assessment resources. Our platform features a diverse library of music genres and styles, enabling students to explore different musical traditions. We also offer customizable lesson plans and performance opportunities to help students showcase their skills and creativity.

How can educators get started with WURRLYedu?

Educators can get started with WURRLYedu by visiting our website and signing up for a free trial. This allows them to explore our platform, access resources, and evaluate how our solutions can fit into their teaching practices. Additionally, we provide onboarding support and training sessions to help educators effectively implement our tools and maximize their impact on student learning.

The company works with businesses in these sectors to facilitate the transition to more sustainable practices through innovative financing solutions and expert advisory services.

This includes structuring debt and equity financing, providing access to grants and incentives, and helping clients navigate the complexities of funding for renewable energy and other sustainable initiatives.

The process for obtaining financing through Sustainable Capital Finance typically begins with an initial consultation to understand the client's project and financial needs. Following this, the company conducts a thorough assessment of the project’s viability and sustainability impact. Once the project is deemed suitable, Sustainable Capital Finance will work on structuring the financing package and assist with the necessary documentation and negotiations.

Does Sustainable Capital Finance provide advisory services for green projects?

Yes, Sustainable Capital Finance offers comprehensive advisory services for green projects. This includes feasibility studies, market analysis, and strategic planning to help clients identify the best paths for sustainable growth. The advisory team also assists in navigating regulatory requirements and securing funding from various sources, ensuring that projects are not only viable but also aligned with sustainability goals.

What types of clients does Sustainable Capital Finance typically work with?

Sustainable Capital Finance works with a diverse range of clients, including startups, established businesses, non-profits, and government entities. Their focus is on organizations that are committed to sustainability and are looking to implement or expand environmentally friendly practices. The company aims to partner with clients who share a vision for a sustainable future and are seeking innovative financial solutions to achieve their goals.

About Africa World Airlines Limited
-----------------------------------

Africa World Airlines Limited (AWA) is a private-sector Ghanaian airline that operates from a base in Accra. The airline is a joint venture between HNA Group/Hainan Airlines and other Chinese and Ghanaian shareholders.  
  
AWA has been issued with Air Carrier License (ACL) number 222 and Air Operator Certificate (AOC) number 030 by the Ghana Civil Aviation Authority (GCAA). The airline commenced flight operations on 21st September 2012 with all-jet services from Accra to Kumasi and Tamale using Embraer 145 aircraft. The airline now operates 8 aircraft on a route network encompassing 10 destinations throughout West Africa.  
  
Africa World Airlines has been allocated the 3-letter code "AFW" by the International Civil Aviation Organisation (ICAO) and 2-letter code "AW" by the International Air Transport Association (IATA).  
  
For details on recruitment and career opportunities with AWA please visit www.flyafricaworld.com/recruitment.

---------------------------

The James L. Maher Center, Newport, RI, is devoted to providing a broad range of services that advance independence and create opportunities for children and adults with developmental disabilities, their families and the community at large.  
  
Our programs and services are designed to provide the individual with developmental disabilities the personalized support they need, including vocational, educational and therapeutic services as required, and to provide employment opportunities so that adults with developmental disabilities can engage as fully as possible in life experiences and live their lives with dignity and respect.

FECI is dedicated to sustainable development practices by integrating environmentally friendly solutions into its projects. This includes utilizing green building techniques in real estate developments, promoting the use of rail transportation to reduce carbon emissions, and investing in infrastructure that supports sustainable urban growth. The company aims to balance economic growth with environmental stewardship.

Yes, FECI offers comprehensive logistics and supply chain management services. The company leverages its extensive rail network and transportation solutions to provide efficient and reliable logistics support. FECI works with businesses to optimize their supply chains, reduce costs, and improve delivery times, ensuring that goods are transported safely and efficiently.

FECI undertakes a wide range of real estate projects, including commercial developments, residential communities, and mixed-use properties. The company focuses on creating vibrant spaces that enhance community living and promote economic activity. FECI's projects often incorporate modern design and sustainable practices to meet the needs of today’s residents and businesses.

About CoatChex
--------------

CoatChex was born in the bars and nightclubs as a solution to a very real problem: coats and jackets were routinely stolen or lost due to the lack of coat checking services. After a few years of checking coats the “old-fashioned” way, it was clear that the industry needed to undergo a revolution – and innovative technology combined with superior service was the answer.  
  
CoatChex is a subsidiary of Chexology, an innovative platform that uses proprietary ticketless technology for checking services. The technology provides peace of mind through mobile devices and smart tags to capture transactions very quickly, accurately and in real time. The merchant mobile application takes a picture of the user, their belonging and electronically checks in their item(s) to enhance efficiency and security while eliminating tickets. The customer experience creates enjoyable moments during situations that have traditionally caused headaches. This technology opens many avenues to authentically engage with customers and create measurable impact through socially-based conversations and interactions.

About ProKids
-------------

ProKids’ vision is a safe, permanent and nurturing home for every child.  
  
For 32 years, ProKids has been advocating for abused and neglected children by mobilizing our community to break the vicious cycle of child abuse and neglect.  
  
We recruit, train, and support community volunteers to speak up for children who have been abused and neglected, and help guide them into safe environments where they can thrive. The heart of this effort is our CASA (Court Appointed Special Advocate) volunteers. Each CASA volunteer is assigned to a foster child – making sure the child is safe, that the child’s needs are being met, and helping each child move into a safe, permanent and nurturing home as quickly as possible.  
  
For more than a decade, 99% of children represented by ProKids were free from abuse while in the foster care system.

Over the course of almost 27 years, Gibney has evolved from a socially active dance

About Ministry Of Education, Morocco
------------------------------------

The Ministry of Education in Morocco, located at Avenue Ennasr, Bab Rouah, Rabat, is a cornerstone institution responsible for the development and implementation of educational policies across the nation. It oversees a broad spectrum of educational sectors, including preschool, fundamental, and secondary education, as well as vocational training programs like Brevets de Technicien Supérieur (BTS) and preparatory classes for prestigious higher education institutions. The Ministry is committed to enhancing the quality of education through rigorous regulation and oversight of private schooling, ensuring that educational standards align with national objectives.  
  
To achieve its mission, the Ministry employs various strategic initiatives aimed at improving teaching methodologies, curriculum development, and teacher training programs. It leverages modern technologies to facilitate educational advancements and promote innovative learning environments. The Ministry also provides valuable resources, such as the Ministry of Education, Morocco teachers list, which offers insights into the qualifications and distribution of educators throughout the country.  
  
By fostering an inclusive and equitable education system, the Ministry of Education strives to meet the diverse needs of Moroccan students, equipping them with the skills necessary to navigate a rapidly evolving global landscape. Through continuous improvement and a focus on innovation, the Ministry aims to elevate educational standards and empower the next generation of learners, ultimately contributing to the socio-economic development of Morocco.

About National Black MBA Association-Kansas City Chapter
--------------------------------------------------------

The Kansas City Chapter of the National Black MBA Association, Inc.(KCNBMBAA) is one of 47 professional & 27 college chapters throughout the United States.  
  
  
OUR MISSION  
  
To lead in the creation of economic and intellectual wealth for African Americans.  
  
OUR ORIGIN  
  
The National Black MBA Association® (NBMBAA) was founded in 1970 at the University of Chicago, by a group of African American MBA students, faculty, advisors, and businessmen. The Kansas City Chapter began as a interest group in 1988 and received full chapter status in 1995. The chapter has twice been awarded "Chapter of the Year".  
  
WHAT WE DO  
  
Empower minority business professionals through a wide range of strategic business forces, including career and education programs, entrepreneurship, lifestyle, and leadership.  
  
With our core values at heart, empowering minority business professionals is an ongoing journey for NBMBAA – one that we value. We are committed to making a sustainable and impactful difference in the communities in which we empower, work, and serve.  
  
The Kansas City chapter is a 501(c)3 providing over $50,000 in scholarships, support for our Leaders of Tomorrow program (targeted at high school students), and has held entrepreneurial & career expositions throughout our existence. We are fully invested in the Kansas City community and invite other liked minded professionals and businesses to partner with us.

About MILAP
-----------

Our mission is to inspire, educate and entertain people of all backgrounds, through a world-class programme of Indian Arts.  
  
Values  
Uniting Hearts Through Arts  
Milap aims to bring people together to collaborate, share and integrate, through all of the programmes we create. This includes artists with audiences, students with teachers, artists with other artists – and all kinds of other people and organisations from diverse backgrounds and geographical areas. Uniting people is a first, crucial step towards improving the world around us.  
  
Brave, adventurous & futuristic  
Our approach to innovation, creativity and quality includes a commitment to take risks and think of how audiences, participants and artists might develop in the future. With a track record of invention, including national ensembles, new productions and a family of brands that is unparalleled in Indian arts, Milap intends to innovate in order to thrive in the future.  
  
Indian Arts for Everyone  
We believe that Indian arts are universal – our performance traditions tell stories, reflect seasons, moods and ideas, and use improvisation, composition and collaboration. Anyone can learn, appreciate or enjoy Indian arts, and it is our aim to bring people close to them through our programme of work.  
  
A Company culture that values artists, audiences, team members, and partners  
In order to deliver a programme of work that helps to change people’s lives for the better, Milap’s organisational values must also ensure that anyone working with or for it are inspired, uplifted and treated with respect. In order to deliver our mission and aims, we need to nurture an international network of artists, who are well trained, connected and have the opportunities to be successful. Education and training for everyone underpins this ideal.

What types of fitness classes does Énergie Cardio offer?

Énergie Cardio offers a diverse range of fitness classes to cater to various interests and fitness levels. Our offerings include Yoga, Pilates, Zumba Fitness, CrossTraining, BODYPUMP, and group training sessions. We also provide specialized classes for muscle building, weight loss, and indoor cycling. Each class is designed to promote physical well-being and can be tailored to meet individual needs.

How can I get started with personal training at Énergie Cardio?

Getting started with personal training at Énergie Cardio is simple! First, visit our website or your nearest Énergie Cardio center to learn about our personal training options. You can schedule a consultation with one of our certified trainers who will assess your fitness goals and create a personalized training plan. We offer one-on-one sessions as well as small group training for those who prefer a more social environment.

Are there any programs specifically designed for weight loss?

Yes, Énergie Cardio offers specialized programs aimed at weight loss. Our fitness classes, such as CrossTraining and BODYPUMP, are designed to maximize calorie burn and improve overall fitness. Additionally, our personal trainers can work with you to develop a customized weight loss plan that includes both exercise and nutritional guidance, ensuring a holistic approach to achieving your weight loss goals.

What is kinésiologie and how is it integrated into Énergie Cardio's services?

Kinésiologie is the study of human movement and its impact on health and wellness. At Énergie Cardio, we integrate kinésiologie into our services by offering assessments and personalized exercise programs that focus on improving physical performance, rehabilitation, and injury prevention. Our trained professionals utilize kinésiological principles to help clients achieve their fitness goals safely and effectively.

Can I participate in group classes if I am a beginner?

Absolutely! Énergie Cardio welcomes participants of all fitness levels, including beginners. Our group classes are designed to be inclusive and adaptable, allowing everyone to participate at their own pace. Instructors are trained to provide modifications and support, ensuring that all members feel comfortable and motivated during their workouts. We encourage beginners to join and experience the supportive community at Énergie Cardio.

What safety measures does Énergie Cardio have in place for its members?

Énergie Cardio prioritizes the safety and well-being of its members. We have implemented a range of safety measures, including regular cleaning and sanitization of equipment and facilities, social distancing protocols, and health screenings for staff and members. Additionally, we provide virtual class options for those who prefer to work out from home. Our goal is to create a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.

----------

VIGA is a global initiative that aims at taking the exemplary success of Akhuwat interest-free microlending model, founded in 2001 with only $100 is now the world’s largest interest-free micro-lending organization. With a portfolio of over $675m, the organization has provided over 4.3m loans provided to date with an exceptional recovery rate of 99%.  
  
The most important gap for hundreds of millions of talented, educated, hardworking, willing and able to work people is access to opportunities. Generation after generation, underprivileged and marginalized segments of most societies find it impossible to get out of the vicious cycle of poverty.  
  
VIGA strongly ascribes to the famous adage i.e. teaching a man how to fish to feed for life. We believe that the positive impact of empowerment does not only lasts a lifetime but for a generation.  
  
Please join VIGA – a movement to provide small micro-loans that are recovered in a short amount of time and are recycled many times over, helping so many deserving people live a happier and more fulfilling life – just like us.

KnobbeMedical.com addresses this challenge by compiling these vital resources and providing easy access to them in one place.

Cuenta oficial de la Superintendencia Nacional de Educación Superior Universitaria.  
  
A través de la publicación de la Ley Universitaria, Ley Nº 30220, se hace oficial la creación de la Superintendencia Nacional de Educación Superior Universitaria, cuya constitucionalidad fue ratificada por el Tribunal Constitucional el 26 de enero de 2016.  
  
Nuestra misión es velar por la calidad de la educación superior universitaria en el Perú.  
  
Nuestras funciones son las siguientes:  
\- Aprobar o denegar la solicitudes de licenciamiento de universidades, filiales, facultades, escuelas y programas de estudios conducentes a grado académico, de conformidad con la Ley Universitaria y la normativa aplicable.  
\- Determinar las infracciones e imponer las sanciones que correspondan en el ámbito de su competencia.  
\- Supervisar en el ámbito de su competencia la calidad de la prestación del servicio educativo considerando la normativa establecida respecto a la materia.  
\- Administrar el Registro Nacional de Grados y Títulos.

About SGL, now part of Masstech Innovations Inc.
------------------------------------------------

SGL is a leading provider of content archive and storage management software for multiple business sectors including post production, news, sports and government. Founded in 1991, the company has clients across the globe, serviced by offices in the US, UK, Germany, Singapore and Australia.  
  
SGL’s FlashNet content storage management system delivers unrivalled levels of resilience, flexibility and adaptability. FlashNet can control and manage all aspects of attached storage systems, whether to near-line, disk, tape or optical disk. Additional benefits of FlashNet include a range of services and workflows to ensure a robust, comprehensive archive. FlashNet Amalgamation Workflow is optimises archiving performance by consolidating multiple small file archive requests into a single archive process, FlashNet Migration Service provides an elegant and fast tool for the migration of entire sets of tape media from one generation or platform to another and the StorageManager module is an intelligent, automated data lifecycle management tool that fully manages data within the archive. The latest development to FlashNet is FlashNet Infinity, an elegant suite of web-based dashboard tools adding even more sophistication and flexibility to the FlashNet solution.  
  
For those taking their first steps into managing their archive, SGL offers FlashNet Lite, FlashPack and FlashBox. FlashNet Lite is a comprehensive, entry-level archiving solution available in four configurations: FL Disk, FL Tape, FL Hybrid and FL Optical Disk, which provide for content storage that is disk only, tape only, optical disk or a combination of disk and tape. FlashNet Lite is a software only solution, however it can be combined with FlashPack and FlashBox, SGL's turnkey archive systems 'in a box' for use with any MAM system.  
  
SGL’s comprehensive content archive and storage management solutions are built on open, scalable and reliable solutions, providing significant workflow, time and cost efficiencies.

About CSEA Local 834
--------------------

CSEA Onondaga Local 834 is a not for profit organization which represents more then 3,500 public service members in Onondaga County. We are employees of Onondaga County, City of Syracuse, Syracuse Housing Authority, OCWA, Liverpool Library and several towns and villages.  
  
We are workers who join together in solidarity to have clout at the negotiating table, in the political arena and in our communities. We are individuals who know that you have to belong to be strong, and we negotiate with our employers from a position of strength that comes from union membership.  
  
CSEA is proud that we are a grassroots union where members themselves elect their officers and where only members can serve on negotiating teams and vote to ratify contracts.  
  
CSEA also has a respected political action network to represent your interests before elected officials. As Local 1000 of the American Federation of State, County and Municipal Employees, we belong to the most powerful international union in the United States.  
  
To our members we say:  
  
Get involved. The more involved you are, the more rewarding your membership will be.

About Billings Clinic
---------------------

Billings Clinic is Montana’s largest health care system serving Montana, Wyoming and the western Dakotas. A not-for-profit organization led by a physician CEO, Billings Clinic is governed by a board of community members, nurses and physicians. Billings Clinic is an integrated multi-specialty group practice with a 304-bed hospital and Level II trauma center. Billings Clinic has more than 4,600 employees, including more than 480 physicians and advanced practitioners offering more than 80 specialties.  
  
Billings Clinic has 14 regional partnerships, including management agreements with 13 Critical Access Hospitals and one outpatient clinic. In addition, we conduct approximately 110 specialty care clinics per month at 21 different regional locations for residents of rural Montana, Wyoming, and North Dakota. We were designated as the first Magnet organization in Montana in 2006, and are a member of the Mayo Clinic Care Network.  
  
Billings, Montana is a friendly college community located near the magnificent Rocky Mountains with great schools, safe neighborhoods, short commutes and abundant family activities. Exciting outdoor recreation is just minutes from home. Come enjoy 300 days of sunshine!

About International Trademark Association (INTA)
------------------------------------------------

The International Trademark Association (INTA) is a global association of brand owners and professionals dedicated to supporting trademarks and complementary intellectual property (IP) to foster consumer trust, economic growth, and innovation, and committed to building a better society through brands.  
  
Members include more than 6,500 organizations, representing more than 34,000 brand owners, trademark counsel, academics, and other professionals, from 185 countries, who benefit from the Association’s global trademark resources, policy development, education and training, committee participation, and global networking and Business Development opportunities. INTA's Annual Meeting is the world's largest gathering of brand owners and professionals in the IP field.  
  
Founded in 1878, INTA is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Beijing, Brussels, Santiago, Singapore, and Washington, D.C., and a representative in New Delhi. For more information, please visit www.inta.org.

O Sistema nasceu com a fundação da Unimed Santos (SP) pelo Dr. Edmundo Castilho, em 1967, e hoje é composto por 368 cooperativas médicas, que prestam assistência para mais de 19 milhões de clientes e 73 mil empresas em todo País.  
  
Clientes Unimed contam com mais de 110 mil médicos, 3.244 hospitais credenciados, além de pronto-atendimentos, laboratórios, ambulâncias e hospitais próprios e credenciados para garantir qualidade na assistência médica, hospitalar e de diagnóstico complementar oferecidos.  
  
Além de deter 34% do mercado nacional de planos de saúde, a Unimed possui lembrança cativa na mente dos brasileiros. De acordo com pesquisa nacional do Instituto Datafolha, a Unimed é pelo 21º ano consecutivo a marca Top of Mind quando o assunto é plano de saúde. Outro destaque é o prêmio plano de saúde em que os brasileiros mais confiam, recebido pela 11ª vez consecutiva, na pesquisa Marcas de Confiança.

About Central Bank Of Armenia
-----------------------------

The Central Bank of Armenia (the CBA) is a legal entity empowered with state functions. Primary goal of the CBA is price stability in the Republic of Armenia. The CBA coordinates the primary goal with the Government of Armenia, as stipulated by the Armenian Law on State Budget, and approved by the National Assembly of Armenia. The CBA itself decides on the strategy of monetary policy it implements and target (intermediate and operational) indicators that are contained in the monetary policy program and subject to presentation to the National Assembly. The program outlines the main directions of the monetary policy and the monetary instruments which the CBA uses in order to fulfill its objectives.  
Coordination of monetary and fiscal policies is priority in developing and implementing the monetary policy. The coordination involves both opting for basic macroeconomic indicators and issues relating to short-term adjustment of liquidity by the CBA, disbursement of external financial inflows and issuance and allocation of T-bills by the Government. The CBA makes sure its activities are maximally transparent and open to public, which serve the best warrant for the general public's confidence in the monetary policy implemented by the CBA.
